tei:div.tei:p: — 8 bye mi 33 3gi ri zhe sha tshong sku / nadu 'a shāci /lha 'a pasang /ri kyi) cir rtoshā du re hūṃ cig sdus sa /ci rdo / / ci 4 tsho cho ci ci shā/ /ci chos ḍā 'a chi na chi/༷//ci༈ rdo po/ ri/ ri ne ci me tho/// ma/ ci rdo su rje rtog waX rdo ris — ci/rngo17sna phyo // 3lo ṭwāṃ

//rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi chos 'byung lo rgyus 'dod 'jo'i bum bzang zhes bya ba bsdo/kragatraṭa so 21 bzang bsam gtan/a ri'i phi li ṭa phi ya spyan ras gzigs nang pa'i chos tshogs kyi chos dge
bdapori dpasna mtha:

4 cig 3 ri / ( ci ——— 61 ci zi ga sna tshe ri4 rdo na ( ḍarsharshas tshe ma ༷ ci3 4 da la / zhe ri rno 2 — ga zhe pa rtse ca 〉༷༷ ༷ dziX tsho tsho / ༷ ༷༷ yi rta ( 7 4 kā tre julho rngo tsho nga tshu mo 7 / kyi da nga po dhe / rdzo ༷ ṇa bye'achi ri9 4 ༄ 4 34rngo ji sa/cho ba lā zhe pa435—— — — ri na/ tsho/ji pas 'i 〉 rtseg ci du chi ne cing — 6rdo bye rwasdi 〉〉 mi mi rjod gyi ༷ ( tsho ci la te 4 2 ra sbong — dzo ri 9 ) kya4 la ri mas ༄ rto riX — 43snabacu ra ༷ rmyo ༷ ༷ ༷ chi rdoX rno / tho naX sna ri rdzo nga 4 can — 4 kyi mo —— ri kā dngorsha 4 4 — sto sna zhe hā 1 ske cho chi dhe'i be zhe rsā 7cha chalari — sna ri rnga ༵༵ / no cho sna me rin mo ce /di cis sdu rmosogatā rtsib sgo dora'i pa ri rī stong nyid snying rje bdag nyid can//srid gsum skye dang 'jigs pa med//shes dang shes bya gcig pa'i sku//dpal ldan dus 'khor la phyag 'tshal//

gling brjod/ ༄༄/ /deng dus gangs ri'i khrod sogs 'dzam gling na/ /ris med rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba la/ / bsam bzhin byon pa 7rgyal ba gnyis pa dngos/ / thams cad mkhyen pa bstan 'dzin rgya ma35ra 'dud/ /bod gangs ljongs su 'gro kun phan bde'i gzhi rtsa/ mdo sngags yongs su rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bsdi gnas ris med dgon sde stong phrag mang po yod pa'i khongs nas/ mi lo bzhi brgya lhag gi lo rgyus dang ldan pa/ 7rgyal ba'i sku bcar rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang ngam/ phan bde legs bshad gling zhes pa 'di bzhin/ thog mar thams cad mkhyen pa 7rgyal mchog sku phreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos phyi lo 1509 lor chos 'khor rgyal phyag btab pa nas dbu 'dzugs/ de mjug 7rgyal dbang gong ma rim byon rnams kyis thugs smon mtshams sbyor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas thun mong dang thun mong ma yin pa'i dgos pa dge mtshan rgya cher gzigs te/ 7rgyal ba'i sku bcar grwa tshang du bdag gir bzhes/ grwa 1

gling brjod/tshang nas 7rgyal dbang rim byon kyi chos phyogs zhabs zhu yongs su rdzogs pa'i thog bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po'i bstan srid zhabs rim sgrub rgyu/ gsang chen bla na med pa'i rgyud sde gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang / phur ba bcas kyi rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor kyi sgo nas sgom sgrub/ bya rgyu da kyi cho ga khag mang / gzhung sa dga' ldan pho brang gi bstan srung dmar nag gnyis kyis dbus bstan pa bsrung ba'i srung chog khag gi bskang chog mdo sngags gzhung chen khag la mtshan nyid rigs pa'i slob gnyer/ thun mong ma yin pa bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil chog gar thig dbyangs gsum sogs ngo mtshar skye 'os kyi bsnyi gnas grwa tshang rin po che 'di nyid kyi chos 'byung lo rgyus mi nyung ba zhig rgyal rabs khag dang lhag par du 7rgyal dbang sku phreng rim byon gyi gsung rnam khag tu gsal na'ang / da bar tredzes 'byung 81 rgyus khag phyogs bsgrigs su bzhugs pa gus pas ma mjal bas/ don gnyer can rnams la gzigs bde'i ched du deb chung zhig byung na ci ma rung snyam ste/ phyi lo 1984 nas bzung / zhar zhor du 7rgyal dbang rim byon gyi zhabrungs rabs deb ther nor bu'i phreng ba phyag deb lnga dang /spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i mdzad rnam rin po che ngos kyi yul dang ngos kyi mi mang / de bzhin khungs ldan bod kyi rgyal rabs lo rgyus khag 2

gling brjod/gi dpe deb/ lhag par du bka' drin can gyi sku zhabs bgres gras rnam pa'i zhal rgyun khungs ldan khag rang gi dngos mjal zin bris su bkod pa bcas la brten nas/ gtso cher bstan pa 'di la ston pa gnyis pa las kyang khyad du 'phags pa/ nges pa don gyi shing rta'i srol 'byed 'dzam gling zhi bde'i ded dpon chen po spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi sku'i che ba'i yon tan rnams/ tha na sngar gyi lam dang lugs srol ches khyad par can du mi mthong ba dang / spyir btang chos dug tu lta mkhan zhig yin yang / blo gzu bor gnas pa'i sgo nas rgyu mtshan mthong ste bsngags brjod zhu pa/ sngar bod dang / nang chos kyi sgra tsam med pa'i yul du'ang mgon po mchog gi sku gsung thugs kyi 'phrin las kyis khyab pa/ 'dzam gling yul gru khag gi khungs ldan dpe deb tshong khang rnams su spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon mchog gi phyag deb khag khrin tshong ang dang po/ ha las ngo mtshar skye 'os kyi do snang / shes 'dod rgyu mtshan ldan pa'i sgo nas dad pa dang brtsi bkur/ yi rangs/ rang re gangs can pa rnams la'ang / spring chos rgyal lo paṇa rnams dang / ris med bstan 'dzin gyi skyes chen byang chub sems dpa' rnams nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la mdzad rjes bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bka' drin bskyang yod kyang / spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 3

gleng brjod/chen po mchog ni de dag las ches khyad par du 'phags shing / ris su ma chad pa'i rgyal ba'i bstan pa la/ nges pa don gyi bka' drin gyis khyab pa/ de ltar yin pa yang mgon po mchog gi (7thub bstan ris med rgyas pa'i smon lam drang srong bden pa'i dbyangs snyan las na/ ris med rgyal ba'i bstan par dag snang mos gus thob ste thos bsam sgom pa'i brtson pa lhur len pa zhes bka' stsal ba bzhin nyams bzhes dang / rjes 'jug gdul bya rnams la'ang /sngar gyi lam lugs lta bu ma yin par/ deng dus dang dngos yod gnas tshul dang mthun pa'i sgo nas mig kha phye ba lta bu'i 'di phyi'i lam ston brtseba'i bka' slob dang chos rgyud chen po bzhi'i lta ba'i dgongs pa rnams/ ming brda so so las mthar thug gi dgongs pa gcig du 'bab tshul gyi sngar med legs bshad/lung rigs gnyis kyis sgo nas gtan la dbab pa/ ngo mtshar ba'i sku'i che ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rnams blo gzu bor gnas pa/ don gnyer can rigs pa dang ldan pa dag gis mjal dus/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa spyi dang / lhag par du mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi bstan pa 'di la/ sku drin shin tu che ba/ khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs bka' drin gsum ldan gyi rtsaba'i bla ma 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang / bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa rin po che 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bsdi 4

gling brjod/gnas grwa tshang rin po che'i bka' drin rgya mtsho lta bu nas chu thigs tsam gsab pa'i slad dang / sgos su grwa tshang 'dir gsar zhugs slob gnyer ba rnams dang / phyi nang don gnyer can rnams la phan re/ rjes su grwa tshang nas chos 'byung lo rgyus kyi dpe deb gsar bskrun gyi cha rkyen du yong re shar te/ grwa tshang phyag btabs nas/ phyi lo 1985 lo bar gyi gnas stangs lo rgyus zin bris lta bur phyogs bsgrigs zhu thub byung ba 'di ni gtso bo/ slob zur thub bstan mchog ldan lags/ sku zhabs 'jam dpal snyan grags lags/ dbu zur ngag dbang bkra shis lags/ sku zhabs sku bcar blo bzang dga' ba lags/ slob dpon thub bstan chos 'phel lags/ mchod g.yog bstan 'dzin grags pa lags/ dge bskos blo bzang dar rgyas lags/ bstan 'dzin chos grags lags/ gsol thab pa bstan 'dzin dge ba lags thub bstan yar 'phel lags/ badzra'aphrin las lags/ sku sger las byed sku ngo byams bstan lags/ gsol thab :rto bzang rnam rgyal lags kyi dbus sku zhabs 'tsho bzhugs rnams dang / sku zhabs dam pa mchod g.yog thub bstan 'jam dbyangs lags/ gar dpon sku zhabs thub bstan rin chen lags/ sku zhabs thub bstan zla ba lags/ sku zhabs skal bzang chos 'byor lags/sku zhabs dkon mchog yon tan lags bcas nas grwa tshang rin po cher thugs 5

gling brjod/'khur che bzhes kyis gang ci'i thad thog mtha' bar gsum du dge bskul gyi lam ston bka' slob bka' drin che bar gus pas snying nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / deb chung zin bris 'di bzhin phyi lo 1988 lor dpar bskrun zhu rgyu byas kyang rkyen du mas nar 'gyangs stabs/ da bar zhu thub ma song de nas mkhyen dgos pa zhig ni deb 'di'i brjod bya phyi lo 1980 bar gyi grwa tshang gi gnas stangs dang lo gcig gi nang gi mdzad rim khag gzhir bzung ste bkod pa las/ deng gi skabs su/ dper na grwa tshang gi rgyugs spyod 'bul stangs skor la'ang 'gyur ba phyin 'dug na'ang / 'di lo rgyus kyi deb chung du song tsang 'gyur ba ma btang bar skabs de gzhir bzung ltar dpar du bskrun pa yin/mtha' don skyes sbyangs kyi shes yon dang / mthong rgya chung ba'i stabs kyis nor 'khrul ji snyed yod pa rnams bzod bzhes gnang skyong bcas ston pa 'das lo 2547 bod rgyal lo 2130 rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu lug phyi lo 2003 zla 5 tshes 16 nyin theg chen chos gling du rtso ma sgrig bgyis pa grwa tshang rin po che'i bka' drin gyis 'tsho ba gus pa blo bzang bsam gtan nam dngos grub kyis/6

dkar chagadakar chab/sdo na brjod/don tshan dang po/( 1 ) thog mar grwa tshang phyag btab pa nas thams cad mkhyen pa 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku dus bar gyi grwa tshang rin po che'i lo rgyus/ ( 1 )don tshan gnyis pa/(2) thams cad mkhyen pa 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i mchog gi 1959 lo phan gyi grwa tshang dang 'brel ba'i chos srid kyi mdzad pa snying bsdus (25)( 3 ) bod du thog mar grwa tshang la sgrigs zhugs byed stangs dang de'i skabs grwa grangs ji yod ( 35) ( 4) bod du lo 'khor gcig nang 7rgyal ba'i gsung zhabs zhu sgo khag gi mdzad rim ( 42)( 5) gra tshang gi mchod gzhis ( 72)44 1

dkar chag dan 'byen ga༄/ma pa/( 5 ) 1959 lor spyi nor 7gong sa mchog rgya gar sa thog tu chibs bsgyur bskyangs skor (75)( 6 ) byes 'byor bod mi'i 'phrod sku zhabs dzobacu nga gnyis lha sa nas khros te rgya gar sa thog du 'byor tshul rka (77)( 7 ) rgya gar du slar yang grwatshang gsar 'dzugs bskyangs tshul rka (86)don tshan bzhi ba/( 8 ) grwa rgyun gsar du 'dzug rgyu dang de'i skabs kyi gnas snangs ( 97 )( 9) lo rim bcu'i slob tshan ( 125)don tshan lnga pa/( 10)deng skabs lo 'khor gcig gi mdzad rim mdor bsdus (134)don tshan drug pa/( 11 ) 1985 lor gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen gnang skabs ༷/mdzad rim rkarka rka rka rkarkarka'i la'irka rka 0777(144)bdun pa/( 12) bca' yi ga gser gyi gnya' shing ( 170)2

sngon brjod/ ༄༅༅/ /gangs can bod kyi sa la'i stongs 'di bzhin 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs kyis gdul zhing du lhag par phyag mchani tu bdag gir bzhes nas/ thog mar mi yi 'gro ba spel ba nas bzung rgyal blon paṇa grub sogs sprul pa'i rol gar ji brnyed cig byon nas 'gro ba rnams smin grol gyi lam la 'god par ma zad/ lhag par rgyal mchog dge 'dun grub pa nas bzung / mthong grol mtshan dpe'i gzugs sku lham mer gsal ba/ sa steng rgyal bstan skusnangs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag 'gro ba'i dug gsum gyi gcong nad sel ba'i rtsisman gyi ljon pa chen po/ 'dzam gling zhi bde'i ded dpon 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog gi bar/ 7rgyal dbang rim byon rnams kyis dbus gtsang mdo stod smad bcas bod ljongs mtha' dbus kun dang / chen po hor dang rgya nag deng gi dus su 'dzam gling shar nub kyi yul gru phal mo cher/ mkhas btsun bzang gsum/ lta sgom spyod gsum/ 'chad rtsod rtsom gsum/ thos bsam sgom gsum gyis/ ston pa mnyam med shākya seṅge'i chos tshul dar spel/nyam pa slar gso/ mi nyams gong 'phel/ grangs las 'das pa'i skye bo rnams kyi rgyud la stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can gyis byang chen gyi sa bon grung 1

po btabs te ma smin pa smin pa dang / smin pa grol bar mdzad cing / lugs zung 'phrin las kyi gdugs dkar dkar 'jam yug gcig gi grib bsil snum pos/ bod 'bangs snyigs lnga'i tsha gdung las skyabs nas sde bzhi'i dpal la rjeXr ba sogs/ 81 rgyus smra ba'i mkhas pa dang / thar 'dod rnam dpyod yangs pa'i skye bo rnams kyi blo yi rwa ba las yongs su brgal ba'i rlabs chen mdzad 'phrin rmad du byung ba rnams dang / 7rgyal mchog gong rim gyi thugs bskyed dang / bka' drin gyi zho shas 'tsho zhing / phyag btab mdzad pa'i/ sku gzhogs grwa tshang / rnam par rgyal ba'i phan bde legs bshad gling 'di nyid kyi lam thun mongs ba nas zung 'jug gi bar gyi mdo sngags kyi nyams bzhes rim pa khag dang / sgrig lam kun spyod/ 'char 'phar bstan srid kyi zhabs rim sogs/ srid zhu zhabs 'degs sgrub tshul sngon byung lo rgyus dang / lhag par rgya dmar kla blo'i dpung gis bod ljongs btsan bzung mnar gcod mi zad pa dang / rgyal bstan rin po che gtor bzhig rtsabarlags blo yul las 'das pa btang skabs/ phebs rjes su 'brang pa'i grwa tshang sku zhabs rnam pas 'phags yul du/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i gzigs skyong bka' slob 'og rgyun 'dzin nyam pa slar gse'i ched/ sku ngal khyad bsad gnang tshul dang / bshad sgrub zung 'brel gyi sgo nas/ sngar las lhag nga 'i 2

legs cha gong 'phel sogs/ dngos byung khag phyi rabs rnams kyis mkhyen rtogs slad/ gsal rjen yig thog tu 'khod pa zhig gal 'gang chen zhing /da lam grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi cho ga phyag len dang mdo sngags gzhung chen rnams la thos bsam slob gnyer mdzad de phyag 'khyer bzhes myong ba'i/ mkhyen rlabs mtshungs med blo bzang bsam gtan lags nas/ gong don brjod gzhir 'khod pa'i phyag deb rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling grwa tshang gi chos 'byung lo rgyus 'dod 'khro'i bum bzang zhes pa thugs khur bskyed de/ 'bri rtso ma ru nga zhib nan gsal 'god gnang 'dug pa shin tu legs po byung 'dug par snying nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu bcas/ grwa tshang mkhan ming 'dzin pa bya do sprul ming nas/2003 zla 4 tshes 28 la/

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/ don tshan dang po/thog mar grwa tshang phyag btab pa nas bzung thams cad mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang sku 'phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i sku dus bar gyi grwa tshang gi lo rgyus/gangs can lha gcig 'phags mchog phyag na padmo ngur sprig gar gyi rnam par rol pa thams cad mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang sku 'phreng rim byon rnams kyi thugs rje kho nas 'tsho ba'i thun mong ma yin pa'i sku'i gam bcar phan bde legs bshad gling grwa tshang ngam/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang zhes yongs su grags pa 'di bzhin thog ma'i phyag 'debs pa po ni / 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos thog mar phyag btab/ de mjug 7sku 'phreng gsum pa thams cad mkhyen pa bsod nams rgya mtshos shing khye phyi lo 1574 lor dpal ldan 'bras spungs gsang sngags pho brang du yongs grags phyag btab par mdzod/ thog ma'i rten 'brel gyi slad du 7rgyal dbang mchog gi rje bdag nyid chen po'i 'grel pa sgron gsal gyi bka' chos chos 1

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa chang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/thun gcig gnang / phan bde legs bshad gling grwa tshang zhes dgon ming du bstsal/ rjes su sku zhabs grwa tshang zhes kyang brjod srol yod 'dug skabs der grwa grangs ji yod gsung rnam khag nang gsal kha ma mjal/ skabs de'i grwa tshang gi zhu sgo ni/ gsang sngags rgyud sde rnams la thos bsam sgom sgrub zhu rgyu dang / dmigs bkar gangs ljongs skye 'gro'i bstan srid bde thabs ched du zhabs rim bsgrub rgyu/ lhag par 7rgyal ba'i chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo khag gi gsung zhabs zhu rgyu bcas yin 'dug de rjes lcags lug lo mtshams su/ sog po'i a than rgyal po'i sku tshe bsrings thabs su grwa tshang du gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i cho ga 'dzugs par mdzad pas/ rnam rgyal grwa tshang zhes dgon ming du 'jags/ me glang lo gsar rjes 7rgyal dbang mchog gis/ phan bde legs bshad gling pa rnams la slar yang bca' yig cig gnang zhes gsung rnam rin po che'i nang gsal bas/ de'i gong du'ang bca' yig cig gnang tshod la/ bca' yig snga phyi gnyis kyi brjod bya ji yod gsung rnam dang ngag rgyun gang du mi snang / 7rgyal dbang mchog 'bras spungs su bzhugs pa'i nub gcig mnal lam du bstan 'gro'i bde skyed kyi slad du dpal mgon zhal bzhi pa bsten gnang dgos pa'i thun mong snang ngor mtshan ma byung ba gsung rnam nang gsal ba bzhin/ de'i rjes nas lo ltar bod zla 3 tshes 82

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/nam yin la dpal mgon gur/ zhal/ lcam sring bcas kyi dus gtor 'dzugs par mdzod/ de nas bzung brgyad gtor chen mo zhes sngar srol ma nyams par lo ltar tshugs mus yin/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum la sogs pa'i yi dam khag gi sgrub mchod lta ra chags su btsugs tshul gsal kha mi 'dug kyang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum so se'i bdag 'jug bzhes sgrol yod 'dug 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bzhi pa thams cad mkhyen pa yon tan rgya mtsho'i sku dus sngar yod cho ga phyag len khag mi nyams rgyun 'dzin zhu rgyu dang / 7rgyal ba'i chos phyogs kyi mdzad pa khag gi gsung zhabs zhu rgyu las/ dmigs bsal cho ga phyag len 'phar 'dzugs mdzod yod skor gsung rnam dang ngag rgyun du mi snang / rang cag bod 'bangs skye 'gro yongs la bka' drin gyi bdag nyid ris med bstan 'dzin kun gyi gtsug nor7rgyal mchog sku phreng lnga pa chen po rje btsun ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sku dus su grwa tshang du cho ga phyag len gsar 'dzugs bka' drin bskyangs pa'i mdzad pa khag dang /7rgyal ba'i chos srid mdzad pa rgya mtsho lta bu las/ grwa tshang dang 'brel ba'i mdzad pa chu thig tsam bkod par/ 7rgyal dbang mchog shing pho bya'i lo gsar gyi dpal ldan lha mo'i tshes gtor gyi gsol tshogs su tshogs dbur thog mar chibs sgyur bskyangs/ sngar gur mgon lcam gsum ma'i gtor 3

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/chog 'phags pa rin po che'i mdzad pa de grwa tshang la btsugs yod kyang / cung zad bsdus skyedan du gzigs te thams cad mkhyen pa bserdzod nams rgya mtshos thugs brtsams lha brgyad ma'i bskang ba de 'dzugs par gnang / grwa tshang gi grwa grangs bcad la 'jam dpal dmar po'i sgrub pa zhig kyang 'dzugs gnang mdzad/ 7rgyal dbang sku phreng gsum pa bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sku dus kyi bskangs gse'i gdangs dbyangs rnams rim gyis 'chal 'dug par7rgyal dgang mchog gis thugs 'khur che bzhes 'og dbu mdzad blobazang bstan 'dzin dang / blo bzang yon tan gnyis kyis dbu mdzod don grub bkra shis la zhib tu dpyad pas nyams pa gsos/ 7rgyal dbang mchog nas grwa tshang gi dbu mdzad du blo bzang yon tan bsko gzhag dang / me'i spu gri dang / bskor sang nyi ma khros kyi sgrub pa btsugs/ grwa tshang gi grwa pa rnams dang / gzhan yang don gnyer can slob ma rnams la 'khrul 'a31ra khams gsum rnam rgyal gyi steng nas 'jigs byed 'phrin las bzhi'i phyag len zhib par khrid/ grwa tshang gi grwa pa nyung shas shig la/ drug cu ma'i phyag len rnams khrid par gnang /hor zla 8 pa'i tshes 1 nyin dmag zor ma'i mdos bskangs gsar btsugs dang 'brel tshogs dbur chibs sgyur bskyangs/ tshes 7 nas nyin bdun gyi ring 'byung po mi bsrun pa ar la gtad pa'i sgrub pa btsugs pas/4

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/lha 'dre ma rungs pa'i tsha ngar chag pa'i mtshan malegs pa byung tshul bka' phebs/yang de rjes tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur thog nyin bdun gyi ring phur sgrab dang /༄mdos bskangs sbrags ma tshugs pa'i nyin gsum par 'brub 'cham dang bcas gdab las kyi sgo nas dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag tshogs su rol ba'i mchod pa phul/ de nub 7rgyal dbang mchog gi mtshan lam du srid gsum bdag mo lha ngo cung zad dma' ba'i mtshan ma byung bas/ lha ngo bstod phyir mnga' gsol bsam pa lhun grub ma ljags rtsom mdzad de tshogs su gsung bas thugs bzhed lhun gyis grub/ tshes 15 nas hor zla 10 tshes da bar grwa tshang 'dus mang rnams la bka' brgyad bde 'dus kyi dbang chen dang / thugs sgrub drag po rtsal gyi rgyun pa sgrub pa sde brgyad 'bring po sgrub pa sde drug gi dbang /tshe dpag med 'chi med 'od snang / thugs rje chen po 'gro ba kun sgrol byang gter phur pa 'bring po drag sngags sam lcags mkhar mar grags pa gsar ban phyogs med kyi gter ma 'jam dpal rdzogs chen/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag 'char ka sgrom bu ma/ 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang / gzhan yang chos skyong khag gi rjes gnang / ja mchod le tshan sogs kyi zhal 'don phal cher gyi ljags lung sogs sngags gsar rnying gi dbang lung mang du gnang /mjug tu grwa tshang nas 7rgyal dbang mchog bstan 'gro'i mgon du 7zhabs 5

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/pad bskal brgyar brtan phyir 'chi med 'od snang gi dul tshon dkyil sabor dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs 'bul lam zhus/ dbus gtsang stod smad kun tu sad 'da' bsdoms shing grwa tshang sku zhabs grangs bcas kyis zla ba gnyis la rdzas sngags ting nge 'dzin la brten pa'i sad srung gi srol btsugs par gnang /lha ldan ra sa gtsug lag khang du 7rgyal dbang mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur thog dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor mtshan ma rdzas kyi phur pa la brten nas rab tu gnas par mdzad/ 'jam dpal tshe bdag gi chog bsgrigs dang / phyag len rnams kyang grwa tshang du btsugs/ gzhan yang sgrig lam skor la slob ston yang yang gnang ba dang / 'cham dbyangs kyi phyag ris gsar bris gnang / lcags bya 'isnar 'cham dang / gtor rgyag sogs thams cad la thugs zhib rgyas par mdzad/ grwa tshang nas 'chi med 'od snang gi cho ga dang 'brel dga' ldan pho brang ba chen po'i bstan pa chab srid skye 'gro'i bde thabs dang bcas pa'i mgon du zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan phyir brtan bzhugs gzab phul bskyangs par zhal bzhes legs par thob/ phyi 'itshe 1645hor zla gsum pa'i nyer lngar/ 7gong sa mchod yon rnam gnyis nas sngar bod rje srong btsan sgam pos pho brang dmar po bzhengs pa'i shul der/ bstan 'gro spyi dang lhag par gangs can pa'i bsod nams kyi zhing du phobrang zhig bzhengs 6

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/rgyu'i dkresangs pa dang bcas/ sa bkra gtan 'bebs mdzad/ tshes 28nyin zur chen chos dbyengs rang grol gyis phyag bstar gyi ltophyo'i thig dang / sngon rtse( rgyan sangs rgyas gnyis pas rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor du lha 'dre rnams dam la btags nas bsam yas mi 'gyur lhun gyi grub pa'i gtsug lag khang bgegs med grub pa'i rten 'brel gyi che ba dang / pod 'dir slob dpon chen po dang / sgrub pa bka' spyi bye brag rnams byin rlabs kyi tshan kha che bas byang gter phur ba lha nag gi dkyil 'khor zhal phye ste sgrub pa btsugs/ pho brang lteb bzhengs sa'i sa yul du mkhyen brtsechen po'i phyag bze'i phur cha yongs rdzogs gdan drangs/ grwa tshang nas dpal chen khrag 'thung khro bo'i stangs stabs kyis sa 'dul bar mdzad/ de rjes nges pa don gyi bdag nyid chen po sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos pho brang dmar po rten dang brten pa bcas pa lo 'khor bzhi bcu zhe gsum gyi nang khongs su legs par grub pa'i gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang pho brang chen po po ta la zhes deng skabs yar thon can gyi 'dzam gling 'di'i nang na'ang snyan par grags pa 'di bzhengs/ rtse pho brang gi skor la ⑩spyi nor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i mdzad rnam/ ngos kyi yul dang ngos kyi mi mang zhes pa'i nang / po ta la de ni yangs shing rgya che ba zhig yod pas 'dzam gling nang gi khang pa che shos yin par brjod kyi yod skad 'dug7

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/de ni lo 1300 sngon bod kyi rgyal po srong btsan sgam pos sgom sgrub gnang yul bzhengs par ye shu'i dus rabs bcu bdun pa'i nang la ta la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pas rgya bskyed gnang ba red/ de'i dkyil du thog brtsegs bcu gsum tsam yod pa de rnams khong gi bka' dang bstun te bzhengs shing / thog brtsegs gnyis tsam sleb skabs/ sku tshe'i 'du byed dus la babs pa mkhyen te/ khong gi sde srid la 7rgyal dbang rang nyid med pa gzhan nas shes tshe bzhengs bskrun gyi las gar sad rkyen byed rgyur re zhig gsang ba bya dgos gsungs pa ltar/sde srid nas 7rgyal dbang mchog dang 'dra ba'i dge 'dun pa zhig btsal te lo bco lnga'i ring gsang ba byas shing / khong gi yang srid myur byon ched rtsig rdo zhig gi steng du/ mkhyen brtsebadag nyid rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /dpal ldan mkhas btsun bzang po'i zlos gar gyi/ /rnam rol mchog gi sprul sku yid bzhin nor/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i dpal du myur byon shog /ces smon lam bris bkod byas pa ste/ deng sang yang thog brtsegs gnyis pa'i thad mjal rgyu yod/ po ta la'i dbus su tshogs khang dang /mdzad sgo tshugs sa rgya che la/ gzhan yang lha khang sum cu so lnga tsam yod pa de tshe'i bkod dang tshon ris sogs ha cang mdzes shing brjid chags po yod/po ta la'i nub ngos rnams rjes su rgya bskyed byas pa ste/ de'i skabs grwa pa 8

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/brgya dang bdun cudon gtsam yod ces dang / yang po ta la'i nang gtan bzhugs dge 'dun pa rnams 7rgyal ba'i chos kyi mdzad sgo tshang mar gsung zhabs kyis las 'gan yod pa zhig yin/ zhes gsungs pa ltar po ta la'i nub ngos su sku zhabs rnams kyi bzhugs shag dang / 'du khang sdurdzogs shin tu rgya khyedan che la/ phyi'i mardzas bzo dang / nang gi bkod pa phun sum tshogs po yod/pho brang dmar po rten dang brten pa bcas pa legs grub mtshams/ 'bras spungs gsang sngags pho brang nas rtsepho brang po ta lar grwa tshang spo bzhugs mdzad/de'i skabs sku zhabs zhal grangs brgya dang brgyad cu skor yod 'dug cing / de dag gi khongs nas mchod dpon ngag dbang shes rab dang / dbu mdzad blo bzang bstan 'dzin/ gnyer pa blo bzang sbyin pa la sogs pa rnams nas gangs ljongs chos srid kyi zhabs zhu legs grub byung skor/ rgyal rabs khag nang du gsal bas 'dir ma spros/ 7rgyal dbang sku phreng drug pa thams cad mkhyen pa blo bzang rin chen tshangs dbyangs rgya mtsho'i sku tshe stod la sngar 7rgyal dbang gong ma rnams nas bstan srid skye 'gro'i bde thabs su dgongs te btsugs pa'i mthong ba brgyud pa'i cho ga phyag len rnams sngar yod thog 7rgyal dbang mchog gi gsung rnam nang / ngas kyang rnam rgyal grwa tshang la dge lugs kyi sa gar 'dzugs rtsis byas te/ dge lugs kyi sa gar shes mkhan btsal kyang 9

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/rtsad ma chod/ zhwa lu nas rgyun byas te bu lugs kyi sa gar zhig 'dzugs rtsis yin zhes gsal bas/ sngar med gsar 'dzugs bskyangs rgyu'i dbesnangs bzhed bla na med pa gnang rung / bod 'bangs bsod nams dman pa'i stabs kyis/ me khye phyi lo 1706 zla 5 tshes 1 nyin 7rgyal dbang mchog sku phreng lnga pa chen po'i yang srid min tshul skyon brjod zhus te khri las phab/ lha bzang khang gis bod ljongs la dbang du bsgyur/ lha bzang khang nas lcags po rir bzhugs pa'i bla ma zhig 7rgyal dbang sku phreng drug pa yin tshul gyis po ta lar gdan drangs shing / 7rgyal ba'i bzhugs khrir bzhag pad dkar 'chang pa ngag dbang ye shes rgya mtsho zhes mtshan gsol/ lha bzang 'khor bcas nas bod ljongs su dbang bsgyur pa'i skabs shig tu o rod 'jun sgar ba'i dmag gis bod nang btsan 'dzul byas mthar/ phyi 'itshe 1717 zla 11 tshes 12 nyin 'jun sgar ba'i dmag lha sar lhags te mthar lha bzang bkrongs/ pad dkar 'dzin pa ye shes rgya mtsho khri las phab ri bo dge ldan pa'i bstan pa la dad gus yod tshul gyis rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i bstan pa las gzhan med ces dril bsgrags/ mthar gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos brgyud 'dzin pa'i bla sprul khag dang / dgon sde mang po rtsagator du btang ba'i gras su grwa tshang rin po che yang gong du 'khod pa ltar 7rgyal mchog sku phreng 10

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/lnga pa chen po'i sku dus su gangs ljongs bstan srid bde thabs kho nar dmigs te sngags gsar rnying ma'i cho ga 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa ma zad/ grwa tshang rin po 'di nyid ris med kyi nyams bzhes gnang bar brten/ phyi lo 1717zla 11 tshes 16 nyin 'jun sgar ji sang gis dpon dmag brgya skor 'khrid de/ po ta lar phyin nas grwa tshang gi sku zhabs tshang ma lha sa'i skyed chu'i khar 'khrid nas na bza' grwa chas rnams bshus/ skya chas gasku1gas te sdurdzo setsware pha ma'i khyim dang / de min so so'i lung par btang / yang ngag rgyun du skabs der dge 'dun pa khag cig gzhung ko brgyud skyid chur bskyur ba'i mthar chu shur chu 'gram nas thon te/ der 'dus pa'i dgon sde zhig chags pa'i dgon ming du/ chu shur thar pa gling zhes brjod srol yod 'dug kyang / lo rgyus khag gi nang 'jun sgar bas rtogator btang ba'i dgon sde'i gras su chu shur thar pa gling yang 'dug par brten yin tshod mi snang / de rjes pho lha ba bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis bod dbang bsgyur ba'i dus su'ang / nga lum sbyar gsum dang / skyetsher lung bla ma sogs khyim mi grangs 19 dus gcig la srog thog btang ba'i gras su grwa tshang gi gnyer pa'ang yod 'dug par brten dus skabs de'i skabs grwa tshang rin po che nyams chag chen po byung 'dug 'on kyang deng skabs dang mi 'dra ba'i gnas tshul zhig ni/ rten gtso khag dang /11

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/ rin thang bral ba'i mchod chas la sogs par de tsam gyi nyams gtor 'thor gsum byung tshod mi snang / de rjes 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa thams cad mkhyen pa bskal bzang rgya mtshos slar yang grwa tshang slar gso bskyangs pa/ ri bo dge lugs pa'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yi dam bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang grwa tshang 'di nyid kyai thun mong ma yin pa'i yi dam bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub pa btsugs tshul rnams brjod par bya ste/ de yang 7rgyal dbang sku 'khor mtsho sngon du bzhugs skabs/ 7rgyal ba'i thugs dgongs bzhin rgyal yab mchog nas thugs khur che bzhes kyis/zla 8 tshes 20 gza' skar phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin/ rtse nas grwa tshang gi grwa pa bros byol du 'byor pa rnams dang gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum dang / rgyud grwa gnyis nas rim 'byor grwa rigs khag de min phyogs mtha' nas dad pas lhags pa'i dge 'dun bsdus nas grwa tshang skyar 'dzugs gnang /7rgya la dbang mchog gis rnam rgyal grwa tshang zhes slar yang dgon ming du stsal/hor zla 12 tshes 29 la bstan srid spyi rim du dmigs gtor bzlog mdzad par rtags mtshan legs po byung / gzhan yang gangs ljongs skye 'gre'i bde thabs ched du dmigs te zhabs rim rgya che mdzad pa khag 7rgyal ba'i gsung rnam nang gsal bas 'dir ma spros/ me pho sprel gnam lo gsar 12

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/tshes nyin snga dro 7rgyal dbang mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur thog 'dus dmangs dang lhan du dpal ldan lha mor tshes gtor gzab phul bskyangs rjes gzim chung du shis par brjod pa'i me tog gi char phabs/ de nyin gnam mkha' dwangs shing rten 'brel legs pas/ 7rgyal dbang mchog nas/ de ring pho brang chen po po ta la dran pa zhig byung zhes bka' phebs/ shing yos phyi lo 1735 zla 7 tshes 11 nyin 7rgyal dbang sku 'khor gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang po ta lar chibs bsgyur gnang thog 7rgyal dbang mchog rje gong ma na rim gyi chos srid kyi mdzad sgo gal che khag gnang yul tshoms chen rnying pa'i nang du mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang thon por zhabs sor gcod/ lo ngo bco brgyad tsam rtsa'athor phyin pa'i grwa tshang de'ang / po ta lar sngar bzhin bzhugs chog pa byung / grwa tshang nas 7rgyal dbang mchog la/ gtsug tor rnam par rgyal ma'i cho ga dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs phul/ tshes 14 nyin dpal gyi lha mo'i gzab gsol rgyas pa tshugs pa'i tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyangs/ 7rgyal dbang mchog gis grwa tshang gi sgrig lam kun spyod dang rgyud sde'i phyag len mtha' dag ri bo dga' ldan pa'i rig sngags 'dzin pa rnams kyi nang na rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par 'phags pa dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi phyag bzhes 13

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'ordzo rgyus/ji lta ba bzhin byung na legs par dgongs te/ rgyud smad grwa tshang nas rdo rje slob dpon du 'os pa dge ba'i bzhes gnyen dwags grwa rab 'byams pa blo bzang tshul khrims dang / dbu mdzad du 'os pa sngags ram pa blo bzang bkra shis/dge skos su dwags grwa rab 'byams pa 'phyongs rgyas chos grags zla ba rbertegs dang / gzhan yang ser 'bras dga' gsum nas dge ba'i bzhes gnyen mtshan nyid dang ldan pa du ma 'dus te khyon dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya phrag skor byung zhing / cho ga phyag len dang / sgrig lam sogs dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang ji ltab bzhin la skabs thob 'dor len cung zad gnang ste bca' yig bka' rtsom dang 'brel da nas dge 'dun gyi nang khrims 'dir 'khod pa ltar dgos pa'i bka' slob stsal/ rgyud smad kyi phyag bzhes ltar bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod gsar 'dzugs mdzad/ hor zla 11 tshes 23 nyin 7rgyal dbang mchog bstan 'gro'i don du mdo stod smad khul du bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya cher legs grub kyis pho brang chen po po ta lar zhabs sor bde bar che 'khod pa dang grwa tshang nas bstan 'gro'i mgon du sku tshe zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan phyir mdo lugs dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs 'bul/de mo sprul sku rin po che dang / grwa tshang gi dus 'khor chog grwa ba/ ri po bde chen gyi chog grwa ba la sogs pa nas rgyud sde gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra 14

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/ba'i bcom ldan 'das dang po sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen ji ltar gaskulal ba btab pa bzhin 7rgyal dbang mchog nas rgyud nas gsungs pa ltar gyi slob ma rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga nas bzung / mjug rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa mtha' dag rgyud kyi rgyal po chen po'i 'grel chen dri ma med pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa rgya bod kyi mkhas pa rnams kyis 'grel pa'i srol mang du gnas pa la dus kyi 'khor lo'i bstan pa la rgyal po zla ba bzang po ltar bsngags par mdzad pa bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang /rje tsong kha pa chen po rnam gnyis kyi bzhed srol thun mong ma yin pa de nyid/ thugs kyi sras mchog mkhas grub dge legs dpal bzang po'i rgyud kyi 'grel chen dang / dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa legs par gtan la phab pa bzhin/ 'drod ma gsum gyi rnam par dag pa bshad pa phra zhing phra ba rnams zhi ba pa bka' drin bskyangs/ mjug tu 7rgyal ba rang nyid nas ljags rtsom mdzad pa'i dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub thabs mkhas grub zhal lung kyi ljags lung stsal/ de nas bzung chos 'di'i rgyun mi nyams par bya ba'i slad du dgongs te/ zur du sku zhabs sum cu skor la cho ga khag legs par blo 'dzin byed du 'jug pa gnang ste/ zla ba byung ngo cog gi yar ngo'i tshes brgyad la dus 'khor bdag mdun bum sgrub sogs sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas bdag 'jug bzhes 15

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'ordzo rgyus/srol dang / lo ltar nag pa'i tshes bdun nas bzung nyin bdun ring dul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas sgrub mchod 'dzugs pa gnang / chog grwa bar dus kyi 'khor lo'i sa gar dang / mchod gar slob par zhwa lu nas slob dpon bzhi bka' 'gug gnang ste/ gar rnams bslab/ mjug tu 7rgyal dbang mchog nas dgyes pa chen pos gzigs zhib mdzad/ dus 'khor dbu mdzad dge slong skal bzang chos 'byor la sogs pas dus kyi 'khor lo'i tshogs mchod zhig bka' rtsom yong ba zhes sdi ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin /7rgyal dbang mchog gis tshogs mchod bde chen 'dod 'jo bka' rtsom mdzad/rgyud sde gzhan khag gi dkyil 'khor bri thig gsar slob bya dgos bka' slob phebs don bzhin sazhabs sum cuskor nas rtsegazim chung bka' gdams 'khyil du bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / rgyud sde che chung khag gi nang tshan/ tshe dpag med dang / mi 'khrugs pa/ thugs rje chen po sogs rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs/ 7rgyal dbang mchog nas re re bzhin gzigs rtogs dang 'brel/ dkyil 'khor so so'i thig rtsadang / tshig don gyi bzhad pa ngag thog nas rgyugs bzhes te/ slad nas kyang slob sbyong phul du phyin pa byas nas gsang sngags kyi bstan rgyun la phan pa byed dbesnas pa'i bslab bya zhal gdams stsal/ rtse blos bslang khang du sngar phan mchod 'bul rgyun 'dzugs 16

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/med tshod la/ 7rgyal dbang 'di'i sku dus nas bzung nyin ltar sku zhabs bzhi nas bde gsang 'jigs gsum re mos kyis bdag 'jug dang / brgya mchod/ yar ngo mar ngo'i tshes bcur tshogs mchod 'bul srol dang / de dag gi zhal 'don bka' bkod legs par gnang / mdor na 7rgyal dbang 'di'i sku dus nas yi dam gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang dus 'khor bcas bla med kyi cho ga dang / rgyud sde chung khag nang tshan/ tshe dpag med lha dgu dang rnam rgyal ma/ mi 'khrugs pa/ sman bla/ thugs rje chen po la sogs pa'i mthong ba brgyud pa'i cho ga phyag len mtha' dag gsar 'dzugs bka' drin che bar mdzad/ da yod gtor sgrub khag gi nang nas/ dgu gtor dang / brgyad gtor/ gzhan yang lo gsar tshes gtor bcas skyar gso mdzad/ dgu gtor gyi 'cham de dus nas yod 'dug 7rgyal dbang gang gi sku dus su btsugs pa gsal kha ma mjal/ de min da yod gtor sgrub khag rang re'i sku zhabs rnams kyi gsung rgyun la/ 7rgyal mchog sku phreng brgyad pa thams cad mkhyen pa 'jim dpal rgya mcho'i skabs gsar 'dzugs bskyangs pa'i skor 'dug na'ang / gsung rnam nang gsal kha ma mjal/ 'on kyang 7rgyal mchogabadun pa dang / brgyad pa gang rung gi sku dus su btsugs pa gdon mi za/ 7rgyal mchog dgu pa thams cad mkhyen pa lung rtogs rgya 17

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/mtsho dang / de bzhin sku phreng bcu pa thams cad mkhyen pa tshul khrims rgya mtsho/sku phreng bcu gcig pa thams cad mkhyen pa mkhas grub rgya ma'erdo/ sku phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho bcas kyi sku dus sngar mdzed cho ga phyag len khag las/ gsar 'dzugs mdzad rigs gsung rnam khag la mi gsal/ 'on kyang 7rgyal dbang de rnams kyi sku dus su gsung zhabs ji ltar zhus pa la sogs zhib pa 7rgyal dbang so so'i gsung rnam nang gsal bas 'dir ma spros/7rgyal dbang sku phreng bdun pa chen po'i sku dus nas bzung / phyi lo 1959zing 'khrug ma byung bar gyi bod du lo 'khor gcig gi nang 7rgyal ba'i gsung zhabs zhu rigs khag dang / gangs ljongs bstan srid bde thabs kyi ched yi dam khag gi sgrub mchod dang / bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po'i bstan srung dmar nag gnyis kyis dbus chos bsrung rnams kyi dus gtor/de min grwa tshang dang 'brel ba'i mdzad sgo khag gi skor 'og tu brjod rgyu/ de rjes 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po thams cad mkhyen pa thub bstan rgya mtsho dpal bzang po mchog gis gangs ljongs bstan srid skye 'gro'i bde thabs su dgongs te 7rgyal kun 'phrin las kyi rang gzugs dpal chen rdo rnge gzhon nu'i sgrub pa 'dzugs pa mdzod tshul dang / gang gi sku dus su grwa tshang dang 'brel ba'i mdzad pa mdo tsam brjod par bya ste/ de yang 7rgyal dbang 18

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/mchog dgung grangs nyer gcig tu phebs mtshams/ grwa tshang slob dpon blo bzang byang chub brtson 'grus nas ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ grwa tshang 'dus mang yongs la grwa tshang gi 'don chog cha tshang dang / sher phyin brgyad stong pa/ lam rim 'jam dpal zhal lung bcas kyi ljags lung nyin shas ring stsal/ mjug tu grwa tshang nas 7rgyal dbang mchog bstan 'gro'i mgon du sku tshe 7zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan phyir bcom ldan 'das sgrol dkar yid bzhin 'khor lo'i cho ga'i steng nas brtan bzhugs bstar 'bul/ gang ci'i legs tshogs su dmigs te/ rtse 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra'i spyan sngar sna lnga'i mchod pa stong phrag 'bul bzhams dang 'brel snga phyir rnam dkar dge tshogs rgya che bskrun par mdzad/ gter chen las rab gling pa 'phrin las mtha' yas rtsal mchog dang / 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa rnam gnyis ji ltar 'brel ba byung tshul dang / phur pa yang snying spu gri zhes pa'i chos gter thog mar gnas gang nas bzhes/ bar tu gter shog lgems ji ltar phab tshul bcas rgyas pa gter chen las rab gling pa'i gsung rnam du gsal bas 'dir ma spros so/ /gu ru'i bka' lung rdo rje'i tha tshig las/yang gcig mnga' bdag yab kyi gar dang / me byi lo pa dwags yul 'byung //de'ang bdud 'joms sprul pa dang / /thugs mthun rten 'brel ma log na/19

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/ /me byi lo pa'i rten skal mchog /rta phag bla rdo sogs dzag gter/ /nang rgyud gsum sogs chos kyi gter/ /ma nyams lag tu 'byor ba dang / /sgrub spel rten 'brel leg 'grigs tshe/ /rgyal rje khyad par bod khams kyi/ /bstan 'gro bde bar gnas pa dang / /dngos grub thob pa'i skal ldan mang / /zhes sogs snga phyi'i gter lung du ma nas gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje'i gsung gis yang yang bsngags pa'i chos gter gyi bdag po 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen por gter chos rnams phul ba dang / de rjes gangs ljongs bstan srid kyi slad du grwa tshang dang / gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling gnyis su sgrub pa btsugs tshul rnams gter ston rin po che'i gsang ba'i rnam par thar pa rmad byung ngo mtshar pudu dkar po'i 'phreng ba dad pa'i sabri shing byin rlabs spungs sdud pa'i ma dros dga' ba'i gru dbyangs nang gsal bas 'dir ma spros/ deng gi dus su'ang lo ltar bod zla 2 nang sgrub mchod tshugs mus/ phyi lo 1899 lo'i chos 'phrul smon lam chen mor gza' skar gyi sbyor 'phrod phun sum tshogs pa'i nyin 7rgyal dbang mchog 'phags bod gzhung lugs rab 'byams la gsan bsam mthar sdu na te bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas gdan sa chen po gsum la rim bzhin zhabs bcag dang 'brel blogasal rigs pa smra pa'i mkhas pa brgya phrag du ma'i dbus su lha rams dam bca' chen mo legs 20

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/par 'jog gnang mdzad par grwa tshang nas dga' ston rten 'brel gyi mdzad sgo gzab rgyas zhus/ dgung grangs nyer drug la phebs pa/ lcags glang zla 6 tshes 4 rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras pos bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor ba'i dus chen nyin/ grwa tshang tshogs yongs dang / dad ldan nyis stong skor la grub dbang dpal mo lugs kyi 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i dbang chen dang / mgon po phyag bzhi ba'i rjes gnang / cho ga'i ljags lung bcas stsol ba'i skabs gnas dga' gnyis kyang thog phebs kyis gtang rag mjal dar 'bul bzhes mdzad/ shing 'brug zla 6 tshes 15 phyi 'i1 1904 zla 7 tshes 30 nyin lha ldan nas rgya 31ga khul la chibs bsgyur bka' drin che skabs/ chibs zhabs gras su grwa tshang nas slob zur byams pa dngos grub can sogs sku zhabs kha shas sku bcar zhus/ 7tredzeng sa mchog dang / sku 'khor rgya sog tu bzhugs rgyun ring grwa tshang nas thugs mkho 'bul mi sku zhabs rim bcar zhus/ sa bya phyi 'itshe cho 1909 zla 11tshe sa 9 nyin 7gong sa mchog ston 'khor lha ldan du zhabs sor 'khod/grwa tshang nas bstan 'gro'i matredzen du sku tshe 7zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i slad du brtan bzhugs phul/ lcags khye phyi lo 1910 le'i dgung gsar nyin dang gnyis kyi mdzad sgo sngar rgyun ltar gnang yang / lu'u tsun 21

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/rgya dmag rnams lha sar 'byor nye'i sbir grags che khar/ lha ldan smon lam chen mo tshugs nye bcas kyi thal zing ji yong thugs blos ma bzod par tshes 4nyin snga dro sku ngal 'dzems med kyis 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po ston 'khor rnams chibs thon bskyangs dgos pa byung / gong bzhin grwa tshang nas chibs zhabs su slob zur byams pa dngos grub sogs sku bcar zhus/ mtha' rdo leb la brgyud phebs te 7gong sa chen po mchog ston 'khor rnams ka sbug 'brug pa ka ji 6( rgyan rdo rje'i gzim shag tu sku bzhugs mdzad/ khyon rgya gar du lo ngo gsum tsam bzhugs rjes bden mtha' gsal te/ chu byi zla 12tshes 16 nyin gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang pho brang chen po po ta la'i mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por zhabs kyi padmo rnam par 'khod/ 7rgyal dbang mchog nas gangs ljongs skye 'gro'i bde thabs kho nar dgongs te gang la gang 'dul gyi mdzad byus bzang po sog po phyi nang sogs brgyud rgya nag dang / de rjes rgya gar du gong du 'khod pa bzhin zhabs kyis bcag phyogs gcig nas zhi ba'i lam nas bden pa dag skyel dang / phyogs gnyis nas go skabs dang bstun te rang stobs drag shugs kyis bod nas man ju'i dpon dmag ming med mthar sgrod dang 'brel/ bod rang btsan rgyal khab yin pa sku ngas bsgrags mdzad/ gzhan yang blo ga 'phrul 22

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi ched rgyus/dang / dpal 'byor/ slob grwa/ zhi drag gi 'dzugs skrun sogs gnas dus dang mthun pa'i rgyal thabs 'phrin las kyi mdzad bzang rlabs po che bskyangs pa khag dang / bod rgyal lo 2059 chu sprel phyi lo 1932 lor ma 'ongs gsal gzigs kyi zhal gdams lhug stsal khag khungs ldan rgyal rabs lo rgyus su gsal bar brten 'dir ma bris/ grwa tshang slob zur byams pa dngos grub nas rgya sog 'phags yul bcas su phyogs phebs kyi chibs zhabs dang /rnam kun gsung chog gi sri zhu bcas dgongs ldan byung ba'i gzigs gsol mkhan chen gyi go ming dang / spyi 'gre'i thab rten thog bstan gling gzhung chod khongs stag rtse nor khang gzhis nam 'tsho'i ring kha 'dzin du stsal/ gzim chung rtag brtan dge 'phel khang bzang du 7gong sa mchog gis dbus gsung zhabs sum cu skor nas bstan 'gro'i bde thabs ched ma mo'i 'khrugs skong grangs gsog gi gsung chog gnad smin bskyangs/ bod rgyal lo 2043me 'brug zla 10 tshes 29 phyi med 1916 nas sa lug 2045 phyi lo 1919 zla 8 tshes 14 bar bstan don gal che'i slad don du bcom ldan 'das 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i gzhi bsnyen chen mor bzhugs rgyun ring / gsung chog zhabs zhu sgrub khang sprul sku blo bzang ngag dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dpal bzang po mchog dang / grwa tshang dus 'khor slob dpon byams 23

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/pa mthu stobs can nas 7rgyal ba'i dgongs bzhed ltar zhabs 'degs zhus/grwatshang grwa khang nang mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyas kyis bzhengs pa'i 'jigs byed dpa' gcig gi sku brnyan de'i gzungs gzhug la skyon yod tshul zhu mi med par nang gzhug brje dkresas gsungs par sku zhabs bgres gras 'ga' nas chag grum 'gro lugs zhus par/ ma gsan par gzungs gzhug phyir 'don skabs mi dbang rang gi bsod nams dbang thang rigs rgyud sogs 'phel ba dang / gzhan phyogs 'ga' zhig gi tshe bsod stobs 'byor rigs rgyud sogs nyams par 'gyur ba'i 'dod gsol dang / zhabs gnon 'phar ma sogs rang 'dod chags sdang mi bzad pa sbyar ba'i gzungs ngan sna tshogs thon pa brje bsgyur zhus/ grwa tshang slob dpon ngag dbang tshul khrims nas gsol ba btab ngor 'a dus tshogs su/ mgon chos gnyis/ lha mo/ rnam sras bzhi'i rjes gnang stsal/ zla ba gsum par sa bcud bum sgrub thog mtha' bar gsum dang / mgon po mchog nas bstan 'gro'i don du ma 'ongs mngon gzigs kyis dus gcor la mthong chen po mdzad de dkyil lwabor gyi stegs bu dang mchod stegs sogs rgya rtsican spus legs gsar bzo dang / ras bris kyi dpal ldan 'bras spungs kyi zhing bkod bris thang che legs zhig bcas grwatshang la gsol ras stsal/ lo ltar sgrub mchod skabs gar gzigs/ sgrub mchod nyin 24

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus dang por nyin gang tshogs mgon du chibs bsgyu/ sgrub mchod grol nas dul tshon gshegs gsol gyi klu chog dmigs bsal nor gling pho brang du gnang srol yod/ thams cad mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos grwa tshang thog cho ga gsar 'dzugs bka' drin bskyangs pa'i skor dang / gang gi sku dus su grwa tshang nas gsung zhabs zhus pa bcas kyi skor mdo tsam lags so//don tshan gnyis pa'i nang gses dang po/thams cad mkhyen pa 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po mchog gi 1959 lo phan gyi chos srid kyai mdzad pa snying bsdus/'gro ba yongs la ma 'dris pa'i mdza' bshes chen po 'phags mchog snying rje'i rang gzugs ngur sgrig gar gyi rnam par rol pa lhar bcas srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 7rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po rje btsun 'jam dpal ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog gi thun slong ba dang thun mong ma yin pa'i chos srid kyi mdzad pa rgya che rnams mdzad rnam rin po che dang phyi nang mkhas pa mang pos mdzad pa'i 25

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'e1 rgyus/gsung rnam rin chen rnams su gsal bas 'dir grwa tshang dang 'brel yod mdzad sgo'i skor mdor bsdus su bkod par/ de yang 7skyabs mgon thugs rje'i bdag nyid gang nyid ni spyir skye 'gro yongs kyi mgon skyabs dang / lhag par rang cag gangs can pa skye 'gro mdzengs kyi gnas stangs gnyen 'phrang 'di kho nar gzigs te/ ma snga ma phyi bar 1935 bod shing phag zla 5 tshes 5 nyin mdo smad stag 'tsher du sku 'khrungs/ sngon nas rjes su dran pa'i mdzad pa las/ bod rgyal 'itshe 2065 sa 21sa phyi ches 1939 zla 10tshes 8 nyin chibs sgyur rgyas pa'i lam ltar lha ldan gtsug lag khang du gnas gzigs dang 'brel nor gling skal bzang pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/1939 zla 11 tshes 13 nyin lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso rdo bo shākya mu ni'i sku mdun du 7rgyal tshab srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che mchog nas dbu skra gtsug phud bzhes rte rje btsun 'jam dpal ngag dbang blo bzang ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho srid gsum dbang bsgyur mtshungs pa med pa'i sde dpal bzang po zhes mtshan gselal mdzad/bod rgyal 81 2067 stsags 'brug phyi 'itshe 1940 zla 1tshes 12 nyin chibs bsgyur rgyas pa'i lam ltar nor gling nas rtse pho brang po ta lar chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ tshes 14 gser khrir mnga' gselal 26

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi ches rgyus/nyin tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs kyi mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i gser gyi khri 'phang mthon por 7rgyal dbang mchog sprul rin po che zhabs sor 'khod pa dang lhan cig grwa tshang gsung zhabs pa rnams nas bkra shis pa'i shis brjod sngon du 'gro ba'i cho ga'i tshig rigs dang mthun par rin chen rgyan cha ba rnams nas/ rtags brgyad/ sna bdun bcas rim bzhin phul te zhabs brtan dang / bden tshig brjod/ skyabs mgon srid skyong rwa sgreng rin po che nas maṇḍal ljags bshad thog bod gzhung nas gser khrir mnga' gasdurdzol gyi rten 'bul phul ba bcas bkra shis dga' ston gyi mdzad sgo bskyangs/ bod rgyal lo 2069 chu rta phyi 'itshe 1942 zla 1 tshes 10 nyin 7tredzeng sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog lha ldan rdo bo shākya mu zhe'i spyan sngar srid skyong yongs 'dzin stag brag rin po che'i drung nas rab byung gi sdom bzhes mdzad/spyi nor 7tredzeng sa mchog dgung grangs bcu gnyis la phebs pa/ me khye phyi lo 1946 lor ji ltar sngon gnas mchog khyad par can wa ra ṇa sir/ston pa sangs rgyas bcon lda na 'das kyis 'khor lnga sde bzang po la sogs par chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi yang snying bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor bar mdzad pa de bzhin du/ gnas khyad par can gru 'dzin gnyis pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i gzim chung nyid 'od du/ ston pa bka' drin can 7rgyal kun 27

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edzi rgyus/snying rje'i rang gzugs spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gis/ gdul bya grwa tshang tshogs mang yongs la chos bzang po chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong gi yang snying shes rab snying po dang / 'jam dpal mtshan brjod la sogs pa'i ljags lung bka' drin stsal/ 'di ni spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gis thun mong snang ngor gdul bya mang tshogs la chos 'khor bskor ba dang po yin tshod snang / bod rgyal ches 20rkerke lcags stag zla 11 tshes na phyi 'i( 1950 zla 10 tshes 17 nyin spyi nor 7tredzeng sa mchog dgung grangs 16 las phebs myed kyang / bod ljongs lha mi yongs nas ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin lugs gnyis chab srid kyi thugs 'gan bdag gir bzhes/ de rjes 'dzam gling rgyal tshogs su bod don thog rgyab skyor yong ba'i snyan zhu phul gnang mdzad pa dang / rgya dmag bod sar btsan 'dzul byas pa rnams phyir 'then dgos lugs bka' yig bstsal skor gsung rnam rin po che dang / rgyal rabs 'edzi rgyus khag tu gsal ba bzhin thugs 'khur che bzhes mdzad mur/ bod sbyongs spyi tshogs nas rgya dmar gung bran tang gi bya spyod gang la gzhigs kyang yid rton 'pher ba gtan nas med gzhis sku phya'i nye srung dang bstan pa chab srid kyi slad du 7gong sa mchog re zhig gro mo tsam la chibs bsgyur gnang na legs tshul bsam sku1sa gcig mthun gyis spyi zhus tshig tho 'bul lam zhus pa ltar 28

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling si lo rgyus/7gong sa mchog ston 'khor/ lcags stag zla 11 tshes 11 phyi lo 1950 zla 12 tshes 19 nyin lha ldan rgyal sa nas ༷tshe 31ra chibs sgyur gnang / sku'i chibs zhabs kyi gras su sku bcar chos dpon mkhan po thub bstan bsod nams so gas sku bcar zhus/ 7gong sa mchog gro mor bzhugs rgyun ring chos srid mdzad pa rgya cher mdzad pa gsung rnam nang gsal bas 'dir ma spros/ lcags sku1sa zla 5 tshes 17 phyi 'itshe 1951 zla 7 tshes 20 nyin 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon che na po ston 'khor gro mo nas lha ldan rgyal sar chibs zhal bsgyur/ phebs lam khel ༷/la rgyal rtse sogs su dad ldan ser skya brgya phrag mang por bka' cho sa dang / bka' slob bstsal cing / grwa tshang gi sgang gzhis kha'i na gshongs su gsol tsha 'khel bar/ grwa tshang nas phebs sgrig gzab rgyas kyis dkar spro sgrig gzhoms sogs zhus par gsol cha gnang / de nas chibs bsgyur gyis bod zla 5 tshes 13 nyin nor gling pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ bod rgyal lo 2081phyi lo 1954 lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i tshes 15 nyin jo bo shākya mu zhe'i spyan sngar yongs 'dzin gling rin po che thub bstan lung rtogs rnam rgyal 'phrin las dpal bzang pos mkhan slob sbrags ma mdzad de spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas dge slong gi bslab gzhi sku(ngas su rdzogs pa legs par bzhes 29

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'orme rgyus/te rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi bdag por bzhengs/ lo de'i zla 5 tshes 11 nyin thabs mkhas kyi mdzad pas rgya nag tu phebs te pha rol po'i bsam phugs mthil phyin par gzigs shing / mdo stod smad khul la sogs pa'i dad ldan ser skya khri phrag mang por bka' chos dang / 'di phyi'i blang dor bka' slob bsam gyis mi khyab pa stsal/ sku'i chibs zhabs kyi gras su sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po thubs bstan bsod nams mchog dang / slob dpon thub bstan bde gshegs/ dbu mdzad thub bstan mchog ldan/ dus dbu thub bstan grags pa/ mchod gakrerdzog thub bstan snying po/ mchod g.yog las tshab thub bstan 'jam dbyangs/ gzim gasku ga thub bstan thabs mkhas/ gsung bzang byams pa skal bzang dang / thub bstan nam mkha'/ :rto bzang bstan pa/ dung pa 'phrin las tshe dbang dang / chos 'phel phun tshogs/ rgya gling ba rdo rje dang / 'jam dpal mkhas btsun bcas sku bcar zhus/ rgya nag tu lo 'khor gcig tsam bzhugs ring bstan pa chab srid kyi mdzad pa rgya che mdzad/ring min bod ljongs su chibs zhal bsgyur/ phebs lam du dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs chos dang zang zing gi sbyin pas tshims par mdzad/ shing lug zla 5 tshes 11 phyi 'dze 1955 zla 6 tshes 30 nyin lha ldan nor gling pho brang du chibs bsgyur rgyas pa'i lam bzhin chibs bsgyur bskyangs/30

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/de nas ring min/ rtse pho brang gi gzim chung nyi 'od du spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin gling sprul rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal snga nas bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen gsan bzhes bka' drin che skabs grwa tshang tshogs yongs lhan du sku bcar zhu rgyu'i go skabs bzang po stsal/ de mjug gzim chung nub brgyud dga' ldan yang tseru/ spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gis 'dus tshogs su lam rim myur lam dmar 'khrid dang / dga' ldan lha brgya ma/ blo rjeXng tshigs brgyad ma bcas kyi bshad 'khrid dang / sems bskyed rgyas pa stsal/ grwa tshang nas 7gong sa mchog bstan 'gro'i mgon dpung dam par sku tshe 7zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i brtan bzhugs phul/ yang nor gling spyan gsal pho brang du gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dbang chen dang /mjug tu nag po skor gsum gyi rjes gnang / gzim chung ngo mtshar dpal 'khyil du slar yang bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / thugs rje chen po'i dbang chen bcas bka' drin bskyangs/ lha klu'i lha lcam bsres mo nas ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ nor gling skal bzang pho brang du ser skya grangs las 'das pa la bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen thengs dang po bka' drin che skabs dus 'khor chog grwab rnams nas zhu sgo mtha' dag legs par grub/ bod rgyal le 2083 me sprel phyi lo 1956 lor bdag 31

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/cig ston pa shākya thub pa mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyis stong lnga brgya 'khor bar rgya gar dbus gzhung dang / byang chub chen po'i chos tshogs nas spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog dus dran gyi mdzad sgor gdan zhu zhus pa dang /gzhan yang chos srid kyi dgongs gzhi dgos pa rgya che'i slad 7gong sa mchog ston 'khor rgya gar la chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyangs/ sku'i chibs zhabs kyi gras su sku bcar mchod dpon thub bstan bsod nams mchog dang / slob dpon thub bstan bde gshegs/ dbu mdzad thub bstan mchog ldan/ dus dbu thub bstan grags pa/ mchod g.yog thub bstan 'jam dbyangs/ gzim gasku1ga thub bstan thabs mkhas/ gsung bzang / 〉rto bzang dga' ba/ byams pa skal bzang / ngag dbang mkhyen rab/ rin chen chos 'byor/ dung ba lha dbang dang / byams pa yon tan/ rgya gling ba/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang /blo bzang rnam rgyal bcas sku bcar zhus/ rgya gar du phebs rjes gtso che bod kyi bde sdug gnas stangs ngo spyod zhib lhongs mdzad cing / 'phags yul gyi shes ldan mang po'i snying du 'phags bod mdza' gcugs kyi 'brel ba skyar gso gong 'phel mdzad thog gnas mchog rdo rje gdan gyi dbus rgya gar gnas chen khag la gnas gzigs mchod 'bul dang / rab gnas/ gsung chos bcas kyi skabs su gsung zhabs legs 'grub zhus/ de nas rgya gar 32

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/khul gyi mdzad sgo grub ste/ bod ljongs su chibs zhal bsgyur ba'i tshur la ma ka sbug dang / sgang tog gro phag gzhis rtse/ bkras lhun bla dgon/ zha lu dgon/ snang thar/ shang dga' chos bde chen chos 'khor/ gser tog can/ 'od yug yangs pa can/ stod lung slar bcas la rim pas chibs bsgyur gyis skal ldan gdul bya ser skya'i tshogs la gsung chos dang /gnas mchog dbe|na sde khag la gnas gzigs mchod 'bul bcas la gsung zhabs zhu sgo legs par zhus/ gzhung dang mi dmangs bcas nas phebs bsu rim pa dang bcas/ me bya phyi lo 1957 zla 2 tshes 1 nyin chibs bsgyur rgyas pa'i lam bzhin nor gling pho brang du zhabs sor 'khod/ lode lha sa khul sdod mdo smad chu bzhi sgang drug gi tshong rigs 'byor ldan rnams nas bskul slong byas thog chol kha gsum gyi ser skya mi mang rnams nas rang gi 'byor 'khos la gzhigs pa'i blos blangs zhal 'debs phul te/ 7gong sa mchog sku tshe 7zhabs pad skal brgyar brtan pa dang / mdzad 'phrin yar zla ltar 'phel ba sogs rtags rten dgos pa du ma'i slad du rin thang bral ba'i phra rgyan du mas spras pa'i gse/ra khri dang / khri lcog rang 'grigs phul ba dang chabs cig bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor le'i dbang chen ji ltar gsol ba btab pa bzhin/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen thengs gnyis pa bka' drin 33

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bskyangs skabs gong bzhin dus 'khor chog grwa ba rnams nas gsung zhabs legs 'grub zhus/ spyi nor 7gong sa mchog dgung grangs nyer bzhir phebs pa/ sa khye phyi lo 1958 lor gdan sa chen po se 'bras gnyisal grwa skor mtshan rtags kyi dam bca' chen mo dang / dga' ldan du chos zhugs dang grwa skor chabs cig bskyangs slad rim bzhin sngar lam chibs bsgyur rgyas pa'i lam ltar chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ gsung zhabs su sku zhabs gang mang dang / 'bras spungs su tshogs yongs sku bcar zhus/ gdan sa so so'i mkhas pa'i yang rtserigs pa smra ba stong phrag 'ga' shas 'du 'dzoms kyi dbus su 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog dam bcar sku bzhugs gnang par mkhan po las zur rnams dang / phyi lo'i lha rams grwa skor ba sogs nas bka' pod lnga'i rtsa'agrel gzhung don dang mthun pa'i brgal rtags rigs lam rtags gsal phul bar/ 7gong sa mchog nas 7rgyal ba'i gsung rab drang nges kyi dgongs don dang mi 'gal zhing / grub mtha' so so'i bzhed tshul tha dad pa legs par phyi ste/ rang lugs kyi 'dzin mtshams ma 'phyugs pa'i gsung lan thogs med du gnang / de rjes gdan sa'i mkhan po bgres pa gnyis re dam bcar 'khod pa la spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas lung rigs 'thad ldan gyi lam nas drangs pa'i brgal brtags gnang ste/ zab yangs 3 4

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/mkhyen rab kyi rol mtsho las rmad byung legs bshad kyi rlabs 'phreng ci yang spros pas kun kyang dga' dad gus pa 'gran pa bzhin du gyur/ dgung grangs nyer lngar phebs pa/ sa phag phyi lo 1959 lor lha ldan cho 'phrul smon lam chen mor lung rigs smra ba'i bka' rams dge ba'i bshes gnyen khri phrag brgal ba'i dbus su lha rams dam bca' chen mor gang nas bgro gleng byung pa de dang de'i gzhung gi zab don phra rags ji bzhin gtan la phabs pa'i gsung lan legs par stsal te mkhas pa rnams yid dbang 'phrog pa dang / blo ldan don gnyer can rnams phul byung legs bshad kyis tshim par mdzad de bstan pa'i mig rgyan du gyur pa'i mdzad bzang bskyangs nas/ nges pa don gyi thub bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag chen por bzhengs par mdzod do//don tshan gnyis pa'i nang gses gnyis pa/bod du thog mar grwa tshang la sgrigs zhugs byed stangs dang de'i skabs kyi grwa grangs ji yod/bod du grwa tshang la grwa grangs ji yod dang / thog mar grwa tshang du sgrig zhugs byed stangs skor 7rgyal mchog sku phreng lnga pa chen po'i sku dus grwa grangs 35

rnam nga ra rgyar ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/brgya dang brgyad cu yod 'dug de rjes 7rgyal mchog bdun pa chen po'i sku dus nas bzung gsung rgyun la gzhung zhabs sri zhu ba rtse drung brgya dang bdun cu don lnga dang / de bzhin shod drung brgya dang bdun cu don lnga / rnam grwa brgya dang bdun cu don lnga / yin tshul brjod rung / phyis su gzhung zhabs rje mang du song / grwa tshang du spyi nor 7gong sa mchog dbus dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya dang bdun cu don lnga yod cing / 7gong sa mchog gong du phud/ de 'og sku bcar chos dpon mkhan po mchog dang / dbu chos gsum zhes/ slob dpon dbu mdzad/ dge skos/ sde phyag gsum/ bgres song gnyis/ spyi pa bcas grwa tshang lhan rgyas dang / ja tshul dang / zhal ta ba chab ril gsum las sne chung khag sbug khongs la bgres song gi phyag rogs dngul gnyer gnyis/ sde zur yod tshe grwa tshang gi las sne khongs su zhugs chog sku'i gzim gasku1ga dang / mchod gasku(ga gnyis/ mchod pa khang dkon gnyer gcig nor bu gling khar gzim chung dkon gnyer gsum/ rtse grwa tshang steng shod du dgon gnyer gnyis/ lha sa rje 'bum khang du dkon gnyer gciga'akhrungs lhar matredzen po pa gcig dang / gtan 'jags gcig klu sdings su mgon po ba gcig rdzong rgyab klu khang du bkon gnyer gcig rtse phan bde lha khang du mgon po pa gcig 'bras spungs sgo khra lha mo khang du rgyun bskangs 36

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus /gsung mi bzhi dang / phyag bde ba gcig bcas sku zhabs sum cu so drug dang /de min las kyi sne mo ba dang / gsung bzang / mchod bzhengs/ dung rgya/phyag bde bcas khyon gong 'khod ltar brgya dang bdun cu don lnga yod/ 'don cha khag gi rgyugs 'bul zhu srol ni/ rgyugs thengs dang por 'tshang rgyugs zhes par/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bdag bskyed thog bskangs gso'i khongs nas mgon po chos rgyal/ lha mo/ zhal bzhi pa bcas blo 'dzin gyis thog mar bgres song la rgyugs phul/ 'di ni gzim chung 'gag tu rgyugs 'bul zhu thub pa yod med kyi tshod blta lta bu yin 'dug rgyugs sprod sgra dag gsal gsum mdzed tshe/ bsres song nas sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po brgyud gzim chung 'gag tu rgyugs phul zhus chog pa zhes snyan seng zhus te/ bka' 'a3tshel byung mtshams/ nyin gcig gzim chung 'gag tu drung ji'i sar rgyugs 'bul zhu skabs/ bgres song nas rgyugs bzhes mdzad/ rgyugs 'bul zin mtshams/ gza' skar 'phrod sbyor dge ba zhig nyin rang gi dge rgan nas dge skos la snyan seng dang 'brel/ grwa tshang gi tshogs khang du gding ba brgyab/ gzim chung du sku bcar gyi gding mjal zhus/ de nas bzung grwa tshang khongs su tshud/ gsar zhugs de zla ba gcig gi ring phyag bde langs mi dgos/ de rjes nyin gcig ja khas zhes pa grwa tshang 37

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/las sne yongs rdzogs la gsol ja dang / gsol zhib/ zhib thud gzab 'bul thog grwa tshang spyi sar ṭam dkar nyis brgya ngo 'bul thog dge rgan nas gsar zhugs de'i gang ci'i zhu bya rnams 'thus tshang zhu rgyu'i 'gan len bya gan rgya bzhag de nas phyag bde ba mi grangs nyi shu rtsaganyis yod pa'i khongs su tshud pa dang / sngar yod phyag bde ba nyer gnyis kyi nang nas rgan pa de phyag bde ba'i khongs nas thon pa dang / sngar phyag bde'i dus yun ring rgyugs thengs gnyis pa/ rgyugs chen phul zin na las/ de min phyag bde thon nyin nas rab rgyugs chen dang / de min phyag rgyugs phul dgos pa las 'bul rgyu med tshe grwa tshang gi sgrigs khongs su sdod mi chog rab rgyugs chen 'bul mi rnams nas gong bzhin thog mar bgres song sar dang / de rjes sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po brgyud rgyugs 'bul zhus chog pa zhes gzim chung du gzhes brda phul/ bka' 'khrol byung mtshams/ gzim chung 'gag tu/bgres song nas dag bsher dang bcas/ skyabs 'gro khrus gsol/ 7rgyal ba'i zhabs brtan/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bdag mdun bum gsum/tshogs 'khor/ dbang chog smon shis bcas dang / 'jigs byed kyi byang chog dang / sbyin bsreg rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs ma/ rgyud sde chung khag gras thugs rje chen po/ mi 'khrugs pa/ tshe dpag med/ sman 38

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bla/ rnam rgyal ma bcas dang / bskangs gso/ mgon po/ chos rgyal/lha mo/ rnam sras/ gur/ zhal/ lcam sring gsum gyi bskangs gso rgyas pa/ sku lnga 'khor bcas/ rdo rje grags ldan/ btsan/ bse khrab/ tshangs pa/ 7rgyal pa'i 'khrungs la dang 'khrungs gsol/ bzur bskul/ 'jug tu grwa tshang mchod brjod bcas gzhung zhabs ser skya yongs rdzogs 'du sar nyin gsum gyi ring sgra dag gsal gsum gyi rgyugs phul rjes/ gzim chung du mjal bcar phyag dbang dang / phyag srung / rang gzhung 'phral bde las khungs nas gnang cha gsol ras stsal/ de rjes grwa tshang du tshogs rgyugs 'bul chog pa zhes dge skos la snyan seng dang 'brel/ gsol tshogs su gsol ji la sogs pa'i mchod yun gyi dus skabs dang bstun rgyugs 'bul zhu dgos shing / rgyugs 'bul zhu rgyu'i cho ga sne mang la brten/ dus yun zhag grangs mang po'i ring 'gor zhing rgyusas thon mtshams grwa tshang spyi so nas mjal dar dang / gsol ras stsal/ rgyugs thengs gnyis par rgyugs chen 'bul ma thub rnams nas/ phyag bde rgyugs zhes pa phul dgos shing /de yang phyag bde rgyugs ni/ gong bzhin phyag bde thon pa'i nyin mo nas gsol tshogs su gsol ja'i dus yun dang bstun/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i bdag bskyed dang / bum pa mdun bskyed/ tshogs 'khor 39

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/dbang chog smon shis dang / bde mchog bdag mdun gnyis bcas tshogs rgyugs 'bul dbe|sa/ rgyugs thengs gnyis pa thon mtshams/ bar shar ba zhes gsung bzang bar ma bskos bar dang / dung rgya'i las thog ma zin bar/ lo tshad nges med kyi nyin ltar gsol tshogs su ltar chags bcar dgos pa las/ dmigs bsal las 'gan med/ de nas nyin gcig grwa tshang lhan rgyas tshang 'dzoms thog bar shar ba gang yod bka' 'gugs gnang ste de'i dkyil nas/ grwa tshang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gsung dang / dpe cha legs gras rnams gsung bzang dang / de min mchod bzhengs pa'i gras su bsko bzhag gnang gi yod/ gsung bzang bar bsko bzhag gnang srol gnyis yod pa las/ gcig gong zhus ltar dang / gnyis pa grwa sa dang /gzhis dgon khag gi nang nas dge 'dun pa gsung legs gras spyi nor 7gong sa maḥtsheg gam/ rgyal tshab nas thad kur grwa tshang du bka' 'gugs gnang ste/ grwa tshang gi sgrigs khungs su 'dzugs pa gnang ba dang grwa tshang gi 'don cha rnams blo 'dzin thog gong bzhin rgyugs 'bul zhus mtshams gsung bzang du bsko gzhag gnang gi krerdzod/ de rnams nas dmigs bsal gzhon khrul rnams rgyugs mi datredzes/ rgyugs thengs gsum pa bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi gsor lo'i 'don cha cha tshang thog mar dus 'khor slob dpon gyi drung 40

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/du dang / de nas rim bzhin/ gzim chung 'gag tshogs gzhung bcas la rgyugs 'bul zhu dgos/ rgyugs sprod thon mtshams rim bzhin dus 'khor grwa pa drug cu re lnga'i khungs su tshud thub/ grwa tshang gi dung rgya gsar slob byed tshul ni/ lo lnga re'i mtshams/ nyin gcig gsung bzang ma yin pa'i bar shar ba grangs nyi shu rtsabazhi lhan rgyas tshang 'dzoms sar bka' 'gugs gnang ste/ de'i dkyil nas gzugs stobs che ba bcu gnyis dung pa dang / chung spro bcu gnyis rgya gling bar bsko gzhag mdzad/ de rjes dus yun zla ba bzhi'i ring dung rgya bslab/ zla ba bzhi'i rjes lhan rgyas tshang 'dzoms sar rgyugs 'bul snga phyi thengs gsum dang / de rjes 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung dang / tshogs su'ang rgyugs 'bul zhu dgos/ gzim chung nas gnang sbyin gsol ras stsal/ rgyugs spyod thon nyin nas de rnams lo lnga'i ring dung rgya las thog pa zhes las 'gan 'khur dgos/ dus yu na de'i ring rang rang sku yon byung rigs rnams spyi sar spungs te lo lnga'i rjes las thog thon mtshams dung rgya las thog so so nas dang / spyi thog bcas nas nyin gcig grwa tshang la nyin saspyongs gtong sgo gzab 'bul thog mchod rdzas la sogs pa sbyor zhu gi yod/ rgyun ldan nas las thog nang phan tshun chos grogs kyi 'du shes kyis phan tshun gus brtse'i srol bzang dmigs bsal can zhig yod 'dug phyi 41

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyu sa/lo dung rgya las thog nas thon rgyu'i 'di lo'i dbyar gnas skabs dkyil 'khor bris thig bslab dgos pa dang / de rjes lhan rgyas thog rgyugs 'bul zhu dgos/gzhan yang dus yun de'i ring mchod pa khag gi ri mo bslab nas gong bzhin rgyugs thengs gsum 'bul datredzes pa dang / rgyugs thengs gsum par mar sgrom rgyab ste legs nyes la gzhigs pa'i ang rim gnang / mchod bzhengs las thog dngos gzhir/ gar pa lo lnga dang / de rjes 'bring dang / rtse ma bcas par lo lnga re bcas khyon lo ngo bco lnga'i ring las thog thon zin dgos/gsung bzang rnams dkyil 'khor bris thig gong bzhin bslab te/ gtso cher 7rgyal ba'i chos phyogs kyi mdzad pa khag gi gsung zhabs zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin sgrub mchod dang / gtor sgrub bcas kyi 'don bskul dbu mdzad phebs na las/ de min mtshan rim ltar zhal 'don bskul dgos so/ /don tshan gnyis pa'i nang gses gsum pa/bod du lo 'khor gcig nang 7rgyal ba'i gsung zhabs zhu sgo khag gi mdzad rim/bod du lo gcig nang star chags su gsung zhabs zhu rgyu'i 7rgyal ba'i 42

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo khag dang / bstan srid spyi rim sgrub mchod khag gtor sgrub/ gzhan yang mdzad sgo khag bcas sdurdzo se'i tshugs yul tshogs khang /zla dus tshes grangs/ grwa grangs bcas snying bsdus su bkod pa/lo ltar gnam lo gsar du bzhad pa'i tshes gcig gi snga dro rtsepho brang dbu rtse nas snyan gsan dung brda gsum pa btang ba dang / sku zhabs rnams sku bzhengs kyis so so'i shag tu lo gsar gyi rten 'brel mdzad/ de'i bar du dus yun ring tsam bzhag dung brda bzhi pa btang pa dang / tshogs brda btang / rtse pho brang gzim chung mtshan gzim khang du/ lhar bcas srid zhi'i gtsug rgyun 7gong sa 7skyabs mabe|na thams cad mkhyen cing gzigs pa chen po mchog dbu bzhugs kyis sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po mchog dang /tshogs gzhung dbu chos gnyis/ dus 'khor dbu chos gnyis/ mchod g.yog dang / gzim gakrerdzog gar dpon bcas nas 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bdag bskyed sngon du btang ste/ dpal ldan lha mo'i bskangs gso sems nyid ma'i dbur gsol tshogs grol/ spyi nor 7go nga sa mchog gis dpal ldan lha mo'i sku thang la thugs smon snyan shal smon tshig can sgron 'bul bskyangs/de rjes zhal 'don sems nyid ma nas rten rdzas dbu bar gsungs te gsol tshogs grol/ de dang dus mtshungs rtse pho brang tshoms chen nub tu grwa tshang 43

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/tshogs gzhu nga nas zhal 'don lha bcu gsum ma'i bdag bskyed dang 'brel lha mo'i gsung bskangs gong bzhin rten rdzas dbu bar gsungs/ de rjes dge 'phel ri rtser nyi ma shar ba dang / rtse pho brang dbu rtser gzhung gi tshes gtor gyi gsol tshogs su/ spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur bka' dran che skabs/ grwa tshang dge skos dang sde pa khri pa gnyis nas spos sne/ sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po mchog nas chibs bsgyur nam yin la gzigs dpe dang / mchod gasku1ga nas phyag bzhes gdan 'dren/ gzim gasku(ga nas na bza' gdan zhu bcas dang spyan rgya gnyis/ mchod bzhengs pa mi grangs nges med kyis zhabs ras phul/ spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i khrir zhabs sor 'khod bstun grwa tshang sde pa khri pa nas maṇḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul zhus/gzhung zhabs rim bzhi rnam pa yan nas mjal bcar phyag dbang zhus rjes rang rang bzhugs gral la 'khod mtshams/ dbu mdzad nas zhal 'don dbu tshugs/nyi ma shar mtshams dbu gdugs pa gnyis dang / gzim 'gag re mos kyis sil yab phul/ tshes gtor gsol tshogs su grwa tshang bkra shis khang gsar nas dkar spro gzab rgyas sgrig gzhoms mdzod/ mdzad sgo 'di'i skor/ spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gis mdzad rnam/ ngos kyi yul dang ngos kyi mi mang 44

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/zhes pa'i nang / lo gsar dus chen nam 'char la/ po ta la'i yang thog gi rtser snga dro nyi ma ma shar gong / chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo zhig yod/ de skabs gnam gzhis grang mo yin stabs mdzad sgo'i gsol ja tsha po de myur tu 'ong 'dod yong gi yod ces bka' stsal ba'i mdzad sgor 'di'i skabs yin/mdzad sgo grwa tshang nas gsol ja dang bzhes 'bras 'debs 'bul zhus/ mnga' gsol skabs drung yig chen mo nas dpal ldan lha mo'i snyan shal la thugs smon zhus te 'bul gnang mdzad/ shis brjod gsungs pa dang / mgron ches bzhugs khrir khri dar phul rjes mdzad sgo grol mtshams sngar bzhin/ spos sne/ spyan rgya/ phebs ras phul te gzim chung du chibs sgyur gnang / de rjes tshoms chen shar du blam lo gsar gyi mdzad sgor gong bzhin gdan zhu mdzad/mdzad sgor gzhung zhabs drung rigs ser skya rnams dang / gdan sa khag gi mkhan po bla sprul serdzogs phebs srol las/ grwa tshang nas chibs bsgyur zhabs zhu ba rnams las de min dmigs bkar phebs ma dbe|sa/ mdzad sgo grol mtshams gong bzhin gdan 'dren zhus/ tshes 2 nyin tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs su rgyal po lo gsar zhes gzhung gi mdzad chen der gong bzhin 7gong sa mchog gdan zhus bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod bstun/dbu chos gsung bzang dang bcas bzhugs khri'i sku mdun du dbu zhwa bzhes te 45 /

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bzhengs/ mchod g.yog nas 7gong sa chen por phyag nas phul/ gzhan yang srid tshab/ yongs 'dzin/ mtshan zhabs/ dbu chos sogs gsung zhabs pa rnams la thor nas bkram/ zhal 'don tshig ma'adroms dang bstun rin chen rgyan cha ba rnams nas rtags brgyad/ sna bdun/ rdzas brgyad bcas 'degs 'bul zhus mjug tu bstan 'bar ma dang shis brjod gsungs/ mdzad sgor gzhung zhabs ser skya krerdzongs rdzogs dang phyi rgyal gyi sku tshab khag yab gzhis sku 'khor la sogs pa/ grwa tshang tshogs sku1ngas na bza' gzab bzhes dang bcas sku bcar zhu dgos/ ston chen dkar spro gzab rgyas dang / gar/'bras gling / bro gling la sogs pa rim pa phul/ mdzad sgo grub mtshams besnang bzhin gdan zhu mdzad/ tshes 3 nyin gzim chung mtshan gzim khang du/ tshes 1 nyin phebs mi rnams sku bcar zhus/ 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyangs/ zhal 'don 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bdag bskyed dang 'brel bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang pa chen po'i bstan srung dmar nag gnyis kyi gsung bskangs dang / 'phrin skyems/bstan srid dang / sku phyu'i skor la 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng gnyis pa thams cad mkhyen pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i thugs dam gyi rten dpal ldan lha mo'i sku thang khyad par can gyi sku mdun du 7gong sa chen pos zan brtag gnang / de 46

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/dang dus mtshungs tshogs gzhung tshoms chen nub tu tshes gsum bstan gsol zhes zhogs pa zhal 'don bdag bskyed dang 'brel/ lha mo dang bstan ma gsungs/ mjug tu gshegs gtor rgyas pa phul skabs/ pho brang dbu rtse nas dung rgya phul/ tshes 3 nyin gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling du tshes gsum spyan 'dren gsol khar/ rtse shod sku tshab dang / bka' shag lhan rgyas chibs bsgyur gyi gnas chung spyan 'dren zhu bar/ grwa tshang nas dung rgya ba mi bzhi dang / gsung zhabs pa brgyad bcas sku bcar zhu/ tshes 4dang tshes 5 la lo gsar dgung gseng / de nas tshes cha gang rung zhig la gzim chung du dgra lha 'od ldan dkar po spyan 'dren zhu bar/ dbu mdzad dang / mchod g.yog gsung bzang mi grangs brgyad/ dung rgya mi bzhi/ dkon gnyer shod bcas sku bcar zhus/ spyan 'dren skabs rnga sbub rnams dkon gnyer shod nas gra sgrig zhu srol dang / dung rgya gzim chung dbu rtse nas phul dgos/ 'di ni gzim chung spyan 'dren nam yin la 'dra ba yin/lha ldan gtsug lag khang du cho 'phrul smon lam chen mor/ 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur yod skabs chibs kha ma bsgyur gong dbu chos gnyis kyis dbus chibs zhabs pa mi grangs bcu drug nas srung spyi'i 'phrin bcol dang /de mjug slo ba dpon nas phebs byams la khrus gsol zhus/ gzim g.yog 47

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/dang / phyag bde ba mi grangs skabs bstun nas mgron gzim gnyis dang lhan du sku'i nyer chas gdan 'dren zhus/ chibs bsgyur rtse nas yin skabs/ rtse gzim chung nas/ rdo ring nang ma bar mchod bzhengs mi grangs bcu drug skor nas phebs ras phul/ gzhan yang spyan rgya/ sil yab pa gnyis/ phebs byams zur bzhir grwa tshang sku zhabs gzugs stobs che ba bzhi nas chibs 'chang ba zhes 7rgyal ba'i sku srung lta bur gri ring re lus bcang thog phebs byams kyi zur bzhi ra rkang 'gros bya dgos/ sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po mchog nas chibs bsgyur che ba nam yin la dpal ldan lha mo'i sku thang dang / slob dpon nas lha mo'i be bum/ dbu mdzad nas de bzhin sku thang / mchod g.yog nas phyag nas nas ze/ dung pa gnyis nas spos mdong gdan zhu bcas khyon sku'i chibs zhabs kyi gras su sku zhabs bcu drug skor sku bcar zhu dgos/ 'di dag ni chibs bsgyur chen mo nam yin zhu bya mtshungs pa yin/ chibs bsgyur bskyangs skabs grwa tshang tshogs yongs nas/ rdo ring nang ma dang / lcang gseb shar gyi zur/ lha sa gtsug lag khang gi e waṃ bcas khag gsum du star bsgrigs kyis gus btud zhus/ grwa tshang tshogs yongs smon lam la phebs skabs/ bar khang dge g.yog rtser gdan zhur bcar/ rtse'i gzhung sgo phun tshogs 'du lam gyi sgo'i ra ba nas gos dkar po zhig gyon/ lag 48

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/na 'bob lcag dang / sba lcag 'khyer te sngon du song / de rjes dge skos nas spos sne bcas grwa dmangs bstar bsgrigs te dmigs bsal bsnams sgo yod rigs las/ de min shog lhung bsnams te spyod lam tshul bzhin du phebs/ smon lam ring bzhugs gnas gtsug lag khang gi yang steng khag dang / bar khang nang gi lha khang khag tu mtshan rim bzhin bzhugs/ smon lam ma tshugs gong smon lam las bya 'bras spungs pa rnams dang lhan du/ grwa tshang gi bkras phyag dang / dung pa gnyis se(gas pa nas gzim chung 'a gag tu 'byor phyag zhus/ mgron che mchog nas smon lam ring gi zhu sgo mtha' dag 'thus shor med pa byed dgos pa'i bka' bsgyur 'thus nan bskyangs rjes phyag srung stsal/ dung pa gnyis kyis rang gzhung bsher khang las khungs nas dung dkar cha gcig rtsis len zhus te kyi smon lam ring nyin ltar gsol ja phebs pa'i skabs dang / de bzhin/ gsung chos rwa ba/ skam tshogs bcas par gtsug lag khang gi yang steng nas phyogs bzhir chag med 'bul gtong zhu dgos/ tshes 10 nyin rme ru rnying par/ 7gong sa mchog gnas chung gzang gsol la chibs sgyur skabs/ spyan rgya sogs dang gsung bzang mi grangs bco lnga sku bcar zhu dgos/ de byings sku zhabs rnams gtsug lag khang gi tshe ring mched dzoyod par thugs rngan lha bsang btang ste bzhugs/49

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/tshes 15 nyin dpal lha lcog tu/ 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur gyis grwa grangs rdzabacu skor nas lha mo dang bstan ma gnyis kyis gzab gsol tshugs/tshes 14/15/16/ bcas nyin gsum ring gtsug lag khang gi dkyil lwabor sdings su du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs tshugs/ mchod chas dang bsnyen bkur rnams grwa tshang sbug khungs nas phul/ tshes grangs lhag chad med tshe/ tshes 18nas 23 bar gtor sgrub zhal 'don spyi bskang yongs rdzogs dang tshes 23 nyin dgong ja ma tshogs gong rgyag gtor tshogs kyi gral 'gor bsgrigs/gtor sgrub de bzhin glo bur las sbyor lta bu yin 'dug tshes 23 nyin dpal lha lcog tu dga' ldan khri rin po che dbu bzhugs 'og grwa grangs lnga bcu skor nas/ lha mo dang / tshangs pa gnyis kyi gzab gsol tshugs/ smon lam gtor rgyag zhogs pa snga tshogs/ srung spyi'i bskang ba'i mjug tu 'phrin bcol gang rgyas dgu gtor chen mo dang / smon lam gtor rgyag gnyis la dbu mdzad nas 'phyag gzan bzhes srol sku1da 'dug dung pa rnams nas gzim chung du bka' skor dang 'brel khyams ra'i sgo 'phyor 'og nas zhwa phud zhus rjes snyan gsan thengs gsum phul/ gtor rgyag dngos gzhi 'phyar dar ba mi grangs nyi shu dang / de mjug grwa tshang sde pa khri pas gos 'phyar gru 50

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/'phyar stod/ 'ja' lham mtshal ka/ mgron gnyer nas gos chen tshon khra dang / zhwa wa sgor/ de byings zhabs gras rnams nas gos phyu dang / sog zhwa gyon pa bcas dpon g.yog bdun dang / gzhung gi sku tshab tu shod drung gcigagrwa tshang gi dge skos bcas nas spos sne zhus/ gan rkyang spos phor ba brgyad/gser skyems pa gnyis/ dung pa bzhi/ dung stegs pa bzhi/ rkang gling ba bzhi/ rol cha ba dgu rnga pa drug cu/ 'phyar dar 'gan 'khris pa gnyis/gtor ma'i 'gan 'khris pa gcig chab ril bcas dang / lha dmag bye ba 'bum ther mtshon byed du rta dmag g.yas ru dang / g.yon ru/ gzhan yang rkang dmag rnams g.yas g.yon du ru star bsgrigs/ gtor rgyab tu dga' ldan khri rin po ches dbus lo de'i dge bzhes lha rams pa rnams zhi dul bag yod kyis phebs nas bstan 'gro'i don du thugs smon mdzad/ sprul pa'i chos skyong dgra lha 'od sa dkar po sku phebs kyis ru 'dren sde bzhi bcas gtor rar phebs nas dgra phyogs su phyag mda' 'phen/ chos skyong phyir phebs pa dang / chos sku ma'i bzlog pa dang bstun slob dpon gyis rgyag gtor 'phangs/ 'phyar dar ba rnams dang / tshogs gzhung phyir phebs kyis 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung zhal dkar mdun/ sngon du dung rkang ba rnams nas gus btud zhus/ de mjug dbu chos gnyis dang rnga rol ba rnams nas dang / de rjes 51
