rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshade gling gi lo rgyus/slob dpon mchog dang sde pa khri pa/ gzan rkyang pa bcas nas rim bzhin gus 'dud zhus rjes gral nyis bsgrigs kyis 'khyams ra'i nang phebs/ mnga' gsol du dam can chos kyi rgyal po'i sku thang rgyan 'grems gnang ba de'i g.yas g.yon du 'phyar dar ba rnams dang / mdun du mchod gtor bsgrigs/ dbu chos tshogs yongs rnams der zhal phyogs te/ mnga' gsol gsung / tshogs khang du 'du tshogs mdzod/ thub sil rnams dbu mdzad nas re re bzhin rtsis bzhes/ mjug tu dbu mdzad nas gzim chung du rtsis 'bul zhu dgos/ tshes 15 nyin ra mo che jo khang du 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur bskyangs skabs/gsung zhabs su sku zhabs bcu drug bcar te zhal 'don khrus gsol dang rab gnas mjug tu mgon por 'phrin bcol gnang smin gsung / lha ldan gtsug lag khang nas rtse pho brang ngam nor gling du chibs sgyur gnang skabs su chibs zhabs gong bzhin dang / tshogs sku1ngas nas kyang gong gsal pa khag gsum du gus 'dud zhus/ tshes 28 nyin nas rtse tshogs khang du 7rgyal dbang bdun pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul du/ bod zla 2 tshes nas bcom ldan 'das 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun tshugs rgyu'i sngon 'gro sa chog dbu tshugs/bod zla gnyis par/52

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'e1 rgyus/gong 'khod ltar tshes 3 nas rdul tshon dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas 'jigs byed kyi sgrub mchod/ yang tshes 1 nas zla gcig ring tshoms chen shar du mdos bskang zhes pa rgyun tshogs thog lha mo'i bskang bshags 'bum ther 'gro nges dang 'brel/ tshes 22 nyin byin 'bebs/tshes 23 nas bdun gcig ring bkras lugs kyi lha mo'i gtor sgrub/rnam kun bskang gso khag gi bdag bskyed la mchod rol med kyang / 'dir mchod rol yod pas rnam kun dang mi 'dra/ bkras lugs gtor sgrub ni/gtsang bkra shis lhun po'i lugs kyi lha mo'i gtor sgrub kyi cho ga phyag len nas dper bzhes pa yin/ gsor tshogs grol skabs kyang / dung brda re phul dgos/ zhal 'don spyi bskang thog lha mo'i mdos gzhung gsung dgos/ tshes 29 nyin gtor rgyag snga phyi dus tshod/ lha ldan gtsug lag khang gi dkyil 'khor sdings su gsang sngags byang chub gling pa nas mdos chog tshogs te/khyams ra'i sgo 'phyor du 7gong sa mchog dang dgungs rtags gcig pa'i grwa tshang sku zhabs gcig gis na bza' be|sa ber dang / pan zhwa/ dom ra sogs bla chas bzhes/ byang chub gling gi slob dpon dang / lhan du glud 'gong dang sho rgyab ste/ glud 'gong pham par mdzad/ glud 'gong skyed chur gru'i nang btang ba dang / dus mtshungs rdo ring phyi ma nas gtor ma 'phen pa gnyis 53

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/dus mtshungs pa dgos/ gzhan yang bod zla gnyis pa'i nang gsang 'dus zla thog nyin grangs 12 tshugs dgos/ zla thog zhes pa/ snga dus zla rer bde gsang 'jigs gsum dang / dus 'khor bcas kyi bdag 'jug nyin re bzhes srol yod 'dug pa de/ phyis su zla thog ces nyin grangs 12la dus gcig tu tshugs/ gtor sgrub dang / sgrub mchod khag la thog mtha' bar gsum du gsol tshogs phul srol kyang skuld 'dug tshes 30 nyin nas dus 'khor ba rnams gar sbyong dang / sa chog pa rnams las bya dbu tshugs/tshogs gzhung nas rnam rgyal ma'i sgrub mchod nyin grangs bdun tshugs dgos/bod zla gsum pa/tshes grangs lhag chad med tshe tshoms chen nub tu tshogs gzhung bod zla 3 tshes 10 nas zla 5 tshes 10 bar zla ba gnyis ring lha mo'i mdos bskang tshugs/ thog mtha' bar gsum du bsgral chog gnang /'di la zla gnyis mdos bskang zer/ dus 'khor gar pa rnams gong 'khod ltar tshes 1 nas 15 bar gar pa mi grangs sum cu skor nas snga dro ka brgyad mar sa gar dang / dgong dro mchod gar gyi sbyong tshugs/ dus 'khor bris thig pa rnams nas las thig dang / yid thig gi thig skud/ bum pa'i cha rdzogs/ dpyog zhu/ srung skud bcas bzo rgyu dang / stegs bu bcas 54

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/sgrigs gshoms zhus/ tshes 5 dgong dro sa chog gi mchod pa rnams sgrigs gzhoms zin mtshams dus 'khor dbu chos gnyis dang / bri thig pa bcas nas mchod par byin rlabs mdzad/ tshes 6 snga dro gar pa rnams gsol ji bzhes tshar ba dang / sa gar khrus zhes/ nang sbyong lta bur tshoms chen du gar chas med par sa gar cha tshang bskyedan/ tshes 7 nyin sa gar dngos gzhi/ de bzhin tshes 13 nyin mchod gar khrus dang / tshes 14 nyin rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor leb/sa par bzhengs grub pas/ mchod phreng mjug 7gong sa mchog gis dbus/ bka' shag lhan rgyas dang / gzhung zhabs ser skya yongs gar gzigs la chibs bsgyur bskyangs rjes gar pa rnams nas mchod gar bskyedan/ mchod gar grub mtshams gar pa rnams la mjal kha dang / gsol ja/ bzhes 'bras phebs/ dge skos nas spos sna zhus ste 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyangs/ 7gong sa mchog bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod mtshams/ sku'i mdzengs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / mtshan zhabs rnam pa mjal kha zhus/ rtse 〈(ra bcas gzhung zhabang rnams la phyag dbang dang / de mjug dus 'khor slob dpon nas shaṇil rten gsum 'degs 'bul dang 'brel dus 'khor chog grwa pa drug cu re bzhi nas mjal phyag zhus te tshogs gral du 'khod/ bod du dus 'khor 55

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/tshogasagrwabazhesartsegasagazhungalas zur du yin 'dug de yang 7rgyal dbang bdun pa chen pos thog mar btsugs pa gnang dus chos grwa ba sum cu skor yod pa dang / phyis su dus 'khor gyi cho ga blo 'dzin can grwa grangs 65 yod/de 'i ring gi gtong sgo khag dang / tshogs yul tshoms chen/ mchod chas la sogs pa grwa tshang spyi pa las zur du yin 'dug 'on kyang deng skabs rgya gar du 7gong sa chen po'i dgongs gzhi dgos pa bla na med pa las/ dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'don chog dang / dkyil 'khor bris thig gar bcas grwa tshang gi grwa pa yin phyin tshang mas blo 'dzin rgyugs sprod zhu dgos zhes bka' slob spyi por phebs pa na bzung / thog mar blo 'dzin rgyugs sprod dang / bar du spyi nor 7gong sa chen po'i zhal snga nas dus kyi zhakhor lo'i dbang lung gakhrid gsum legs par nod te mtshan rim bzhin bsnyen sgrub la bzhugs dgos pa dang / 'itshe ltar nag pa zla ba'i tshes 15 dang stabs bstun/ thog mar sa'i cho ga rnams sngon du btang ba'i sgo nas sgrub mchod nyin bdun dang / mjug tu kha skong sbyin sreg bcas sngar srol nyams med tshugs/ tshogs mgon du 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur bka' drin che ba dang / khul 'dir gnyug mar gnas pa'i bya bral ba 'ga' yang gsedzel tshogs su phebs 'thus gnang ba stsal/ bod du dus 'khor sgrub mchod nyin grangs 15 dang nyin tha 56

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'etshergyus/mar sbyin sreg de yang sku gsung thugs nyin dgu dang / thugs dkyil nyin drug tshes 30 nyin nor gling klu khang du klu chog gnang / klu chog grub mtshams dus 'khor dbu chos gnyis nas/ sgrub mchod ring gi spyi nor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po'i sku skal dkar spro'i phud dang / bzhugs khri'i sku yon/ 7rgyal ba'i bum pa'i nang gi bum chu dang / rdul tshon phud bcas 7gong sa chen por 'bul bzhes dang / mjug tu mjal bcar phyag dbang stsal/ bod zla 4 tshes shar la dus 'khor spro seng nyin gsum mam bzhi btang / bod zla 3 tshes 8 nas nyin lnga'i ring brgyad gtor tshugs rgyur brten tshes 7 nyin gzim chung bzhugs khri nas na bza' gdan zhu grub pa dang / pho brang dbu rtse nas snyan gsan dung brda btang ba dang / brgyad gtor gsol tshogs su phebs mi sku zhabs rnams nas rang rang gi sku zlam tshogs khang du bskyal/ tshes 8 nyin 7be|nga sa mchog gnas gzigs su chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ gur zhal/ lcam sring gsum gyi sku brnyan la thugs smon snyan shal sgron 'bul mdzad de tshogs dbur zhabs stegs su 'khol/gzhung zhabs las 'dron yan nas kyang / sdo/ra/ zhal/ lcam sring gsum gyi sku brnyan la mjal dar 'bul grub mtshams 7gong sa mchog gzim chung du gdan zhu mdzad/ tshoms chen shar nub gnyis kyi nang gsol tshogs mdzed 57

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/rigs la grwa tshang slob dpon nas bla chas gos ber bzhes dgos/bod zla bzhi par/bod zla 4 tshes 1 nas tshes 4 bar bde chog lu yi pa'i lugs kyi sa chog dang / tshes lda nas tshes 14 bar nyin grangs bcu'i ring sgrub mchod dngos gzhi/ nyin mtha' mar sbyin sreg tshes 15nyin rdul tshon klu chog tshes 16 nas bde chog gung seng nyin grangs bdun/ tshes 30 nas zla 5 tshes da bar nyin gsum gyi ring thugs rje chen po padmo lugs kyi sgrub mchod kyi sngon 'gro sa chogabod zla lnga par/gong 'khod ltar tshes 3 nas nyin bdun gyi ring sgru mchod/ tshes lda nas spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i sku'i 'khrungs skar gyi mdzad chen dang 'brel nyin bzhi'i ring 7rgyal dbang sku 'phreng rim byon gyi 'khrungs lha rten khang du sku zhabs nyi shu nas 'khrungs lha dang / lha mo gtso gyur gyis gsol mchod/ tshes 10 nas klu sdings su dbyar gsol gyi spro seng nyin bcu gnyis/ dbyar gsol nyin bcu gnyis par klu sdings su 7rgyal dbang sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtshe'i sku'i 'khrungs skar la brten/'khrungs lha li sbyin ha ra'i gsung bskang / tshes 15 nyin tshogs yongs 58

rnam/ par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling gi 'du khang du sku lnga gtso gyur gyi srung spyi'i bskang gso'i thog dgra 'od ldan dkar po/ lo gsol spyan 'dren zhus/ chos skyong nas 'dus tshogs su dgyes pa chen po'i bka' lung dang / phyag srung stsal/ tshes 21 nas gsang 'dus bris thig rnams nas nyin bzhi'i ring gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i lugs kyi sngon 'gro sa chog dang / tshes 24 nas tshogs yongs nyin bcu'i ring rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas sgrub mchod/ mjug tu sbyin sreg bod zla 6 tshes 4nyin rdzong rgyab klu khang du rdul tshon klu chog gnang / tshes 5 nas sbyar rag nor bu chos gling du gsang 'dus gung seng nyin bdun/ de'i skabs phying ba dkar gtso 'khor rnams la gsol mchod dang 'brel lo gsol spyan 'dren dang / gzim chung spyan 'dren du phebs pa dang stabs bstun bsam yas gnod sbyin tse'u dmar po'i sku rten gdan zhus thog lo gsol spyan 'dren zhu gnang mdzad/bod zla drug pa/tshes 15 nas gzim chung bde ldan 'khyil du dge 'dun zhal grangs 50 skor nas thams cad mkhyen pa 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos gangs ljongs skye 'gro'i bde thabs su dgongs te 'dzugs par 59

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs gad gling gi lo rgyus/mdzad pa dus babs gter ston las rab gling pa'am gter ston bsod rgyal gyis gter nas bzhes pa'i phur pa yang snying spu gri ras bris dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub mchod dang / mjug tu sbyin sreg bcas nyin grangs bco lnga /lo gnangs 'char la rdul tshon dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i bdud rtsi sman sgrub kyang tshugs/ tshes 16 nyin dbyar zhal bzhes/ tshes 23 nas bcom bo 'das sman gyi sgrub mchod nyin grangs bdun gyi ring nyin nya tshogs thengs tha mar lha mo'i bskang ba gtong gnang dgos/ dbyar gnas ring /gsung bzang ba rnams dang / grwa mang rnams dbyangs sbyong dang / dung rgya ba rnams phu bskor tshugs/ phyag bde ba nyi shu rtsaganyis kyis lo gcig gi bstan ma'i bskang bshags bsags/ zla 6 tshes 20 nas grwa tshang dge bskos gsar ring brje len gyis gsar pa'i khri 'don nyin sar sro la lar gra lha//ti ///pa //// the /tshang gi bca' yig ma bu gsum tshogs dbus su sgrog sbyang zhus/ dge skos kyi las rgyun lo 'khor gcig dang / deng sang mas rim bzhin phebs dgos yod 'dugabod zla bdun pa/tshes 1 nas 4 bar tshoms chen nub tu 'jigs byed kyi bri thig pa rnams nas rsāgs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub mchod kyi sngon 'tsho 60

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/sa chog nyin bzhi/ tshes 5 nas tshes 11 bar sgrub mchod/ tshes 14 nas 16 bar nyin gsum gyi ring 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs ma dang / de rjes gnas bcu rgyal bstan 'dzad med kyi sgrub mchod nyin bdun/ byams khang du dus 'khor ba mi grangs 23 nas dus 'khor khar kha zla thog ces nyin grangs 12 tshes 20nas bcom ldan tshe dpag med lha dgu'i sgrub mchod kyi sngon 'gro'i sa chog dang /tshes 32 nas tshogs gzhung nas tshe dpag med kyi sgrub mchod nyin bdun/nyin ltar dgong jar tshe chog 'chi blu dang / nyin tha mar sku glud phyir brdzong bya dgos/bod zla brgyad pa/tshes 1 sbyar rag gling gar chab zhugs nyin bcu gnyis/ sku mgron du rtse yig tshang gi dbus gzhung zhabs las tshan yan nyin gcig dang /bka' shag lhan rgyas kyis dbus shod skor gong bzhin nyin gcig gdan zhu mdzad/chab zhugs tredzeng 'khod ltar tshes 11 bar dang / tshes 12 nas mi 'khrugs pa'i sa chog nyin gsum/ tshes 15 nas nyin bdun gyi ring rdul tshon dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas mi 'khrugs pa lha bcu gsum gyi sgrub mchod/ tshes 22 rwa lugs lha mo'i gtor sgrub kyi byin 'bebs 61

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/dang / tshes 23 nas gtor sgrub/ tshes 29 nyin gtor 'phen/dge 'dun zhal grangs 25 nas rtse rgyal po lcog gam sku lnga'i rten khang du sku lnga'i mdos bskang dang 'brel lo gsol tshugs/ chab zhugs grol rjes 'di lo'i dgu gtor 'cham dung btang mi dung pa gnyis nas dus yun dgu gtor ma tshugs bar 'cham dung sbyang dbe|sa/bod zla dgu pa/tshes 1 nas 4 bar bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog gi sgrub mchod tshogs rgyu'i sngon 'gro sa chog dang / tshes 5 nas bcu bzhi'i bar sgrub mchod/ mjug tu sbyin sreg dang / klu chog yang ma chod bzhengs mi grangs 10 tredzeng tshes 1 nas 17 bar grwa tshang gi 'itshe gcig gi 'dzugs gtor khag bzhengs/ tshes 17 nyin mchod bzhings yongs rdzogs yong ste mchod pa rnams khungs so sor sgrigs gshoms grub pa dgos/ tshes 23 nas lcam sring gi gtor sgrub/ zhal 'don lcam sring gtso gyur gyi spyi bskang yongs rdzogs/ tshes 29 nyin gtor 'phen mdzad/bod zla bcu pa/62

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi che( rgyus/tshes 1 nas 4 bar 'jigs byed sa chog nyin bzhi/ tshes 5 nas 14 bar sgrub mchod dang / mjug tu sbyin sreg tshes 15nyin klu chog tshes 16 nas 17 nyin gnyis 'jigs byed gung seng /yang tredzeng tshes 7 nas 'edze 'di'i nang gi gsar zhugs rnams la 'cham gsar slob mgo tshugs/ tshes 22 nyin mgon po'i gtor sgrub kyi byin 'bebs/ tshes 23 nas myur mdzad ye shes kyi mgon po phyag drug pa'i gtor sgrub/ tshes 29 nyin gtor 'phen/ gtor sgrub khag gi nyin gsum par sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po dang / mchod gasku1ga rnam gnyis kyis bstan srung so so'i sku thang la 7gong sa mchog gis thugs smon snyan shal sgron 'bul mdzad/ de'i skabs dge skos nas spos snes gdan zhu/ tshes 25 nyin 'jam dbyangs mi'i rnam par rol pa rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po'i dgongs rdzobs mchod 'bul mdzad sgo'i snga dro gsung bzang ba rnams na bza' gzab bzhes kyis ka phibs 'og tu dbyangs sbyong gnang /mdzad sgo dngos gzhir 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur dang / srid tshab/ sku'i sku1ngas 'dzin/ ma'adron zhabs/ bka' shag bcas gzhung zhabs rnam pa dang /sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po dang / mchod gzim gnyis/ dbu chos gnyis gsung bzang ba mi grangs 20 yongs rdzogs thog mchod bzhengs 63

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/pa gnyis bcas nas rtse 'phags mchog lo ke shwa ra'i sku mdun du dang / de bzhin 7rgyal dbang sku 'phreng rim byon gyi gser gdung khang khag brgyad/ blos bslangs khang bcas so sor chibs bsgyur gyis thog mchod 'bul zhus/ de yang dgu pa lung rtogs rgya mtshe'i gser gdung khang du zhal 'don sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma tshar gsum gsung rjes sa gzhi byin rlabs dang khrus gsol/gnas bcu mtshungs med ma dang / mjug tu dkon mchog gsum gyi shis brjod/ brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho'i gser gdung khang du/ bla ma'i rnal 'byor dang / khrus gsol/ 'phags pa rin po che'i sku mdun du/ skyabs 'gro rgyas pa dang / skabs gsum pa/ shar gangs ri ma/ snying 'dab brgyad bcas dbyangs 'then/ mjug tu 'phags bstod/ bstan 'bar ma/ bdun pa skal bzang rgya mcho'i gser gdung khang du/ khrus gsol/bde chen sku gsum ma gdangs 'then/ ngo mtshar bsngags pa bcas gsungs/7rgyal dbang lnga pa chen mo'i gser gdung khang du/ 7rgyal ba'i 'khrungs rabs gsol 'debs dang / dpal ldan sa gsum/ khrus gsol/ maṇḍal bcas dang / de min so sor bla ma'i rnal 'byor/ blos bslangs khang du bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi bstod pa dang / spyi glu dbyings 'then/ mjug tu bde gsang 'jig gsum gyi smon lam/ shis brjod gsung srol bcas 64

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/dga' ldan lnga mchod kyi mchod 'bul rim pa dang / de rjes tshes cha gang rung zhig la/ rtse gzim chung nub rgyud nyi 'od du spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur gyis sku'i yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / mtshan zhabs rnam pa/ gzhung zhabs khag grwa tshang lce'ogs skusangs bcas nas gzim chung gzab gsol nyin gcig tshugs/ zhal 'don lha mo gtso gyur thog srung spyi'i bskang gso/ yang dus 'khor lha khang du grwa tshang slob dpon dbu bzhugs 'og grwa grangs 25 nas seng gdong ma'i bzlas pa bye ba gcig nyin grangs 14 nang 'gro nges dang 'brel gtor sgrub nyin bdun/ mjug tu gtor 'phen/ gtor sgrub khag gi gtor ma'i 'og chos 'byung blug dgos/bod zla bcu gcig pa/tshes 1 nas tshogs yongs kyis nyin bdun gyi ring srung spyi'i bskang gso tshugs/ 'di la spyi bskang sgrub mchod kyang zer/ tshes 8nas dus 'khor lha khang du dus 'khor ba rnams dus 'khor zla thog nyin bcu gnyis/ tshogs yongs bde mchog zla thog nyin bcu gnyis dang / tshes 22 nyin lcags mkhar srid gsum rnam rgyal gyi sgo nas gtor chen gyi byin 'bebs/ tshes 23 nas gtor sgrub/ tshes 29 nyin gtor 'a phen/ gtor sgrub la lo 'di'i 'jigs byed bsnyen mtshams pa brgyad gsol 65

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/tshogs su nges par phebs dgos/bod zla bcu gnyis pa/tshes 6 nas nyin lnga'i ring rgyal zla'i dus chen dang stabs bstun da sa bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i bde mchog gi sgrub mchod/ mgar thar sgrub mchod kyang zer/ tshes 10 nyin rgyal zla tshes bcu/ tshes 11nas lo mjug dgu gtor chen mo'i 'cham sbyangs nyin bdun/ nyin dang por 'di 'itsware 'cham pa gsar bslob rnams la lhan rgyas kyi rgyugs bzhes/ 'cham sbyangs nyin dang po gsum la/ 'cham dung dang / nyin bdun par 'cham chas ma gyon pa tsam las/ de min dgu gtor dngos gzhi'i nyin gyi gnang sgo cha tshang gnang dgos/ tshes 16 nas rtse mcho da pa khang du lo mjug mchod bzhengs dbu btsugs/ tshes 22 nyin rtse pho brang tshoms chen srid zhi'i phun tshogs kyi bzhugs khrir na bza' gdan zhu dang / gzim chung ba rnams brag sgo maṇḍa ru 'byor mtshams/ pho brang dbu rtse nas dung pa gnyis kyis dung btang / dgu gtor gsol tshogs su phebs mi rnams nas rang rang gi sku zlam tshogs khang du skyel ba gnang / tshes 23 nas gtor sgrub dngos gzhir/ zhal 'don nyin dang por/ gur zhal gnyis kyi dus gtor dang 'brel srung spyi'i bskang gso/ nyin gnyis par lha mo'i dus gtor 66

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling si lo rgyus/la brten/ lha mo gtsor gyur thog gong bzhin/ nyin gsum par sku lnga dang /lcam sring / srid rgyal ma dus gtor la brten/ de rnams gtsor gyur gong bzhin/ nyin bzhi pa nas chos rgyal gtso bo mdzadaka srungaspyi'i basbang gso/nyin dang po gsum la gsol tshogs kyi bar seng la 'cham hrag bsdus shig dang / nyin bzhi pa/ lnga pa/ drug pa bcas kyi dgong dro tshogs kyi gral 'gor zhwa nag 'cham dpon dang / bde 'cham pa gnyis nas res mos kyis bsgral chog dang 'brel 'cham rgyag dgos/ nyin bdun par snga dro gong bzhin 'jigs mdzad rdo rje bdag bskyed sgom pa sngon du song ba'i sgo nas srung spyi'i bskang gso dang / nyi shar mtshams zor bskyed gsungs rjes gsol tshogs grol/ de rjes dung pa gnyis nas bde yangs shar du snyan gsan thengs gsum btang / gsum pa'i mjug sde pa khri pa dang / dge skos gnyis nas spos sne dang / de mjug mchod g.yog dang / rnga rol ba mi grangs 16gzan rkyang gnyis/ dung rgya bzhi/ mchod bzhengs pa gnyis/ gser skyems pa gnyis bcas dbu mdzad kyi g.yas gasku1na nas gral nyis sgrigs kyis phebs te bde yangs shar gyi mthil du phebs pa dang / tshang mas zhal 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung la phyogs te zhwa phud zhus te 'cham gur 'og rang rang bzhugs gral la 'khod/ dbu mdzad bzhugs khri'i steng bzhugs te rol mo rin chen 67

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/rlon pa phyag g.yas gamatshen bsnams nas brjid nyams chen po'i ngang nas byin 'bebs mdzad/ de mjug 'cham chos rgyal gtso 'khor bco brgyad dang /dur bdag bzhi/ zhwa nag nyi shu rtsaganyis/ shwa ba gcig twa shang 'khor bcas/ 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos sog yul gyi 'cham nas dper bzhes te gsar btsugs gnang ba ching mgon po tshe ring bcas 'cham pag 47 nas 'cham bskyon/ 'cham mjug gtor 'phen mdzad/ tshes 30 nyin tshoms chen nub tu gnam lo gsar tshes kyi tshes gtor byin 'bebs the1ba/sa/zur tshogs khagagrwa khang 'og rgyun bskang ba rnams nas bca' yig nang gsal gyi srung spyi'i bskang gso/ nub rgyud nyi 'od du rgyun bskang bzhi nas lha zhal gtso gyur gyis srung spyi'i bskang gso chag med/ yi dam lha khang dang / blo blangs khang du gsang bde 'jigs gsum res mos kyi bdag 'jug chag med/ byams khang du mi gnyis nas dus 'khor chag med/ gser gdung dge legs 'dod 'jor mi gnyis nas srung spyi'i bskang gso'i thog sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i rigs gsum spyi sgrub dang / gtor ma brgya rtsa/ dregs pa'i sde dpon/tsha gsur bcas dang / yar ngor sku zhabs brgyad grwa gcig gis spyan ras 68

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/gzigs 'jig rten dbang phyug gi tshes bcu dang / mar ngor rta mgrin khams gsum zil gnon gyi tshes cu chag med/ pho brang dbu rtse'i dgra lha khang du dung rgya mi bzhi nas zla re'i tshes 3/5/8/15/ bcas nyin bzhi la dgra lha chag med/ de yang tshes 5 la rgyags rngan las de min gsum la bkra shis 'khyil ba btang dgos/ rtser lo 'khor gcig gi nang spyan gzigs khang du sku zhabs brgyad grwa nas sgrol dkar dang rig byed ma'i bsnyen chen dang /rgyun zin mi gnyis/ grwa shag khang gsar du dus 'khor chog grwa ba'i khongs nas res mos kyi dus 'khor bsnyen mtshams pa gnyis/ dus yun zla ba gsum re'i mtshams brje len/ rgyal po lcog tu sku zhabs bzhi nas phur ba'i mtshams/dus yun zla ba gnyis re'i mtshams brje len/ zla ba dgu pa'i nang sku zhabs brgyad grwa gcig nas 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bsnyen pa/ dus yun zla ba gnyis dang phyed/ bod zla gnyis pa'i tshes gcig nas sku zhabs bzhis rgyal po lcog tu sad srung dang / zhal 'don rje bla ma'i sgo nas dmigs brtse ma 'bum bzhi dang / dpa' gcig las rung / rdo rje rnam sbyong / sad srung gsor sgrub/ dus yun zla ba gnyis lhag tsam dang / de rjes grwa shag sad srung khang du bod zla 9 tshes da bar rgyun srings dang 'brel sad srung /de'i ring tho rangs nam mkhar sprin med tshe/ rje bla ma'i cho ga dang 'brel yang 69

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/steng nag phyogs bzhir ḍa ma ru dkrol dgos/ ḍa ma ru rje bla ma'i phyag bzhes yin par grags/ tshe gling / gdong dkar/ dge 'phel/ dog bde'i nang bcas sa yul bzhir/ sgrub pa 'khor lo 'dzugs chog zhus/ de rnams ni grwa tshang nas dmigs bsal spyi tshogs kyi zhabs 'degs yin 'dug zla ba gnyis pa nas gzim chung bde ldan 'khyel du sa bcud bum sgrub tu gzhung nas do dam par mkhan chen gcig ched phebs thog sku zhabs brgyad grwa gcig bcas nas/ bum bcud la bum rdzas dang / gzungs/ ril bu sogs gra sgrig legs par zin mtshams sgrub bzhag gnang rgyur/ thog mtha' bar gsum du spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gis dbus/ sku'i yongs 'dzin/ mtshan zhabs la sogs pa rnams chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyangs/ sgrub bzhag grub rjes sku zhabs gsum nas lha ldan nye 'khor/ gdong dkar dang 'bras spungs gling nang khag gsum/ de bzhin se ra/ dge 'phel/ ram pa mtsho/ gnyan kha/ dpal lha'i mtsho/ 'dam ra chen mor khag gnyis bcas sa gnas so sor bum pa sba chog zhus/ phyir bskyod khag la sku zhabs gcig dang / rgyud stod grwa tshang nas rgyud grwa gcig gzhung gi a drung gcig bcas nas gtsang phyogs yul khag dang / de bzhin/ dwags kong yul khag dang / lho khul/yar 'brog khul/ byang khul bcas so sor phebs te sba chog mdzad/ yang 70

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/lo gnangs 'char byang du thang lha gserdzol ched sku zhabs brgyad grwa gcig nas gnyan chen thang lha'i rten mkhar du bdun gnyis gsum ring lo gnyis kyi thang lha'i gzab gsol thog bskang bshags bsags/ yangs can 'go pa tshebyung dang sbas tshang sde pa thun mong nas rten khang gi dam kha bkrol te/ lo gnyis kyi rten rdzas khag phul/ gdugs dang rgyal mtshan rnams gsar brje zhus rjes khungs so so nas dam phru brgyab de mjug slob dpon rin po ches thang lha dam 'dogs gnang yul/ sher phug tu bum pa sba chog dang / byang nam mtsho'i khar nyin bdun gyi ring bstan ma'i bskangs bshags dang / lha mo'i mdos gzhung khag gsungs/ mjug tu sde pa chu gnyer dang thun mong du mtsho rdzas khag phul/ bod zla 4 pa'i nang char 'bebs su/ e mtsho/ ga lar mtsho/ zhog mtsho/ mi 'khrug mtsho/ rol pa'i mtsho/ sman chen mtsho bcas par sku zhabs brgyad grwa gcig phyogs phebs kyis nyin bdun ring rje bla ma'i cho ga dang 'brel mtsho so sor bum pa sba chog mdzad/ 7gong sa mchog nor gling du sku bzhugs mdzad ring / sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po dang / mchod gzim gnyis/ dbu mdzad/ gsung bzang ba lnga / dung rgya bzhi bcas nor gling bca' bzhugs thog tshes gcig nam yin la lha mo dang bstan ma gnyis kyi dus gtor dang / tshes 8 la gur/ zhal/71

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi ches rgyus/lcam sring gsum gyi dus gtor/ tshes 29 la mgon po phyag drug pa'i dus gtor rnams chag med/ klu thebs yod rigs la nor gling klu khang du dkon gnyer gsum dang / gsung bzang ba gcig bcas nas klu gtor chag med/ bod zla 9 pa'i nang mchod bzhengs mi grangs bcu nas gzim chung khag gi 'dzugs gtor rnams nyin gnyis kyi nang gsar brje zhus rjes/nyin gcig 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur bka' drin che thog mgon po gtsor gyur gyi srung spyi'i gzab gsol gzab rgyas tshugs dgos pa bcas bod du lo 'khor gcig nang ltar chags su 7rgyal ba'i chos phyogs kyi mdzad chen khag la sogs par gsung zhabs zhu sgo'i mdzad rim mdo tsam lags so//grwa tshang gi mchod gzhis/gangs ljongs bstan srid bde don slad ched 'dzugs mdzad pa'i gong du 'khod pa'i sgrub mchod dang / gtor sgrub la sogs pa'i bsnyen bkur mchod phogs kyi ched du 7rgyal dbang sku phreng na rim nas dang / rgyal tshab gzhung sa mchog bcas nas mchod gzhis ma lag ga31la bstsal byung ba khag ba/zha34 bkatra/05/72

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'e1 rgyus/zur khang phun tshogs gling gzhis/ rdo pho brang gzhis/ gzhis kha shar/ pi'u gzhis/ rje btsun rdzong gzhis chung / skyed pa gzhis chung / bsam 'grub bde chen gzhis/ bsam 'grub shar/ yar stod dpal grong gzhis lag rtse thang dpal grong gzhis lag lho brag steng chen gzhis chung / tshal sna gzhis chung / zas yang dkar chu 'khor/ rnye thang sgo gzhis ka/ sga tog pho brang gzhis chung / spang shugs gzhis chung / sras chung chu 'khor/gang ba gzhis/ rwa mo che gzhis/ stod lung ser ma gzhis/ snang rtse nang gong gzhis chung / stod lung gram gzhis/ smon mkhar gzhis/ e ka gzhis/ thang skya gzhis/ nyin mtshan bde legs gzhis chung / 'phan po phu shar gzhis ka/ lcang 'edze can gzhis ka/ zhog gzhis ka/ zhog gzhis ka/ nang shar gzhis ka/ ya ru gzhis chung / spo 'dod gzhis/ spo 'dod la tshang a khog gzhis/ spo 'dod shar phyogs a khu gzhis/ se sgang gzhis ka/ thar gling gnyer tshang / gdong dkar rgyal po sha ma bcas gzhis ka ma lag dang / grwa tshang khongs kyi ru ba'am 'brog sde/ rdo'i phu nang gcig glo'i nang gcig gnyes thang phu nang gnyis/ stod lung gram gyi phu nang gcig 'phan po phu shar nang gcig zhog phu nang 'brog sde khag bdun/ cub mda' nang gcig byang khul du/ yangs pa can nang 'brog sde 73

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/gcig yang skyes ru lung nang gcig bcas ru ba dang / gzhis ma lag bcas kyi nas lo re'i byung 'bab kyi steng nas sku zhabs brgya dang bdun cu don bzhi la zla rer rtsam phogs khal gnyis dang bre bcu dang / lo lubor gcig gi nang bzhes zas snum sreg sum brgya drug cu phul dgos pa nas nyis brgya gnyis ngo 'bul dang / de 'phros dod phul srol/ yang yin tog grangs dgu bcu/ snun zo ba bdun/ mar khal gnyis/ 〈sna zhib khal gnyis/ gnangs 'char la tsha khal re dang / bu la tog khal phyed re/ bu rol che ba gsum dang / chung ba gnyis/ rin chen tshal gyi sgrub mchod skabs bzhes zas dzoster re/ bkras khang khongs nas chab zhugs nyin gnyis la bzhes zas bcud sder re bcas lo ltar phul dgos/ snga dus gzhis ka khag dang / ru ba bcas pa bkras khang dang / phyag mdzod/ sbrug khongs bcas gsum nas rang rang gzhis ka khag la sogs pa 'dzin skyong gnang srol dang / rang re'i zhal rgyun du gzhis ma lag bcu gsum zer ba'ang bkras khang gcig pu'i khongs las/ phyag mdzod dang sbug khongs gnyis kyi khongs kyi gzhis ka khag gzhis ma lag bcu gsum nang tshud med/ dus phyis tshang ma mnyam sgril gyis spyi 'dzin bzo gnang mdzad pa dang / de dag gi 'dzin skyong gnang byed mkhan sku zhabs drug dang / de'i 'og las byed bzhi bcu skor yod 'dug74

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edzi rgyus/don tshan gsum pa/1959 lor spyi nor 7gong sa mchog rgya gar sa thog tu chibs bsgyur bskyangs 〉tsher/don tshan gsum pa'i nang gses dang po/spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog sku gzhon nu'i dus nas chos srid kyi mdzad pa rlabs po che bskyangs par ma zad/ bod yul bod kyis rang dbang gi sgo nas 'dzin skyong byed chog pa dgos pa dang / rgya dmar gzhung la'ang kha dan tshig la gnas pa byed dgos pa'i bka' nan chen po gnang ba/ lhag par rgya che'i bod mi mang tshogs nas 7gong sa mchog la blo gtad yid ches rtsegacig tu zhus pa bcas la rgya dmar nas mi bzod pa'i phrag dog gis phyogs gcig nas bod mir drag gnon byed shugs che ru btang ba dang /gnyis nas 7be nga sa mchog dmag sgar la gzigs mor gdan zhu zhus nas sku phyur sdo ba'i bya spyod kyi rnam 'gyur nyin bzhin ma bsdad par mngon gsal sde dod du song bar brten/ phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 17 sa phag zla 2 tshes 8 nyin 7gong sa mchog ston 'khor nor gling nas chibs thon gyis phebs lam sogs la sku ngal tshad med bzhes skor gsung rnam rin po cher gsal bas 'dir ma spros/ phyi zla 4 tshes 5 nyin 7gong sa 75

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/chen po ston gabor lhan rgyas mon rta dbang dgon du phebs 'byor bskyangs/ spyi nor 7gong sa mchog mon rta dbang dgon du bzhugs rgyun skabs bkras zur thub bstan tshul khyems la sdurdzogs pa'i rang grwa sku zhabs brgyad rgya gar sa mtshams su 'byor ba'i 7snyan seng sgron phul zhus/ de nyin bod zla zhatshes 15 khel bas bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i dus mchod bka' drin bskyangs/ sku'i chibs zhabs kyi gras su sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po thub bstan bsod nams dang / mchod gakrerdzog thub bstan 'jam dbyangs/ gzim gasku1ga thub bstan thabs mkhas bcas sku bcar zhu thub pa byung / rgya gar sa thog tu phebs mtshams/ rgya gar dbus gzhung dang mi dmangs bcas nas bod don thog gdung sems mnyam bskyed dang 'brel phebs sgrigs gzab rgyas zhus pa dang / 7be|nga sa mchog rgya gar sa thog tu sku khams bde bo'i ngang zhabs sor 'khod thub pa byung bar/ rgya gar gzhung dang mi dmangs khri khrag mang po bcas nas dga' bsu gus 'dud kyi dga' 'bod 'brug stong ldir ba lta bu'i ngang nas/ phyi zla 4 tshes 30 nyin sku 'khor lhan rgyas sa gnas ma su rir zhabs sor bde bar bkod/76

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/don tshan gsum pa'i nang gses gnyis pa/byes 'byor bod mi'i 'phrod sku zhabs lnga bcu nga gnyis lha sa nas bros te rgya gar sa thog du 'byor tshul/gang gi zhabs rjes su 'brangs pa'i btsan byol ba bod mi khri phrag brgal ba rgya gar dang / 'brug bal bcas khag gsum nang khros 'byor thub pa'i khongs su sku zhabs lnga bcu nga gnyis rgya gar sa thog tu phebs 'byor thub pa byung / de yang phyi lo 1959 zla 3 tshes 19 snga dro chu tshod da pa'i thog rtse pho brang dang / nor gling / lha sa grong khyer bcas su rgya dmar nas me sgrogs kyis gtor bzhig shugs chen btang rkyen bod mi stong phrag mang po'i lus srog 'dor dgos byung ba dang / rtser me sgrogs brgyab rkyen grwa tshang gi sku zhabs kha shas rkyen 'das su gyur/ de byings pho brang nang du sdod blos ma bzod par tshes 19 dgong dro dang / tshes 20 nyin gyi dgong dro pho brang la me rjeXgs rgyag mus kyi skabs su lus la gang 'phyar las gzhan gang yang med par rtsenas bros te nyang ra'i phu brgyud 'phan por sku zhabs phal cher 'byor thub pa byung 'dug kyang / de khul pha ma dang spun mched yod rigs dang / gzhan yang ring min gnas tshul zhi 'jam yong res phyir log bya rgyu'i 77

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/re 'dod shar te sku zhabs mang po zhig de gar bzhugs 'dug kha shas lam bar bsad pa'i gnas tshul byung ba dang / sku zhabs gnyis gangs rdib 'og 'das grongs gyur/ de min lho kha brgyud mtsho sna dang / rma mgo gro yul bcas lam khag gsum la dka' ngal chen po spyad de mthar rgya gar sa thog tu 'byor thub pa byung / yang sku zhabs sku bcar blo bzang dga' ba lags dang /ye shes sbyin pa gnyis 'gro lam sogs kyi sku ngal gyis nyin grangs mang po'i ring ri khugs nang zas gos sogs kyi shin tu sku ngal chen po'i ngang nas bzhugs dgos byung ba dang mthar ri la ri brgyud kyis rgya gar du phebs 'byor thub pa byung pa bcas/ ma su ma rir snga phyi bsdoms sku zhabs 47 mnyam 'dzoms thub pa byung zhing / sku zhabs gnyis phyi lo 1960 lo nang dha sar phebs thub pa byung ba bcas khyon rgya gar sa thog tu phebs 'byor thub pa/ sku'i chibs zhabs kyi gras su gong 'khod ltar gsum dang / zing 'khrug skabs bzhi bcu zhe bdun/ de mjug gnyis bcas skabs de sku zhabs lnga bcu nga gnyis phebs gnang thub pa byung / ma si ma rir 'byor skabs gtso che spyi nor 7gong sa chen po 'i thugs rje la brten rgya gar gzhung sogs rogs tshogs rnams nas sdod gnas zas gos sman bcos sogs gang cir gra sgrig yag po yod pa der zla ba 2 tsam bzhugs/ skabs der sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po nas 78

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/'dus tshogs su nyin sgor sum brgya gtong gnang mdzad/ zla ba gnyis pa'i zla mjug tu gdan sa gsum gyi bla sprul dang dge bzhes/ gzhan yang bgres gras bcas ḍal hor du gtong gnang mdzad pa de'i khongs su grwa tshang gis kyang sku zhabs bgres gras 25 gtong gnang mdzad pa dang / de byings gzhon pa rnams sbag sar gtong ba gnang / sbag sar yod pa'i gzhon gras khongs nas sku zhabs blo bzang dga' ba lags dang / sku zhabs sbyin pa bstan 'dzin lags/ ḍal hor nas sku zhabs thubs bstan chos dbyangs lags bcas ma su rir gsung zhabs su bka' 'gug gnang / ḍal hor dang sbag sa sa gnas so sor rgya gar gzhung nas gnas khang sogs gra sgrig gnang ste dka' ngal che ba ma byung yang / sku zhabs rnams 'tsho khag gnyis su gyes par brten bstan srid kyi zhabs rim sgrub rgyu sogs la sa gnas gcig tu mnyam 'dzoms bzhugs thub byung na dge mtshan che lugs mchod dpon mkhan po nas bka' slob dang 'brel sa gnas so so nas kyang rgya bod 'go 'dzin khag la snyan seng rim pa zhus 'bras bka' 'khrol thob ste/ sbag sar gnas sdod sku zhabs rnams ḍal hor du spo bzhugs mdzad/ de mjug bzhugs sgar ma su ri nas sku bcar mchod dpo na mkhan po brgyud grwa tshang la bka' yig phebs pa'i dgongs don gar dpon thub bstan rin chen dang / gsung bzang rgan pa ngag dbang 79

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bkra shis gnyis gang myur ma su rir yong dgos zhes bka' yig phebs don ltar/ khong gnyis sku bcar zhus/ ma su rir spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas mjal kha'i thog gar dpon thub bstan rin chen grwa tshang gi slob dpon las tshab dang / ngag dbang bkra shis dbu mdzad las tshab/ ḍal hor gnas sdod sku zhabs thub bstan bde bzhegs dge bskos la bsko gzhag dang sbrags/khong gnyis kyi mdun grwa tshang gi rten gtsor/ sku rten gser zangs kyi ston pa'i snang brnyan gcig dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi ba'i snang brnyan gcigagasung rten du byang chub lam rim chen mo pod gcig thugs rten du rdo dril rtse dgu ma gcig gzhan yang las bum gcig dngul gyi ting kha lo ma bdun tshar gcig dngul kong gnyis/ maṇḍal gcig bcas gsol stsal thog sngar yod grwa tshang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i cho ga phyag len khag mi nyams rgyun 'dzin thub pa dgos gal gyis bka' slob spyi bor phebs/ de mjug sku zhabs gnyis ḍal hor du phyir log mdzad/ rten gtso gsol stsal byung ba rnams bzhugs yul dmigs bsal lcerdogs khang med pas/ sku zhabs bgres gras kyi bzhugs gnas su gdan 'dren gyis bzhugs su gsol/ 'dus mang thog bka' slob zab mo rnams snyan sgron zhus par/ sku zhabs rnams dga' skyo'i tshor ba smra mi shes pa zhig byung ba dang / tshang mas spyi nor 7gong 80

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/sa mchog gi bka' slob dang / rang re'i grwa tshang rin po che'i la rgya bcas la brten nas sngar las lhag pa'i sems shugs bskyed de/ snga dgong dus tshod nam byung la dpe cha dkon pa'i rigs dpe cha 'bri rgyu dang / de bzhin skyor sbyangs/ las seng la bstan srid kyi zhabs rim bsgrub rgyu/ de min rgyun ldan bod mi spyi mtshungs ltar/ rang rang bzo grwa khag dang / lam bzo sogs la bskyod pa/ zla re rang gis dka' ngal khyad bsad byas nas byung pa'i dngul phogs nas sum cha gcig grwa tshang spyi sar mngon lkog spu tsam med par dga' pa'i ngang las sner rtsis sprod zhus pa bcas/ ḍal hor du gnas sdod bod mi rnams kyi mig dpe lta bur gyur yod/ phyi lo 1960 lor bzhugs sga dha ram sa lar spo bzhugs mdzad rjes spyi nor 7gong sa mchog bod mi'i sdod gnas lcam pa lam bzo dang / ḍal hor khul gyi bod mi ser skya skusnangs kyi gnas stangs la gzigs zhib dang 'brel rang cag kha ba ri ba'i lha skal 'phags mchog thugs rje chen po'i bka' dbang dang mjug tu bka' slob shin tu mche stsal/ de rjes gdan sa khag dang / rgyud grwa stod smad/mi dmangs bcas kyi sdod gnas khag la gzigs skor bka' drin bskyangs/grwa tshang gi sdod khang la lhod bzhugs thog de'i nyin spyi nor 7gong sa chen po'i sku'i 'khrungs skar gyi nyin mo yin par brten/ sngar srol 'khungs skar nyin 81

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'odze rgyus/gyi mdzad sgo mdor bsdus shig bka' drin bskyangs/ dbu spyi nor 7gong sa mchog dbu bzhugs kyis tshogs dmangs dang lhan du zhal 'don gyi dang por bod 'bangs yongs la bka' drin gyi bdag nyid sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i smon tshig rtsepho brang gi thog brtsegs gnyis pa'i thad rtsig rdo'i steng bris brkos gnang ba/mkhyen rtse bdag nyid rje btsun spyan ras gzigs/ /dpal ldan mkhas btsun bzang po'i zlos gar gyi/ /rnam rol mchog gi sprul sku yid bzhin nor/ /blo bzang bstan pa'i dpal du zhabs brtan shog /ces pa sngon du gsungs pa'i sgo nas/ 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i bdag bskyed bsgoms/ de'i mjug bstan srung rgya mtsho'i dbus nas mngon par 'phags pa 7rgyal dbang sku phreng na rim gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i bka' srung dpal ldan lha mo dang / rdo rje grags ldan gnyis dang srung spyi'i 'phrin bcol bcas thugs smon gnang smin gyis bka' drin bskyangs/ de ni rgya gar du phebs rjes kyi 'khrungs skar mdzad sgo dang po yin par ma zad/ dus 'gyur rjes grwa dmangs nas 7gong sa mchog gi zhal mjal gsung thos dang po yin par brten/ 7rgyal dbang mchog mjal ba dang tshang ma dbang med kyis 82

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/mig chu shor ba la sogs dga' skyo zung 'brel gyi tshor ba shugs drag dang bcas rang yul dran pa zhig byung 'dug mgon po mchog nas dmigs bsal bka' slob dang 'brel/ grwa tshang rten gtsor bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi sku brnyan byin can/ deng skabs grwa tshang lhan rgyas khang du bzhugs pa 'di dang / sgrol ljang gi sku thang gcig shin tu ngo mtshar che ba'i dpal ldan lha mo'i zhal 'bag deng skabs theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang yang steng lha mo khang gi lha mo'i zhal brnyan du bzhugs pa sogs thugs smon rgya che'i sgo nas gsol ras stsal ba dang sbrags/ gtso cher grwa tshang gi cho ga phyag len sngar yod rnams slar sor chud thabs su dgongs nas gzhon gras gang 'tshams shig gsung bzang du bsko bzhag dang / grwa tshang gi cho ga phyag len slar sor chud ༷thabs kyi 'gro song gi mthun rkyen dmigs rten du hir sgor 1000 chig stong tham pa gsol ras stsal/ de mjug ḍal hor nas dha sar bzhugs sgar du gsung zhabs 'phar mar/ sku zhabs thub bstan ngag dbang dang / bstan 'dzin chos ldan/ ngag dbang rig sgrol gsum bka' 'gug gnang ba dang / gzhan yang dus tshod nges med bstan srid kyi zhabs rim sgrub ched dbu chos gnyis sogs sku zhabs rnams sku bcar zhu dgos par brten/ lam bar skad brda ma 'phrod pa'i dka' ngal dang / gtso 83

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/cher rang gzhung phyag gron chung khyad du dgongs te sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po mchog gi dbus dha sar bca' bzhugs gsung zhabs pa rnams nas rang gzhung las khungs khag la ngo bcar gyis gong gi gnas lugs la brten ḍal hor du gnas sdod grwa tshang gi sku zhabs rnams 'di ga dha sar zla sgril yong thabs zhes snyan seng zhu mus thog ḍal hor nas grwa tshang gi 'thus mir sku zhabs skal bzang chos 'byor dha sar ched rdzong gnang ba ltar 'di gar bca' bzhugs sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po mchog dang / gsung zhabs rnams tshang 'dzoms thog gong gsal gnas tshul snyan seng zhus pa dang / de ltar byung na legs tshul spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas chos don bka' blon lcog steng thub bstan nor bzang la bka' mngags gnang ba bcas la brten bka' bzhes zab mo thob ste sku zhabs skal bzang chos 'byor gyi mdun 7gong sa mchog nas dge 'dun rer hin sgor 15 re gsol ras stsal ba dang / sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po brgyud grwa tshang spyi sar hin sgor 6000 drug stong tham pa sku sger yig tshang nas snga g.yar zhus te ḍal hor du phyir log gnang / dmigs bsal dha sar sku bcar zhu pa'i las don grub 'bras dang / dge 'dun rer nyin sgor 15 gsol stsal gnang ba bcas tshogs mang thog gsal snyan seng zhus/ de mjug phyi lo 1961 zla 11 nang rang 84

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/gzhung chos don lhan khang nas ḍal hor don gcod khang du bka' yig phebs pa'i nang / der yod rnam grwa gsung zhabs pa rnams rang rang skyob gso'i lag deb dang sbrags dha sar 'phral gtong dgos zhes bka' phebs/ don gcod nas kyang 'dus tshogs thog gsal bsgrags gnang ste/ phyi zla 11tshes 13 nyin ḍal hor gnas sngerdzod sku zhabs rnams rda sa bzhugs sgar du gnas spos zhus/ dha sar sdod khang / bka' blon lcog steng nas 7rgyal ba'i pho brang dang / thag nye 'brel mtshungs na ro ji ko krir sdod gnas bzo gnang mdzad par der rgya gar gnas 'ashesad sku zhabs tshang ma tshang 'dzoms thub pa byung / ko kri'i byang ngos su sku'i yongs 'dzin 7skyabs rje khri byang rdo rje 'chang mchog gi bzhugs yul dang / grwa tshang gi tshogs khang dang / lha mo khang / grwa shag rung khang / gnyer tshang bcas yin 'dug de'i lo'i bod zla 12 nang sngar srol lo mjug gi mchod pa khag dang / lo gsar tshes gtor bcas kyi mchod pa gang rgyas bzhengs/ tshes 30 nyin pho brang tshoms chen du spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyangs thog 'dus dmangs dang lhan du tshes gtor byin 'bebs tshugs/de'i skabs sku zhabs su la'ang na bza' grwa chas bzhes rgyu med par/ tshang ma skyob gse'i gos phogs bzhes te gsol tshogs la phebs par/ gzhung 85

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/zhabs rgan gras rnam pa sogs phyi nang gi mi kun yid skyo ba'i gnas tshul zhig byung 'dug tshes 1 nyin dpal ldan lha mo'i tshes gtor tshogs dbur spyi no ra 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur dang / de bzhin sku'i yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis dang / bla sprul/ gzhung zhabs ser skya krerdzongs rdzogs/ grwa tshang 'dus mangs dang bcas nas 'edze gsar gyi mdzad sgo gzab rgyas gnang /de ni rgya gar du 7zhabs sor 'khod rjes spyi nor 7gong sa mchog dbu bzhugs 'og grwa tshang tshogs mang nas tshes gtor phul ba dang po yin 'dugargya gar du slar yang grwa tshang gsar 'dzugs bskyangs tshul/don tshan gsum pa'i nang gses gsum pa/phyi lo 1962 lor dha sa na ro ji ko krir sku zhabs rnams tshang 'dzoms byung rjes gtso che spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gi thugs rje bka' drin dang / sku zhabs rnam pa'i lhag bsam dang snying stobs bcas las/ 7rgyal dbang na rim nas gangs ljongs kyi bstan srid bde thabs kho nar dgongs te thugs smon mtshams sbyor rgya che dang bcas 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa'i sgrub 86

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/mchod che khag dang / bstan srung khag gi gtor sgrub/ de min phyag srol bzang po gang sku1da pa rnams phyi nang gi mthun rkyen 'dzoms rim bzhin slar gso mdzad de rdul tshon dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i sgrub mchod rim bzhin tshugs thub pa byung / 1959 che1 nas 1962 lo bar phyi'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms min yang grwa tshang rin po che'i thun mong ma yin pa'i yid dam bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor 'isna'i dus mchod ma chad par tshugs par gnang / de yang gong du 'khod pa ltar/ 1959 lor spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gi dbus chibs khongs gsung zhabs pa rnams nas mon rta dbang dgon par tshugs gnang pa dang / 1960 'itsher ma su ri/ 1961 lor dha sar pho brang rnying pa mārba a she ram du mchod chas sogs yod byad 'dzoms pa med stabs sku zhabs mchog gasku1ga thub bstan 'jam dbyangs nas 3snag bu'i steng dus 'khor sku gsung thugs kyi dkyil 'khor cha tshang zhig gsar bzhengs kyis sgrub mchod tshugs pa bcas 7rgyal dbang sku 'phreng bdun pa chen pos thugs smon mtshams sbyor rgya che'i ngang 'dzugs gnang mdzad pa nas bzung / da lta'i bar yid dam 'di'i dus mchod ma chad par lo ltar tshugs thub pa 'di ni bcom sa dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi gsor lo dang ngo bo dbyer ma mchis pa spyi nor 7gong sa chen pos dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'chad nyan la brten 87

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi che1 rgyus/nas bstan pa dang sems can gyi don rgya chen po mdzad pa'i thugs rjer mngon/de'i skabs gter ston bsod rgyal lugs kyi phur pa'i sgrub mchod tshugs rgyu'i mchod chas sogs kyi mthun rkyen ma tshang yang / gangs ljongs skye 'gro'i bde thabs ched yi dam 'di nyid kyi sgo nas gtor sgrub thengs kha shas tshugs pa dang / gtor sgrub kyi dbu bzhugs su 7gong sa mchog dang / skabs 'ga' zhig tu grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po dil mgo mkhyen brtse rin po che dbus pa'i ris meng kyi bstan 'dzin gyi skye bu dam pa mang po zhabs sor 'khod/phyi lo 1968 lor sud si gnas sdod rtse drung blo bzang chos 'phel nas sbyin bdag zhus te phur pa'i sgo nas bdud rtsisman sgrub kyi sgrub pa tshugs/ gzhan yang / 62 'itshe nas bzung bod zla 3 tshes 8 la 'char can brgyad gtor dang / lo mjug gi dgu gtor chen mo bcas tshugs/ dgu gtor gyi 'cham mi grangs ma ldang ba dang / phyi'i mthun rkyen ma 'dzoms pa bcas kyis dus da lta'ang skyar gso ma thub par lus yod na rang re gzhon gras rnams nas de dag la mkhas shing byang chub pa'i bgres pa rnams kyi drung nas bslab dgos rgyu gal cher mthong / phyi lo 1961 lo dang 1962 lo so sor rang gzhung chos don las khang gi chog mchan bka' 'khrol dang 'brel grwa tshang nas mchod chas kyi mthun rkyen zhal 'debs zhu mi ka rdor khul du sku 88

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/zhabs 'jam dpal snyan grags dang / sku zhabs ngag dbang bzod pa gnyis dang / bal yul khul du sku zhabs blo bzang tshe ring dang / bstan 'dzin thogs med gnyis/ la dwags khul du sku zhabs thub bstan zla ba dang / sku zhabs ngag dbang bzod pa gnyis bcas gtong ba gnang / de yang ka rdor khul du phebs mi gnyis la grwa tshang nas bskur ba'i zhal 'debs slong yig nang don 'di ltar ste/ ka rdor khul sogs su bzhugs pa'i bod rigs dad gtong ldan pa rnams la zhu rgyur/ sku bcar phan bde legs bshad gling pa dge 'dun zhal grangs lnga bcu nga gnyis 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i 7zhabs rjes su skyabs bcol la ngo bcar thub pa rnams 'tsho bsdus kyis rang lugs gzhi gsum dang / gzhung lugs mdo sngags kyi phyag bzhes che phra mi nyams gong 'phel lhag brtson zhu mus yin yang / mchod chas kyi rigs gang yang ma 'byor zhing / gzhan yang 'dus spyir mthun rkyen gang ci'i cha nas dka' ngal che rkyen/ da lam de phyogs dge 'dun gnyis ched gnyer zhus pa bzhin sbyin bdag ser skya lhag bsam can rnams nas mchod chas kyi rigs dang/ spyi phan mthun rkyen sogs kyi dad sbyor phan 'char ci mchis grogs mgon thugs rje che ba nas legs par sbyar ba'i dad rdzas rnams kyang gnang mchan kha gsal gnang skyong zhu rgyur/ de dag bar ma do ru ma song 89

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/ba dge 'dun gyi spyi rdzas rang la smin nges zhu rgyu yin pa bcas tshang ma'i dgongs par 'jags 'tshal/ dha ram sa la nas phran sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po thub bstan bsod nams dang / rnam grwa slob tshab thub bstan rin chen 'dus tshogs thun mong nas 1961 phyi zla 9 tshes 1 bzang por/ zhes dang / de mjug grwa tshang gi spyi dam 'khod pa bcas dang / de bzhin bal yul dang / la dwags khul nas bkras lhun sngags chog pod cha tshang gcig dang / dngul kong che ba ngo grangs bzhi/ lhan sgor brgyad stong bcas dang / bal yul khul nas deng skabs rab gnas kyi yo byad cha tshang dang / sbub sil/ sku che chung sna tshogs/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum gyi sku thang / deng skabs gtsug lag khang gi gsung rten gras brgyad stong gser bris ma dang / 'bum pod bcu gnyis/ ka rdor khul nas ji ril do grangs brgyad/ phing do po gnyis/ dar tshon do po gnyis/ dngul gyi ka pa li khebs rang 'grigs cha tshang gnyis dang / dngul kong / nyin sgor bzhi brgya skor bcas sa khul so sor phebs mi rnams nas grwa tshang thugs la bcangs te sku ngal 'dzoms med gnang par brten phan 'bras chen po byung yod/ 1963 lor spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gi bka' dgongs bzhin rang gzhung chos don lhan khang nas rgyud smad mkhan zur bsam gtan 90

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/chos 'phel grwa tshang gi mkhan po dang / 7skyabs rje rwa stod rin po che ngag dbang tshul khrims grwa tshang gi slob dpon du bsko gzhagastsal ba'i chos don lhan khang gi bkod rgya'i nang 'khel don/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas bka' slob spyi phebs dgongs don/ gsang chen bla na med pa'i rgyud sde gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi rim gnyis zab mo'i rtsabashad man ngag gi gnad rnams rgyud grwa rnam gnyis su 'chad spel 'dzin skyong nyams med bstan pa rin po che mig rgyan du che ba yod cing / sku bcar phan bde legs ngazhad gling gi grwa tshang 'di nyid la'ang / 'jam mgon tsong kha pa chen po'i lta sgrub gtsang ma'i gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi sgrub mchod dang / bya rgyud kyi cho ga khag mang / gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi lha srung khag gi bskang chogalhag par thun mong ma yin pa dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dkyil chog gar thig dbyangs gsum sogs bzhed srol phyag rgyun rmad po che mtshed mus 'di rnams nyams pa med pa'i thog byang chub lam rim che chung dang / grub ma tha' che chung gang 'os shig gi steng nas bshad rtsod slob khrid 'grel ba bzhi sbrags dang / dpal dus kyi 'khor 'o'i rgyud 'grel man ngag gi 'chad nyan bcas rtsab legs par btsugs thub pa zhig nges par 'byung ba'i dgongs bzhes zab mo yod pa bzhin/ sku bcar phan bde legs bshad gling gi mkhan por 91

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/rgyud smad mkhan zur bsam gtan chos 'phel dang / slob dpon du rwa stod chu dbar sprul sku ngag dbang tshul khrims bsko gzhagastsal te/ mkhan po'i gnang sgo/ 7go sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas 'phral yun kun tu bstan rgyun du sman thabs kyi dgongs bzhes zab mo ji ltar yod pa mtha' dag rim pa bzhin du legs par grub thabs thugs su bcangs te dge 'dun gyi 'dul khrims dang / chos 'chad spel rnams skal ldan dang ba 'dren pa'i gsos su 'gyur nges thugs 'khur che bskyed dang / slob dpon nas kyang grwa tshang gi chos srid gnyis ba'i gzhi mtshugs shing / legs brgya yar rgyas gong dus spel ba'i dus bstun thabs tshul gang la ci 'os blo rtsal gzengs su thon pa'i rgyun sring do 'khur lhod med dgos rgyu bcas/ chos don lhan khang nas 1963 zla 8 tshes 28 la zhes phebs pa de don spyi bor bkur te mkhan slob gnyis grwa tshang du khri 'don mdzad/ sngar slob dpon bsko gzhag gnang srol las/ grwatshang gi mkhan po zhes pa zur du med/ bka' drin mtshungs med dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po bsam gtan chos 'phel lags ni grwa tshang gi mkhanapo dang po yin 'dug de mjug dpe khrid dge rgan du dga' ldan shar rtse'i mkhan zur dge ba'i bzhes gnyen chen po bla tai rin po che dang / ser byes dge bshes rab brtan rnam gnyis grwa tshang du bka' 92

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'i1 rgyus/'gugs gnang / mkhan rin po che nas grwa tshang gi chos phyogs kyi mdzad pa khag thugs 'gan bzhes te sku zhabs rnams la byang chub lam rim chen mo gtsos mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen khag gi dpe khrid/ lhag par 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i dgongs gzhi zab mo 'grub thabs su mkhan rin po che nas sku ngal 'dzems med gnang ste grwa tshang gi gsar zhugs rnams la 1970 'dze nas grub mtha' la rbertegs pa'i gzhung chen khag gi 'chad nyan rtsod grwa gsar 'dzugs skor zhib pa 'og tu brjod rgyu/de bzhin 7skyabs rje rwa stod rin po che nas kyang chos srid kyi phyag las rgya cher gnang ba'i nang tshan/ ṭa khyon dwang slob khang la grwa tshang nas chos kyi slob ston pa gtong rgyu'i skor gtso che dgongs skor bka' slob dang sbrags/ rin po che ṭa tson du ngo phebs kyis rgya bod 'go 'dzin rnams dang phan tshun bka' bsdur zhib mo gnang / grwa tshang nas phebs thub pa byung na dgos pa dge mtshan chen po yod par phan tshun thugs mthun byung ste/ phyi lo 1964 zla 1tshes 13 nyin grwa tshang nas sku zhabs drug gtong gnang dang / khong tsho'i blang dor byed sgo'i sgrig gzhi yang mkhan slob las byed thun mong nas gtan 'bebs gnang yod/ na ro ji ko kri ru sku zhabs rnams la rtsis kyi slob sbyong gsar du btsugs par sbyangs 'bras gang legs byung ba dang / sku 93

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/zhabs drug dmigs bkar rang gzhung dbus sman rtsis khang du slob sbyong la gtong ba gnang / sman rtsis kyi slob sbyong gang legs thon pa'i khongs nas sman rtsis khang gi sman pa'i gras su tshud pa'ang thub pa byung ste deng skabs zhabs 'degs zhus mus su yod pa bcas sku zhabs rnams nas gtso che spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gi lam ston bka' slob thugs dbus su bcang ste rang 'khri'i skabs babs zhu bya rnams 'thus tshang zhus thog yul dus gnas stangs dang 'tshams pa'i shes yon khag la thugs snang chen po gnang / de nas spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gi thugs rjes lo re bzhin byes 'byor bod mi rnams kyi 'tsho gos mthun rkyen bzang du phyin yod pa ltar/ grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi phyi nang mthun rkyen yang legs su phyin par brten/ thog mar grwa tshang gi 'don cha rgyugs chen gyi phyag dpe khag dpar skrun zhus te ma gnas thog bluman phul bar brten rgyud grwa stod smad sogs sngags grwa rnams la phan thogs chen po byung bar ma zad/grwa tshang la yang dpe cha dkon pa'i dka' ngal sel thub pa byung yod/ 1968lor ⑩spyi nor 7gong sa skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi bka' dgongs gzhi bzung rgyas spros kyi bkod pa gtan nas med pa'i theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang rten dang brten pa bcas pa gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i yang steng du 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung dang lha mo khang dang / grwa tshang gi tshogs khang / de'i 94

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/nye 'khris su grwa tshang rang khungs nas 'gro gron btang ste grwa shag thog brtsegs gsum gsar skrun gnang / gtsug lag khang gi rten gtso rnam gsum gyi gzungs 'bul zhabs zhu gtso bo 7skyabs rje rwa stod rin po che nas thugs 'gan rkang bzhes 'og sku zhabs rnams nas zhabs zhu 'thus tshang zhus/ rten gtso thub dbang sku yi seng khri'i bang mdzod nang grwa tshang gnyer khungs nas ja mar dang 'byarigs sogs nor sna byur bur gtams pa phul ba de'i rten 'brel gyis deng gi char 'dus sde 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen gzhung sa mchog la snyan sun zhu ma dgos tsam dang/ gsar zhugs rnams kyang tshogs chos/ slob gnyer la ci bder gzhol chog pa las ri rgyugs lung rgyugs byed mai dgos pa 'di byung ba yin snyam/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das kyi yongs grags gnas chen bzhi'i nang tshan samachog grong du sngar nas bod dgon gnyis yod pa gcig la dwags blo bzang rnam rgyal gyis 'dzin skyong byed pa dang/ gcig a mdo 'jam dbyangs bstan 'dzin gyis 'dzin skyong byed kyi yod 'dug thog mar la dwags blo bzang rnam rgyal gyis dgon pa la dwags nang pa'i chos tshogs su phul ba dang / chos tshogs nas spyi nor 7gong sa chen por 'bul lam zhus/ de rjes a mdo 'jam dbyangs bstan /'dzin nas rang dgon spyi nor 7gong sa chen por 'bul lam zhus pa bcas 7gong sa mchog nas dgon 95

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/chung gnyis kyi 'dzin skyong grwa tshang nas byed dgos pa'i bka' slob dang sbrags gsol ras stsal/ 1970 phyi zla 1 tshes 15 nyin 'char gzhi sngon phul ltar grwa tshang lhan steng nas dgon pa'i 'dzin skyong byed por sku zhabs 'jam dpal snyan grags dang/ bstan 'dzin thogs med/ sku zhabs ngag dbang brtson 'grus bcas ched gtong mdzad/ de nas rim bzhin grwa tshang rang khongs dang/ dha sa dbus sman rtsis khang bcas nas zhal 'debs gserdzol stsal/gzhan yangadagon pa'i 'gan 'dzin sazhabs khungs su khrims mthun byung rigs khag nas dad ldan bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa sngar yod gtsug lag khang nyams gso dang 'brel dpe mdzod khang dang / gnas bskor ba rnams bzhugs ༷/la makresan khang kha shas bcas gsar skrun zhus pa bcas grwa 'drong gi dgon lag lta bu yin/ 1969 lo'i zla 8 nang na ro ji ka kri nas theg chen chos gling gi grwa shag gsar par gnas spo gnang / grwa shag gi khang ston nyin/ spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog dang/ sku'i yongs 'dzin rnam gnyis bcas chibs bsgyur bka' drin gyis sku sgod bzhugs mdzad/ de bzhin gzhung zhabs ser skya dang / sa gnas dpon rigs bcas kyang gdan zhu sne len gzab rgyas zhus/ don tshan 'di'i nang dmigs bkar gyi brjod rgyu 7rgyal ba gong ma na rim gyis bstan 'gro'i slad du 'dzugs 96

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling rga la rgyus/gnang mdzad pa'i yi dam khag gi sgrub mchod dang / bstan srung rgya mche'i gtor sgrub sogs skyar gso mdzad tshul gong du rob tsam 'khod pa ltar/1969 lo'i gong du skyar gso gnang thub pa byung yod na'ang / de dag so so tshugs pa'i dus ces nges gtan yod par mi snang / 1973 lor spyi nor 7gong sa chen por dgongasachiskor gyis zla dus tshes grangs gtan 'bebs gnang ba bzhin/ deng skabs lo 'khor gcig gi nang sgrub mchod dang / gtor sgrub/ de min mdzad sgo khag gi mdzad rim mdor bsdus 'og tu brjod rgyur brten 'dir ma spros/don tshan bzhi pa/grwa rgyun gsar du 'jug rgyu dang de'i skabs kyi gnas stangs/don tshan bzhi pa'i nang gses dang po/spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i bka' slob dgongs don ltar grwa tshang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes khag mi nyams rgyun 'dzin slad grwa pa gsar du 'dzugs rgyu dang / de rnams nas sngar srol grwa tshang gi cho ga phyag len khag sbyangs brtson byed pa'i thog 1970 lo 97

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/nas spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gi dgongs gzhi dang dgos pa bla na med pas mdo sngags gzhung chen khag sogs sbyong brdar gsar 'dzugs bka' drin bskyangs/ spyi nor 7gong sa chen po'i dgongs gzhi ltar 7skyabs rje rwa stod rin po che nas thugs 'gan rkang bzhes kyi gsar zhugs byed phyogs skor na ro ji ko kri ru mkhan slob rnam gnyis kyis dbus grwa mang tshang 'dzoms kyis bka' bsdur gnang 'bras grwapa gsar pa 'jug rgyu'i thugs thag bcad de gsar zhugs sde tshan dang po/ 1969 lo nas 1970 bar grwa gsar slob bu 28 bcug pa gnang / de yang thog mar grwa tshang du 'dzul chog pa zhes 7skyabs rje rwa stod rin po che'i sku mdun du slob phrug do bdag dang mnyam du rang gi pha ma'am spun mched ngo bcar gyis snyan seng lan mang zhus mthar rin po che nas slob phrug de'i kun spyod dang / shes yon/ rig pa bcas par thugs zhib nan tan gnang ste mthar grwa tshang lhan rgyas dang go bsdur gyis gsar zhugs kyi dge rgan sku zhabs ngag dbang chos 'byor lags dang / sku zhabs thub bstan chos 'phel lags gnyis la rtsis sprod gnang / khong gnyis nas gza' tshes dang bstun 'don chog blo 'dzin bya rgyu 'go btsugs te rgyugs thengs dang por 'jigs byed bdag bskyed thog bskang gso gser zhun ma/ matredzen po chos rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras/ gur/ zhal/ lcam sring 98

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/gsum gyi bskang chog bsdus pa/ sku lnga / rdo rje grags ldan/ 7rgyal ba'i 'khrungs lha/ 'khrungs gsol bcas dge rgan sar 'gro nges thugs blo 'khel ba byung mtshams/ dge rgan gnyis nas sngar srol bod kyi bgres song gi tshab ltabu dus 'khor slob dpon sku zhabs thub bstan rin chen lags su snyan seng zhus/ de nas nyin gcig khong gi sku mdun du cha tshang rgyugs sprod zhu dgos/ de skabs sgra dag gsal gsum yag po yod na khong nas gzim chung du rgyugs 'bul zhus chog pa zhes 7gong sa chen por 7snyan seng phul/ gzim chung nas tshes grangs 'di nyin rgyugs 'bul zhu dgos zhes bka' 'khrol thon mtshams/ gtan 'khel dus tshes nyin dus 'khor slob dpon dang lhan du pho brang la sku bcar zhus te/ 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung nub rgyud zhal 'don khang du thog mar sku phyag gsum phul/ de nas gdan la 'khod/ dus slob nas dpe cha dag bsher gyis gzigs/ dbu mkhyen brtse'i bdag nyid ma nas/ mjug gangs ri rwa bas bskor ba'i zhing khams 'dir/ /phan dang bde ba ma lus 'byung ba'i gnas/ /spyan ras gzigs dbang bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho yi/ /zhabs pad srid mtha'i bar du brtan gyur cig /ces pa'i bar sgra dag gsal gsum ngag zhu dgos/ dus yun chu tshod gsum tsam 'gor gyi yod/ de rjes dus slob dang lhan du mjal kha 99

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/zhus/ rang rang skabs babs dang 'tsham pa'i bka' stsolab rgyas bsdus ci rigs dang phyag srung stsal/ de'i nyin nas slob bu de grwa tshang gi sgrig khungs su tshud pa yin/ rgyugs thengs 'di'i ming la 'tshang rgyugs kyang zer srol yod/ de rjes dge rgan gnyis nas nyin lnga'i ring gung seng bzhag slob phrug gzhan rnams nas slob bu grwa tshang du tshud pa byung de la rten 'brel gyi kha btags gakrerdzogs srol sku(da/ rgyugs thengs gnyis par/ 7rgyal ba'i zhabs brtan dang bde gsang gajigs gsum gyi bdag bskyed nas mjug smon shis bar/ bskang gso gong du 'tshang rgyugs skabs phul ba cha tshang / 'jigs byed kyi sbyin sreg dang / sbyang chog rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs bcas gong bzhin dus 'khor slob dpon nas sku bcar brgyud 7snyan seng zhus te bka' 'khe|la thon mtshams nyi ma gsum la cha tshang rgyugs 'bul zhu datre|sa/nyin mtha' mar mjal kha'i thog blang dor byed sgo'i bka' slob dang / gnang sbyin/ phyag srung bcas gsol ras stsal/ de rjes dge skos la tshogs rgyugs 'bul chog pa zhes snyan seng zhus te bod nang gi sngar srol ltar tshogs rgyugs 'bul dgos/ —tshogs rgyugs thon mtshams slob grwa'i sgrig khongs nas thon pa yin/ slobaphrug rnams skabs re dge rgan gnyis nas nyin gcig sprod gseng la 'khrid kyi yod/ rnam kun dpe cha rgyugs spyod dka' ngal 100

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/che bas de'i nyin ha cang skyid po yong gi yod/ gong zhus ltar dge rgan gnyis dang / de 'og rgan bdag gnyis yod/ rgyun ldan sgrig lam kun spyod nan 'doms byed/ skabs re phan tshun legs spel nyes 'gog ched dge rgan gnyis dbu bzhugs kyis tshogs 'du tshogs kyi sku1da/ slob phrug rnams kyi dpe 'dzin rgyugs sprod dang / rgyun ldan gyi kun spyod bcas la gtso che grwa tshang lhan rgyas dang / de 'og dge rgan gnyis nas rkang 'gan bzhes te tshang mar bka' drin gyis bskyangs yod/ dus 'khor blo 'dzin skyor sbyang /dus 'khor dbu glob gnyis gang rung gi sku mdun du bcar dgos/ dus gsor blo 'dzin zin rjes rgyugs sprod gong bzhin zhu dgos pa dang / de nas grub mtha'i rtsab blo 'dzin byas te/ rgyugs spyod dang po mkhan rin po che'i drung dang / de rjes 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung du 'bul dgos/ dpe cha dag bzher gnang mkhan grwa tshang gi dge bshes gcig phebs kyi yerdzod/ rgyugs 'bul zin pa dang 7gong sa mchog nas mjal kha'i thog rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung drang nges legs bzhad snying po'i phyag dpe gsol stsal dang 'brel gzhung chen khag la slob gnyer mu mthud byed dgos pa'i bka' slob stsal/de rjes gong bzhin tshogs rgyugs 'bul dgos pa bcas 'don chog blo 'dzin rgyugs 'bul zhu tshul be|nga zhus ltar 1969 81 nas 1979 che( 101

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bar gyi grwa tshang du gsar zhugs byed mkhan rnams kyi rgyugs sprod gnang stangs ni deng dus dang mthun par rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs nas brgya cha gnang srol yod/ grwa tshang gi 'don chog yongs su rdzogs pa rgyugs sprod ma zin bar slob grwa'i sgrig khungs su sdod dgos pa dang / slob thon mtshams grwa tshang du sgrig zhugs bya rgyu bcas sngar lam la phran bu 'gyur ba phyin mtshed/ deng skabs kyi gnas stangs ni/ gtso che spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gi thugs rje dang / grwa tshang dbu 'dzin las sne rnam pa'i gzigs skyong bcas la brten nas zas be|sa gnas mal sdurdzogs kyi mthun rkyen gus nas zhu ma datre|sa pa mi kun gyi spyod yul du gyur mdzed na/ mthun rkyen la gzhigs pas grub 'bras yag po ma thon na/ dgos pa ma 'grub pas/ gtso cher 7gong sa mchog dang / dbu 'dzin las sne rnam pas thugs re ji ltar gnang ba ltar/ don 'bras son pa'i 'bad brtson gnang rogs zhes 'bod skul zhu rgyu yin/ bod rgyal lo 2095 lcags khye/ phyi lo 1970 lor theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa gsar bzhengs legs par grub/bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi lubor lo'i dbang chen thengs gsum pa bka' drin stsal/ gnam lo gsar tshes nyin spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas chos rwa dbu 'byed mdzad rgyu thugs gtan 'khel/ mdzad sgo'i 102

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/thog grwa tshang gi gsar zhugs nyi shu skor nas gzhung chen khag la rtags gsal gtong dgos shes mkhan rin po che gzim shag tu 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur gyi bka' slob spyi bor phebs/ gsar zhugs rnams la rang rang rtags gsal gtong rgyu'i gzhung tshig sho lo ka re gsol ras stsal/ da nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen khag la slob gnyer byed dgos pa'i bka' slob spyi bor phebs/ de rjes rang rang la gsol ras stsal ba'i gzhung chen gyi dpe khrid zhu bar mkhan rin po che bsam gtan chos 'phel mchog dang / dpe khrid dge rgan bla tai rin po che/ dge bshes rab brtan lags bcas kyi drung du bcar nas dpe khrid dang / rtags gsal gtong stangs slob sbyong zhus/ gnam lo gsar kyi snga dro'i chu tshod 10 thog spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gtsug lag khang gi chos rwa'i bzhugs khrir zhabs sor 'khod/mdzad sgor rang gzhung gi bka' blon rnam pa dang / sku bcar mchod dpon mkhan po grwa tshang gi mkhan slob 'dus dmangs sogs yod/ grwa tshang nas gsol ja dang bzhes 'bras btegs/ spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas brtsibazhag gsungs/ gsar zhugs rnams kyis rang rang tshigs bcad kyi steng nas rtags gsal btang / rtags gsal grub mtshams 7be|nga sa mchog grwa tshang du mtshan nyid kyi bshad grwa 'dzugs pa gnang ba'i dgos pa dge mtshan 103

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/dang / de ring dngos su 'go 'dzugs zin pa bzhin blo gsar rnams nas slob gnyer mtha' 'khyol ba'i 'bad pa byed dgos pa sogs bka' slob zab rgyas stsal te mdzad sgo grol/ de nas bzung mkhan rin po che nas gsar zhugs rnams la thog mar bsdus grwa nas bzung dpe khrid stsal/ rim bzhin 'dzin grwa gnyis su dbye ba gnang ste 'dzin grwa rgan par bstan 'dzin 'dzin grwa dang / gzhon par dge 'phel 'dzin grwa zhes ming 'dogs pa gnang /'dzin grwa rgan pa dang / sku zhabs bgres gras phebs mi rnams la mkhan rin po che nas dpe khrid gnang ba dang / gzhon pa dge 'phel 'dzin grwar bla ti rin po che nas dpe khrid gnang / nyin re phyed yol rgyab deng skabs ltar rtsod grwa tshugs/ gzhan yang 1970 lo'i zla 11 tshes 1nas bzung snga dro gsar zhugs rnams la sku zhabs mchod gasku1ga thub bstan 'jam da/sgrungs lags dang / 'phrin las dbang rgyal lags rnam gnyis nas dus 'khor dang / bde gsang 'jigs gsum la sogs pa'i dkyil 'khor bris thig bslab pa gnang / de bzhin dus 'khor slob dpon sku zhabs thub bstan rin chen lags dang / sku zhabs ngag chos 'byor lags gnyis nas gar rnams bslab/ de skabs snga dro dha sa meg ghan du grwa tshang dang zlos gar thun mong nas slob grwa zhig gsar 'dzugs gnang ba ltar gsar zhugs 104

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edzi rgyus/rnams/ snga dro'i chu tshod 8 nas 12 bar slob grwar la 'gro dgos/slob grwa der dge rgan dang / yig chas/ dpe mdzod bcas mthun rkyen gang legs 21da pa dang / skabs der gsar zhugs rnams la phan thogs chen po byung yod/ 'on kyang mjug 'khyongs ma thub pa blo pham che/ phyi lo 1972 gro'i zla 2 tshes 21 dgong dro chu tshod 7 pa'i thog 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung du spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas grwa tshang 'dus tshogs la grwa tshang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ma rgyal mtshan gyi tog ltar mngon par 'phags pa dpal ldan lha mo'i rjes gnang rtsal ba dang 'brel/ dpal ldan lha mo 'di nyid ni spyir 7rgyal dbang gong ma rim byon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i srung ma yin pa dang / de 'brel grwa tshang gi srung ma'i rgyal mo lta bu yin pa'i skor bka' slob zab cing rgyas pa stsal/ de nas 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung nub rgyud zhal 'don khang du sku zhabs rnams res mos kyi lha mo'i bsnyen par bzhugs/ 1973 bod zla 2 tshes 1 nas tshes 7 bar spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i bka' dgongs ltar gangs ljongs kyi bstan srid skye 'gro'i bde thabs su rgyal kun 'phrin las gcig tu 'dus pa'i rang gzugs dpal chen rdo rje gzhon nu'i sgo nas gtor sgrub tshugs rgyu'i sngon du 'dus tshogs rnams tshoms chen du phur pa'i bzlas 105

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bsnyen pa bzhugs/ tshes 8 nas dngos gzhi gtor sgrub kyi tshogs dbur spyi nor 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyang mkhan rin po che bsam gtan chos 'phel mchog gis dbus sku zhabs bzhi bcu skor dang / gnas chung sku rten gong ma blo bzang 'jigs med kyis dbus pa'i gnas grwa lnga bcas nas tshes 29 bar gtong sgrub tshugs/ las sbyor skabs kun gyi mthong snang du ya mtshan gyi mtshan ma bzang po byung / de'i skabs nyin gcig tshogs la spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas bka' gnang don 'dus tshogs snga lo pho brang du lha mo'i bsnyen par sdod skabs/ nub gcig nga la rmi lam ya mtshan zhig nga rang lha sa gtsug lag khang gi yang steng gzim chung du yod pa dang / shel khra nang nas mar blta dus de'i 'og la grwa tshang tshogs 'tshogs te 'dug tshogs kyi dbu bzhugs slob dpon a zhe 'bar chag gcig khri'i sgang la bzhugs 'dug pa des nga la bltas te/ grwa pa 'di tshos yag po byed kyi mi 'dug ces brjod de khri las langs te phyin song ba zhig rmis byung / de ni grwa tshang la lha mo thugs mi mnyes pa yin nam snyam pa byung bas tshang mas gzab gzab byed dbe|sa zhes bka' 〈(ba phebs/ tshang mar blo 'tshab dang sems khral chen po byung na'ang / don gnas gang gi thog nas ma mnyes pa byung ba yin pa sus kyang ma shes/ gtor sgrub zin rjes dge 106

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi che( rgyus/'dun rnams nas rang rang 'khos dpag gi zhal 'debs phul ba ltar grwa tshang spyi sa nas dpal ldan lha mor bshags tshogs yang yang 'bul bar ma zad/gtso che skabs bab kyi zhu bya rnams kyang lhag bsam rnam dag gis sngar lhag zhu mus kyang / srung ma bsten phyogs kyi dbang gis lha mo ma mnyes pa byung ba sus kyang ma shes pas mur lus/ phyi lo 1960 lo nas bzung lo ltar bod zla 1 tshes 3 nyin tshes gsum rten gsol skabs tshogs yongs nas srung spyi'i bskang gso'i thog 'brel lo shas kyi gong nas rgyal chen shugs ldan gyi bskang gso gtong mus dang / de bzhin pho brang du dgong dro 'char can sku zhabs bzhi nas srung spyi'i 'phrin bcol gtong skabs kyang rgyal chen gyi bskang chog bsdus pa chag med 'don pa 7skyabs rje yongs 'dzin khri byang rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zla bskang skabs grwa tshang nas chog grwa star chags bcar ba gzhan yang na ro ji ko krir rgya chen gyi bskang bshags rgya che gsog sgrub dang srog gtad zhu mkhan yang re gnyis byung yod/ de 'dra'i dus skabs shig la spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen pos grwa tshang gi mkhan rin po che bsam gtan chos 'phel brgyud grwa tshang la bka' slob phebs don/ da nas lo gsol thog rgyal chen gyi bskang gso 'don ma dgos pa dang / de bzhin tshogs gzhung nas kyang 'don mi dgos zhes phebs/ de rjes gzim 107

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/chung gi dgong dro'i 'phrin bcol skabs 'don pa de yang ma dgos zhes bka' slob snga phyi phebs don bzhin mtshams 'jogs zhus/ 'on kyang rgyal chen bsten srol sngar med gsar spros kyis rkyen pa'i grwa tshang la dpal ldan lha mo'i 'khu ldog yod pa bdag lta bus da dung yang ma shes/ 1978 lo'i zla 6 tshes 13 nyin gu ru'i 'bum tshogs kyi nyin gsum par/ grwa tshang gi mkhan rin po che blo bzang nyi ma mchog gis dbus sku zhabs sum cu dang /de bzhin gnas chung gi rgan gras lnga / rigs lam slob dge gnyis/ dha sar gtan sdod rgyud grwa smad stod kyi 'thus mi bcas bka' 'gugs thog dmigs bsal bcar 'thus bka' 'khol a ri khul bca' sdod rwa stod skyong bla sprul sku dang / nyag re skal bzang ye shes bcas par pho brang tshoms chen du spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas rgyal chen shugs ldan bsten phyogs skor blang dor byed sgo'i bka' slob stsal ba nas bzung thag pa gris bcad pa'i dpe ltar grwa tshang rgan gzhon tshang mas blodor tshul bzhin zhus pa'i 'bras bur 1978 'o3) zla 10 tshes 1 bod sa stag zla 9par slar yang gangs ljongs bstan srid kyi don du dpal chen rdo rje phur pa'i gtor sgrub tshugs skabs nyin gcig spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas da cha grwa tshang la dpal ldan lha mo'i 'khu ldog lhag med zhi zin pa'i bka' slob phebs 108

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/par brten sems ngal gyi 'khur po ri bo lta bu 'bebs thub pa byung / 'di ni spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas rgya chen shugs ldan brten na bod gzhung dga' ldan pho brang gi bstan srid la 'phral phug gang sar phan las gnod che ba skye bo blo yul las 'das pa ye shes kyi gzigs pas dpyad pa mdzad de thugs nges brtan po rnyed pa rang re rnams la blang dor byed sgo'i bka' slob gsal po stsal ba snying dbus su bzhag ste spang blang tshul bzhin zhus pa'i 'bras bu yin par mngon/ 'di ni deng skabs kyang gal gnad chen por mthong ba ltar/ snga phyi'i lo rgyus dkyus gcig tu bkod pa yin/1976 'i re zla 2 tshes 17 nyin nas gsar zhugs 'jam dpal lhun grub dang / bstan 'dzin lhun po/ blo bzang bsam gtan/ thub bstan dpal ldan/ blo bzang bstan dar/ thub bstan thogs med/ blo bzang chos rgyal/ bstan 'dzin lha dbang / bstan 'dzin brtson 'grus bcas mi grangs dgu la sku zhabs skal bzang chos 'byor serdzogs pas dgu gtor tshogs kyi gral 'atredzer rgyag rgyu'i 'cham khag zhib phra bslabs/ 'edze de'i dgu gtor la 'cham brgyab cing / spyi nor 7gong sa mchog kyang 'cham gzigs la chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyangs/ 'di ni rgya gar du phebs rjes dgu gtor gyi 'cham brgyab pa dang po yin/109

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edzi rgyus/gzhan yang 1976 lor bka' drin mtshungs med mkhan rin po che bsam gtan chos 'phel mchog rang gzhung chos don lhan khang brgyud grwatshang gi mkhan po dgongs zhu gnang ba dang / de bzhin bka' drin mtshungs med 7skyabs rje rwa stod rin po che mchog kyang slob dpon dgongs zhu gnang ba bzhin bka' 'khrol thob/ 7skyabs mchog rnam gnyis kyis mdzad pa gong du 'khod pa ltar gtso che slob gnyer thog skabs babs 'dzin skyong bcas thad thugs 'khur che bskyed gnang yod/ deng skabs slob gnyer sogs gang ci phun sum tshogs po yod pa 'di'i mang gzhi mkhan slob rnam gnyis dang / grwa tshang gi sku zhabs bgres gras rnam pa bcas nas sku ngal chen pos 'ding gnang mdzad pa yin pas/ rang re gsar zhugs rnams nas terdzong rnam pa'i bka' drin snying dbus su bcangs te rgan gzhon gus bkur dang mig ltos bzang po rgyun 'dzin byed dgos/ 1976 lo'i zla 11 par spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi bka' 'brel ltar rang gzhung chos don lhan khang nas grwa tshang gi mkhan por rgyud smad mkhan zur bka' drin mtshungs med blo bzang nyi ma mchog bsko gzhag mdzod/ grwa tshang du khri 'don gnang /spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas 7rgyal ba'i gzim chung sgrol ma lha khang du mkhan rin po che blo bzang nyi ma mchog dang / 7skyabs 110

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/ rje rwa stod rin po ches dbus 'dus tshogs la bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor 'i re sgrub thabs kyi steng nas bshad khrid stsal/ 1977lo'i zla 4 tshes 22 nyin mkhan zur rin po che bsam gtan chos 'phel mchog dgongs pa chos dbyings su thim tshul bstan/ grwa tshang spyi pa dang / rang rang 'khos dpag bcas kyis rin po che dam pa'i thugs dgongs zab mo yongs su rdzogs phyir mchod 'bul rgya che zhus/ 1977 'itshe bar spyi sger tshang mas rang khungs rtsis khra sogs las sne so sor 'gan dkri gtsang ma gnang ba dang / las sne rim pa so sdurdzo nas kyang lhag bsam rnam dag gis ngal ba dang len gnang yod/ da dung yang las don gtsang ma yid ches 'pher ba yong ched/ bsngo rten sogs dad sbyin khag nas phul 'byor rigs la byung 'dzin rtsis khra bzo rgyu dang / ma 'ongs las don byed phyogs kha gsal stabs bde yig cha nyar 'jog byed rgyu/ las don che chung tshang ma yig thog nas byas te de la rtsa'adzin byed rgyu/ deng sang spyi tshogs sgrig 'dzugs che chung tshang mar las don byed mkhan dang / 'brel ba byed yul bcas su yig tshang yod pa ltar/ grwa tshang nas kyang de don yig tshang chung ngu zhig gsar du btsugs pa der gtan sdod drung yig gcig bzhag ste las don byed bzhin yod pa gang cir phan thogs chen po byung yod par mngon/ 1976 lor 111

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'e1 rgyus/gnas chung chos rgyal chen pos spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i sku phyu'i skor la rdo drag gi bka' lung phebs par brten bod mi ser skya lha mi skulangs nas zhabs rim smin sgrub rgya che zhus pa dang / lhag par 7gong sa mchog nas skabs babs dus gzigs kyis 7rgyal mchog lnga pa chen po'i dag snang gsang ba rgya can khongs sgrub pa bka' brgyad kyi ljags bsnyen smin rgyas mdzad pa bcas la brten nas sku gegs kyi mtshan ma ngan pa rang sar zhi ste rang cag rnams bde skyid kyi dpal la longs su spyod chog pa byung yang / de rjes bka' lung rim par skye 'gro bsod nams dman pas mgon po mchog la brtan bzhugs yang yang 'bul dgos gsungs pa bzhin/me sprul zla 10 tshes 6 phyi 81 1977 zla 11 tshes 16nyin res gza' lhag pa gza' skar 'byur 'phrod mchog tu dge ba'i nyin gyi snga char theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang yang steng tshoms chen du grwa tshang dang / gnas chung sgra dbyangs gling gnyis thun mong nas spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog la tshe dpag med 'chi med lha lnga'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs smin rgyas 'bul lam zhus pa dang / de nyin rang re'i grwa tshang gi sku zhabs phyogs mtha' khag la sku1da pa rnams dang / lhag par deng skabs grwa tshang gi 'grig khongs su med pa rnams kyang sngon chad grwa tshang 'di nyid kyi 1 12

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/thugs rje dang / bka' drin gyi zho shas 'a tsho zhing chos dang / zang zing la lhan cig tu spyod pa sha stag yin zhing / da lta yang dam tshig dang la rgya ma bor bar dga' zhen mi lhod pa'i ngang nas rang rang ya rabs kyi 'tsho ba'i mdu na lam bzang por spyod bzhin gnas pa rnams la'ang grwa tshang ldan steng nas mgron brda gtong gnang mdzad /1977 lor spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog la gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi bka' dbang smin 〈(la skyabs 'jug thugs rje che ba zhes lha gos dang rten gsum 'bul 'degs dang bcas mkhan rin po che brgyud snyan seng zhur par/ 1979 zla 3 tshes 20 nyin nas gtsug lag khang du gnang rgyu'i bka' bzhes zab resna thob/ tshes 14 nyin spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gis dbus gsung zhabs bcu nas nyin bdun gyi ring gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i dbang chen gyi sngo 'gro'i sa chog dang / phyed yol la spyi nor 7gong sa/ mchog nas dad ldan ser skya yongs la byang chub gzhung lam gyi bshad khrid stsal/ tshes 20 nyin gsang 'dus mi bskyed rdo rje'i lugs kyi dbang chen gyi sngon 'gro sta gon/ tshes 21/22 nyin gnyis la bka' dbang dngos gzhi/ tshes 22 nyin dgong dro pho brang dbu rtser rdul tshon klu chog tshes 23 nyin ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 113

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/la brten bde mchog lu i pa'i lugs kyi dbang chen/ tshes 24 nyin ras bris dkyil 'khor la brten 'jigs byed bcu gsum ma'i dbang chen dang / mjug tu rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung sngags rim chen mo'i bzhad khrid bcas bka' drin stsal/ lo de'i phyi zla 12 tshes 4 nas nyin gsum gyi ring spyi nor 7gong sa mchog gi bka' 'brel bzhin gnas mchog rdo rje gdan gyi mchod rten rin po che'i drung du 7gong sa mchog dbu bzhugs 'og gsung zhabs dus 'khor slob dpon thub bstan rin chen dang / dbu mdzad thub bstan chos 'phel/ mchod gasku1ga thub bstan 'jam dbyangs lags sogs nas rab gnas dge legs rgya mtsho'i char 'bebs kyi cho ga'i steng nas rab tu gnas par mdzad/ de dag legs par grub rjes bod la gzigs skor dang po phebs mi rnam pas bod mi sa ya drug gi sku tshab gnang ste lhar bcas srid zhi'i gtsug rgyan 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog mkha' khyab 'gro ba spyi dang / bye brag gangs ljongs bstan srid bde skyed kyi mabe|na skyabs dam par sku tshe 7zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i brtan bzhugs tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi cho ga'i sgo nas 'bul rgyu'i sngon du/ rdo rje slob dpon 'khrul zhig rin po che mchog dang / grwa tshang mkhan rin po ches dbus gsung zhabs rnams nas nyin bdun gyi ring sgrub 114
