rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'ordzo rgyus/zhag gnad smin zhus/ brtan bzhugs dngos gzhi 'bul yul/ mchod rten rin po che'i rten gtso thub dbang gi sku mdun du bzhugs khri rin po che dang mchod tshogs bshams/ gzigs skor sku tshab kyi tshogs gtso bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal dang / sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan rnam gnyis nas spos sne dang bcas spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gdan drangs/ mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i gser gyi khrir zhabs 〈snar 'khod bstun/ sku tshab rnam gnyis nas maṇḍal sku gsung thugs rten 'degs 'bul zhus/ rdo rje slob dpon mchog gi dbus rang gzhung sku tshab rnam pa dang gsung zhabs pa bcas nas dad 'dun gasku ba med pa'i sgo nas brtan bzhugs gzab rgyas bstar 'bul zhu rgyu'i be| skabs thob/deng gi dus su'ang skabs de'i gnas tshul dran dus snying nas dga' ba dang yi rang skye ba'i mdzad sgo pomatshar can zhig byung yod/ 1979 bod zla 2 nang spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i bka' 'brel ltar rdza rong 'khrul zhig rin po che mchog gi zhal snga nas gter ston bsod rgyal lugs kyi phur pa'i dbang chen ras bris dkyil 'khor la brten nas stsal ba dang / mjug tu 'don chog yongs kyi ljags lung yang legs par nod 1980 81ra gsar zhugs mang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs shag sdurdzogs ldang 115

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/min la brten grwa shag gsar pa thog brtsegs lnga pa 'di gsar skrun gnang /lhan rgyas kyi sku tshab sku zhabs ngag dbang rgya mtsho nas sku ngal 'dzems med kyis phyag las 'gan 'khur bzhes/ mthar legs grub mtshams/ spyi nor 7gong sa mchog grwa shag gsar rnying khag la gzigs skor chibs bsgyur bskyangs nas gnas khang byin gyis brlabs/ grwa tshang lhan steng nas sku zhabs ngag dbang rgya mtsho lags su legs skyes gsol ras gnang / 1980 lo nas a rir bca' bzhugs ser byes dge bshes bzod pa lags kyi chos tshogs nas lhar bcas srid zhi'i gtsug nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen thengs bdun pa de a ri'i sa gnas mi kri san du skyabs 'jug yong ba zhes 7snyan seng snga phyi zhus par brten 1981 lo'i zla 7 tshes 15 16 17/bcas nyin gsum gyi ring gnang rgyu'i bka' bzhes thob/ 'di ga grwa tshang nas dus dbang gsung zhabs su/ dbu slob ngag dbang bkra shis/ dbu mdzad thub bstan chos 'phel/ mchod g.yog thub bstan 'jam dbyangs/dge bskos ngag dbang mkhyen rab/ mchod g.yerdzog las tshab bstan 'dzin grags pa/ bri thig pa/ ngag dbang chos 'byor/ 'jam dpal lhun grub/blo bzang bsam gtan/ blo bzang bstan dar bcas dang / gsung bzang /116

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/bstan 'dzin thabs mkhas dang / bstan 'dzin bde bzhegs/ bstan 'dzin zla bzang / mchod bzhengs/ ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ thub bstan thogs med/ bstan 'dzin lha dbang / blo bzang chos rgyan bcas nas dus dbang gi zhu sgo mtha' dag dang / tshur lam a ri'i rgyal sa zhe'u yog zho lom sbi/ yu ni wa se kri'i tshogs khang chen mor dad mjal ba brgya phrag kha shas brgal ba'i dbus su grwa tshang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i gar 'cham 'khrub pa de la phyi nyin a ri'i snyan grags can gyi gsar shog khag tu'ang bstod bsngags rgya cher zhus 'dug par ma zad/ slar yang mjal 'dod yod pa'i tshogs pa khag mang po'i mgron brda 'byor/ 'di ni a rir bod dgon gyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gar 'cham 'khrab pa dang po de yin pa dang / bod don gsal bsgrags kyang rgya che byung / 1979 lo nas spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi thugs rje las bod phyi nang phan tshun bar gnyen 'phrad kyi go skabs byung ba nas bzung / 'di ga grwa tshang nas bod lus sku zhabs rnams la gtso che spyi nor 7gong sa chen po'i zhal mjal dang / de bzhin 7gong sa mchog gis dbu khrid pa'i btsan byol gzhung dmangs dang / rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i grwa tshang rin po che'i gnas sdangs gzigs ched du 'di phyogs rang dbang lung par phebs thub thabs la grwatshang nas gang ci'i thugs 117

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/'khur che bzhes gnang / skabs der grwa tshang nas bod lus sku zhabs rnams la gtong gnang mdzad pa'i phyag bris kyi ngo bzhus/༄ṣṭha༅/ /gus shing brtse ba'i gzhis lus rnam grwa dbu mdzad sku zhabs thub bstan mchog ldan lags dang / dus 'khor dbu mdzad/ byams pa skal bzang lags/ gzhan yang sku zhabs lhan rgyas matredzeg la/da lam rang re'i sku tshab tshogs pa'i sku ngo rnams 'di gar phebs 'byor zin nas khyed rnam pa'i gnas stangs 'grel bshad bskyon pa dang chabs cig sku par kha shas kyang mig ston mdzad byung bar/ 'dir yod rgan gzhon tshang ma dga' skyo'i tshor ba shugs drag dang bcas rang yul dran pa dang / dus yun ring po de tsam ring kha bral nas sdod dgos pa bcas kyi gnas tshul rnams slar yang dran gse'i shugs ston du gyur nas sems 'gul chen po thebs song / 'di gar 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i thugs rje dang / bka' drin nyag gcig la brten nas 'tsho gos gnas mal sogs gang legs thog chos spyod spyi dang / lhag par grwa tshang rang khungs kyi cho ga phyag len rnams mi nyams rgyun 'dzin gyis phal cher skyar gso zin nas gtor sgrub sgrub mchod sogs de sngon bskal bzang lugs bzang gis dus ltar tshugs mus thog gsar zhugs gzhon skyes rnams la mtshan nyid dang / phyi nang shes yon 118

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/slob sbyong gi 'dzin rim sogs yar thon dang yar rgyas kyi mdun lam bzang la grub 'bras kyang mi dman tsam 'thon bzhin yod/ da bar rang re'i mi tshe'i nang gi dus yun ha cang ring po mi lo nyi shu brgal ba'i ring phan tshun shi gson rtsad gcod tsam byed dbang ma byung rung / spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i thugs rje dang / mdzod 'phrin 'dzam gling phyogs kun tu khyab pa la brten nyi zer spar mos mi khebs pa'i dpe ltar da cha dngos thog bden 'tshol gyi srid byus 'og phan tshun gnyen 'phrad dang / lhag par 'di ga bod gzhung sku tshab rnams bod sa gang sar phebs nas gzhis lus bod mi rnams la 'tshams 'dri dang / gnas stangs gzigs skor gnang ba bcas dga' zhing gus la spobs pa skyes 'os pa 'di ltabu dngos su byung ba yin stabs/'dir yod bod mi spyi dang / rang re'i sku zhabs rnam pa'i gras nas kyang rang yul mthong 'dod dang / gnas tshul nyan 'dod kyi phan tshun thuga'aphrad bya rgyur sngar las lhag pa'i sems 'tshab ha cang chen po gnang mkhan mang po 'dug de bzhin der bzhugs khyed rnams kyang gtso che spyi nor 7gong sa yid bzhin nor bu zhal mjal 'dod dang / de bzhin rang gi gnyen tshan dang / dge phrug chos kyi grogs po rnams la thug 'phrad mdzad rgyur thugs 'dod yod pa gzhir bcas/ bod mi spyi mtshungs ltar phan tshun gnyis phyogs 119

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/nas gnyer 'phrad bya rgyu'i dus tshod go sgrig gnang thub na 'gro gron dang sne len gra sgrig cha tshang 'di nas zhu rtsis yod pas de lugs dgongs 'jags kyis zhib cha'i gnas tshul dang byed thabs gang dga' ba8ma gsal kha byang brgyud gtong gnang yod pa mkhyen/ dha sa bzhugs sgar theg chen chos gling rnam grwa yig tshang lhan rgyas thun mong nas 1980 zla tshes la/ phul//zhes phan tshun gnas tshul phul res gnang bar ma zad/ da bar sku zhabs gang tsam phebs thub pas khongs nas bod kyi grwatshang dbu mdzad thub bstan mchog ldan lags sogs sku zhabs 'ga' 'di gar bca' bzhugs mdzad/ bod lus sku zhabs rnams rgya mi'i btson 'og tu ha las pa'i sku ngal chen po byung rung / len lan thams cad gcig la bda'/ kun la bka' drin che bar sgoms/ zhes gsungs pa ltar/ rang gi sngon bsags kyi 'bras bu dus su smin pa yin 'dug dgongs pa las/ spyi tshogs gsar rnying dang / skyabs yul dam pa sogs la smod pa'i mtshams med kyi dri mas ma gos par gnas pa dang / rang rang 'tsho tre|sa gnas stangs la gzhigs pas sku zhabs nang phan tshun nang gcig gi spun ltar blta rtog gnang ba dang / grwa tshang rin po che'i thugs dbus su bcangs te grwa tshang gi dpe cha sho lo ka gcig las med na'ang bdag gnyer gnang 'dug pa bcas/ rjes su yi rang zhu 'os su mthong /120

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/7gong sa mchog gi bka' da gongs ltar 1982 bod zla 4 nang gtsug lag khang du ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi sgrub pa tshugs/ de rjes lo ltar bod zla 4 pa'i nang nyin lnga'i ring tshugs mus yin pa dang / mchod gnyer la sogs bsnyen bkur sku sger yig tshang nas gsol ras stsal/ 1983lor dpal ldan 'bras spungs chos sgar du/ rgya gar lho phyogs bod mi'i gzhis skar 'brel mtshungs khag lnga nas gdan sa chen po se 'bras dga' gsum gtsor gyur ris med dge 'dun gang yod gdan drangs par rang gzhung nas rtsaba'i rgyu krerdzon sbyar te/ chu phag cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo rgyas pa zhig tshugs te 'jig rten kun tu snyigs lnga'i rgud tshogs zhi zhing / 'gro kun phan bde'i dpal la spyod pa/ yang sgos gangs ljongs skye 'gro'i 'dod don myur du 'grub pa/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi dgung skes dngos gzhi'i sku gegs nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi ba bcas kyi ched tshogs gsog mchod sprin spro 'bul gnang ba dang / de dang chabs cig tu/ phyi lo 1959 sa phag lha ldan smon lam chen mo'i skabs spyi nor 7gong sa chen po mchog nas 7rgyal ba'i bka' dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa'i gzhung lugs rab 'byams rgya mtshor gsan sbyong legs par grub pa'i rjes 'brel grwa bskor lha rams mtshan bzhes kyi dam bca' mdzad nas mi lo nyer lnga'akhor 121

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/ba'i rjes dran dga' ston gyi mdzad sgor grwa tshang nas gsung zhabs sum cu skor sku bcar zhus/ chu phag gnam 'e1 gsar tshes kyi mdzad 〉( khag dang / srung spyi'i sgo nas sgrub zhag nyin bdun gnad smin dang 'brel smon lam gtor zor 'phen pa gnang / 'di ni rgya gar du grwa tshang nas smon lam gtor thug bskyon pa dang po yin/ 1984 phyi zla lda nang / nyi hong nang pa'i chos sde na ri ta shing sho ji dgon pas nyi hong du gsang sngags kyi chos dar spel gnang mkhan ko bho rda yi shi mya ngan las 'das nas lo 1150 'khor ba'i dus dran dang stabs bstun dgon pa'i nye 'khor du 'dzam gling zhi bde'i ched mchod rten chen po zhig gsar bzhengs legs grub kyi dbu 'byed dang rab gnas bcas par/ spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por snyan seng sngon zhus kyis bka' bzhes thob par brten/ rab gnas kyis gsung zhabs su mkhan rin po che blo bzang nyi ma mchog gis dbus gsung zhabs bcu gnyis sku bcar zhus/ bcom ldan 'das dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i 〈sna nas rab tu gnas par mdzad/ dkyil 'khor dpal ldan smad rgyud grwa tshang gi phyag bzhes ji lta ba bzhin bzhengs pa/ deng skabs kyang mchod rten gyi nang rten du mjal rgyu yod/ phyi zla 5 tshes 12 nyin nyi hong gi rgyal sa krog khyor nang bca' bzhugs chos kyi slob dpon ku ri ya ma'i chos tshogs nas gra sgrig zhus 122

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 9lo rgyus/pa bzhin snyan grags can gyi tshogs khang spo to khang du sku zhabs rnam pas grwa tshang gi gar 'cham bskyon rjes tshogs khang du spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur thog gsung zhabs rnams dang lhan du 'dzam gling zhi bde mdzeng ched zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gnang / skabs der zhal mjal zhu mkhan mi mang khri phrag gsum skor bcar/ mjug tu spyi nor 7gong sa chen pos 'dzom gling zhi bde yong thabs skor bka' slob stsal/ 1984 lor grwa tshang spyi nas 'gro gron gsol ras kyis na gzhon slob gnyer ba gang tsam zhig blo skyel 'phel ched 'jang dgun chos su gtong gnang mdzad/ spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas grwa tshang slob dpon du dbu zur thub bstan mchog ldan mchog bstedze gzhag stsal ba ltar/ 1984 zla 10 tshes 23 bod zla 10 tshes 1 nyin sngar slob dpon khri 'don gyi lam ltar khri 'don gnang / snga lo grwa tshang nas spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por srung spyi'i rjes gnang skyabs 'jug bka' drin che ba zhes 7snyan seng zhus pa ltar/ 1985 phyi zla 4 tshes 18 nyin spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas pho brang tshoms chen du mgon po phyag drug dang /mgon dkar/ chos rgyal phyi nang gnyis bcas kyi rjes gnang dang / tshes 21 nyin gtsug lag khang gi yang steng tshoms chen du/ lha mo dang / bstan 123

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/ma bcu gnyis kyi rjes gnang / rgyal po sku lnga'i srog gtad bcas gnang /tshes 25 nyin mgrelan po gur dang / zhal/ lcam sring gsum/ tshes 29 nyin rnam sras dang / dzam bha la bcas kyi rjes gnang bka' drin stsal/yu rob kyi yul gru sud si ri kong du yod pa'i dad ldan rang rigs sud si gzhis chags rnams dang / gzhan yang yu rob phyi rgyal nang pa thun mong bcas nas sngon du spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por bcom ldan dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen thengs bcu pa gong gsal sa gnas su gnang skyong yong ba'i 7snyan seng zhus par bka' bzhes legs par thob ste/ phyi zla 7 tshes 29/3 0/31/ bcas nyin gsum ring rdul tshon dkyil 'khor la brten nas bka' dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par stsal ba/ de skabs gsung zhabs su slob dpon thub bstan mchog ldan dang / dbu mdzad thub bstan chos 'phel/ dge bskos ngag dbang bkra shis/ mchod gasku1ga thub bstan 'jam dbyangs/ mchod gasku1ga las tshab bstan 'dzin grags pa/ bris thig pa/ bstan 'dzin bde bzhegs/ bstan 'dzin zla bzang / bstan 'dzin lha dbang / blo bzang dar rgyas bcas dang / gsung bzang ba/ ngag dbang chos 'byor dang / bstan 'dzin chos ldan/ bstan 'dzin thabs mkhas/ 'jam dpal lhun grub/ 21 bzang bsam gtan/124

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/mchod bzhengs pa thub bstan thogs med/ blo bzang chos rgyan bcas nas gsung zhabs zhu sgo rnams 'thus tshang zhus/ phyi zla 9 tshes 24 nas bstan srid skye 'gro'i bde thabs su/ pho brang tshoms chen du dpal ldan lha mo'i sgo nas gtor sgrub rgyas pa zhig tshugs pa'i chog zhabs thugs bzhed ji bzhin zhus/lo rim bcu'i slob tshan/don tshan bzhi pa'i nang gses gnyis pa/1979 81ra grwa tshang la gsar du zhugs mkhan rim pa gnyis pa 'dzul phyogs skor/ grwa tshang gi lhan rgyas khang dang dge 'dun bgres pa bcas tshogs mi 15 skor yod pa'i tshogs chung nas nyin shas ring gang dge'i gros bsdur gyis mos mthun byung ba 7gong sa chen por snyan seng dang 'brel shes bya gsar shog thog sku1ngas khyab gsal bsgrags gnang / grwa tshang gi dpal 'byor gnas stangs nas sdod shag sogs thad sku ngal mdzed mus kyang gtso che gong du gsal ba ltar mthong ba brgyud pa'i phyag len rnams mi nyams rgyun 'dzin thub thabs dang / spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i mdzad 'phrin yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin gong 'phel 'gro bzhin pa'i chos phyogs 125

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/kyi gsung zhabs zhu mi 〈snags 'phral phugs kyi datredzes pa dge mtshan du mar gzigs te da lta bar gsar zhugs bdun cu skor bcug pa dang / de dag gi slob sbyong byed yul/ grwa tshang gi slob grwa zhes pa zur 'dzugs gnang ba dang / der slob tshan gtso che ba bzhi yod cing / de yang slob tshan dang po grwa tshang gi 'don chog khag blo 'dzin bya rgyu dang / gnyis pa mtshan nyid kyai lo rim bcu'i slob tshan/ gsum pa bod yig bzhi pa dbyin yig bcas yin/ slob sbyong sprod mi dge rgan/ 'don chog dge rgan bzhi/ grwa tshang gi slob gnyer mdzengs la mtshan kyi dpe khrid gnang mkhan mkhan rin po ches dbus gdan sa'i dge bshes rnams dang / bod yig dge rgan gcig dbyin ji'i dge rgan gcig dang / rgyun ldan slob grwa'i 'dzin skyong la lhan rgyas nas gzigs rtogs 'og dge rgan nas kyang blta skyong mdzad/ slob grwa ba rnams kyi 'don chog rgyugs sprod byed phyogs gong du zhus zin pa ltar dang / mtshan nyid kyi slob gnyer byed phyogs slob gnyer ba gsar rnying yongs rdzogs spyi mtshungs lo rim 10 yi slob tshan dang / lo re rtsod rgyugs dang 'bri rgyugs bcas 1977 'itshe nas grwa tshang gi mkhan rin po che byang rtse chos rje blo bzang nyi ma mchog nas gtso che 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por daglerdzongs skor bka' slob zhus te slob tshan khag gtan 'bebs bzo gnang 126

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus / mdzod pa bzhin/ lo rim dang po'i slob tshan/ yongs 'dzin bsdus grwa nang tshan rigs lam chung 'bring gnyis/ lo rim dang por rtsod rgyugs las 'bri rgyugs phul mai datredzes/ 'itshe rim gnyis pa'i slob tshan/ rigs lam che ba'i rtsod rgyugs 'bul dgos/ gzhan yang sum rtags rtsabasdus legs bshad ljon dbang / lo rim gsum par blo rigs dang / rtags rigs/lo rim gsum pa nas bcu pa bar lo ltar rtsod rgyugs dang bri rgyugs gnyis ka phul dgos/ lo rim bzhi par lcang skya grub mtha' sde tshan dang po dang gnyis pa/ mdze rim phrupar cing skya grub mtha' sde chan gsum pa dang / mkhas grub rjes mdzad pa'i sa lam mkhas pa'i yid 'phrog gnyis/ lo rim drug par lcang skya grub mtha' sde tshan bzhi pa dang / rgyal tshab rje'i gsung mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bsdus don rin chen 'phreng ba gnyis/ 'di yan grub mtha'i rtsab blo gyu gas phul zin pa dgos/ lo rim bdun pa/ rje bdag nyid chen po'i gsung legs bzhad snying po sems tsam pa'i skor dang / 'jam dbyangs dga' nywadzes mdzad pa'i sngags sa lam gnyis/ 81 rim brgyad pa/ legs bzhad snying po dbu ma pa'i skor/ lo rim dgu pa/ sngags rim chen mo rnal 'byor rgyud yan/ lo rim bcu pa/ sngags rim chen mo rnal 'byor bla med kyi skor bcas lo rim bcu'i slob tshan dang / lo ltar bod zla 10127

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/nang rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs su rtsod rgyugs dang / 'bri rgyugs phul dgos/rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs nas 'e1 ltar sbyang 'bras la gzhigs pa'i brgya cha stsal srol gtan 'bebs dang / 'e1 rim bcu pa thon mtshams rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs kyi steng nas lo bcu'i sbyang 'bras brgya cha la gzhigs pa'i mdo sngags gzhung chen slob thon pa'i phyag 'khyer bzo gnang mdzad pa ltar/slob thon dang po dge 'dun bzhi/ 1984 zla 11 pa'i nang thon par/1985 phyi zla 3 tshes 1 nyin bzhugs sgar theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang du grwa tshang mkhan rin po che byang rtse chos rje blo bzang nyin ma mchog nas dbu mdzad/ rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs kyi tshogs gtso chos don drung che khams sprul 'jam dbyangs don grub mchog dang / rgyud stod sku tshab bcas dang / gzhan yang rang gzhung bka' shag gi sku tshab/ spyi 'thus lhan khang / sku sger yig tshang / shes rig lhan khang / bod khrim bcas kyi sku tshab rnam pa/ grwa tshang dge 'dun tshogs yongs dang phyi nang sku mgron mi sna brgya phrag lhag bcas 'dus pa'i sar rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs kyis tshogs gtso chos don drung ches/ rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs kyi sku tshab mdzad nas gsung bzhad gnang ba'i snying bsdus su/ de snga bod du rgyal bstan dar rgyas phun sum tshogs pa'i thog 7rgyal dbang sku 'phreng na rim dang / skyes 128

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edzi rgyus/chen dam pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs ltabu byon pa rnams kyi bka' drin la brten nas thub bstan 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi byed po chos byed dgon sde grangs las 'das pa yod pa'i nang tshan grwa tshang 'di nyid ni 7rgyal dbang skuphreng gnyis pa dge 'dun rgya mtshos thog mar phyag btab cing / bar du dar rgyas su gyur pa sku bcar phan bde legs bshad gling zhes dge 'dun nyis brgyar nye ba yod pa rnams kyi bzhugs gnas kyang rtsepho brang po ta la'i nang grwa tshang gi kun dga' ra ba zhes rten dang brten par bcas pa phun sum tshogs pa dang / dge 'dun rnams kyang gzhi gsum phyag len/ yi dam gsang bde 'jigs gsum dang /dpal dus kyi 'khor lo sogs rgyud sde gong 'og rnams dang / snga 'gyur rnying ma'i gter chos gsar rnying gis mtshon chos spyod spyi dang / cho ga phyag len/ rta dbyangs gar thig gtor bzo dkar rgyan tshun thun mong ma yin pa'i khyad chos dang ldan zhing / lhag par 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas bstan pa dang / chab srid skye 'gro'i bde skyed kyi ched du chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo gang sar gsung zhabs kyi zhu sgo mtha' dag 'thus tshang yar rgyas 'gran zla bral ba yod pa sogs de snga'i lo rgyus gsal bshad dang /bar skabs bstan dgra rgya dmar nas bod ljongs snod bcud yongs rdzogs btsan 'og rtsabarlag tu btang ba'i skor dang / 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon 129

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyurnga /chen po'i chibs zhabs su 'brangs pa'i btsan byol bod mi'i khrod du grwa tshang sku zhabs lnga bcu nga gnyis phebs thub pa rnams kyis dka' ngal du ma brgyud nas sngar srol cho ga phyag len rnams nyams gso yar rgyas gnang rgyu snying bcangs kyi grub 'bras bzang por bstod bsngags gnang ba dang 'brel 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas tshad med thugs rje'i gzigs bskyangs kyis mkhan po dang / slob dpon/ chos dge sogs gsar bsko mdzad pa dang / dge 'dun gsar zhugs gang tsam byung ba bcas nas phyar gru mnyam 'degs kyis 'bad brtson la brten sngar yod phyag srol gang yod thog rgyal bstan dar rgyas yun gnas thub pa'i rtsab mdo phyogs la lung rtogs gnyis dang / sngags phyogs bskyed rdzogs gnyis bcas bshad sgrub 'dzin skyong spel gsum dgos pa don gyi snying por gzigs nas rigs lam rtsod grwa gsar 'dzugs bskyangs pa dang 'brel lo rim dang po bsdus grwa chung 'bring nas/ lo rim bcu pa sngags rim chen mo bar 'dzin rim re'u mig gtan 'bebs mdzad par brten nas/ da lam dge 'dun blo gsal bzhi sbyang 'bras mthar son gyi lag 'khyer stsal ba'i mdzad sgo 'di ni sngar phan byung ma myong ba'i rang re rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi lo rgyus le'u gsar pa'i sge 'phar dbye ba zhig dang /sngags 'os gzi brjid dang ldan pa zhig yin par brten mkhan rin po che mchog 130

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/dang / slob dpon rnam pa/ slob gnyer pa bcas la ngas rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs kyi sku tshab zhus te bkra shis bde legs dang 'brel thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin zhes sogs don snying ldan pa'i gsung bzhad zab rgyas gnang / de rjes ser smad dge bzhes bstan 'dzin rab rgyas lags nas slob thon pa rnams kyi lo re'i 'briphyod rgyugs sprod kyi ang rim brgya cha sgrog byang gnang / rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs kyi 'gan 'dzin byang rtsechos rje rin po che mchog nas mdo sngags gzhung chen slob thon pa dge slong 'jam dpal lhun grub dang / dge slong bstan 'dzin dbyig gnyen/ dge slong blo bzang bsam gtan/ dge slong bstan 'dzin grags pa bcas la ang sde dang po'i lag 'khyer gsol ras stsal/ mkhan rin po che mchog dang / shes rig gi sku tshab bcas nas de ni grwa tshang gi lo rgyus thog thengs dang por yin pa dang grub 'bras la bsngags brjod bcas kyi gsung bshad gnang / grwa tshang nas legs skyes gsol ras stsal/ de rjes grwa tshang tshogs gzhung gi slob dpon sku zhabs thub bsta na mchog ldan nas da lam mdo sngags kyi gzhung chen slob thon par lag 'khyer gnang ba'i skal bzang dga' ston gyi mdzad sgo 'dir phebs pa'i rgyugs bzhes lhan tshogs rnam pa dang / rang gzhung las khungs khag gi sku tshab/ sku mgron rnam pa/ dge 'dun tshogs pa bcas la ngas grwa tshang 131

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'i( rgyuso/tshogs mtshengs kyi tshab byas te snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhu rgyu dang / mkhan rin po che mchog dang / dge bshes rnam pa/ slob gnyer ba rnam pa bcas nas da bar 7rgyalu ba'i bka' dgongs 'gal med lo nas lo bsdud snying stobs chen pos 'bad brtson gnang ba'i 'bras bu bzang po de ring dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa 'dir snying nas rjes su yi rang dang thugs rje che zhu rgyu yin/slad kyang pho rgyus ldan pa'i grwa tshang 'di nyid nas 7skyab mgon 7rgyal ba'i dbang po'i sri zhu'i zhabs 'degs sngar las lhag pa zhu thub pa'i cha rkyen dam pa ni mdo sngags gzhung chen la thos bsam slob gnyer gnang rgyu 'di nyid shin tu gal che bas rang cag tshang mas lhag bsam rnam dag gi dam bca' snying du bkod de 'bad brtson gnang dgos pa'i re 'dun gnang ba dang / chabs cig tshang mar bkra shis bde legs zhu gnang mdzad/ tshogs 21ngas nas dpal ldan dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i shis brjod kyi mtha' brgyan te mdzad sgo legs grub ngang nas grol/ 1985 phyi zla 4 tshes 4nyin mdo sngags gzhung chen slob thon pa'i lag 'khyer spyan zhu dang 'brel spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i mjal kha zhus par/ rjes brtse'i gsung gi gzengs bstod dbugs dbyung thob par brten dga' spro zad mi shes pa dang bcas 'di phyi kun tu dge ba'i don chen po 'grub par gyur ro/ /di 132

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/rnams kyi rtsab chu 'go gangs la thug pa ltar spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi thugs rje dang bka' drin kho na las byung bar yid ches nges pa rnyed de snying khong rus pa'i gting nas dga' gus yi rang dang mi phyed dad pa'i spu long rab tu g.yo zhing / 'di lta bu'i bka' drin gyi phung po'i tshad ni sa chen po la bzhugs pa'i sems dpa' rnams kyis kyang brjod par mi nus na bdag lta bus brjod ga la nus/ 'byung 'gyur yang ris med bstan 'gro spyi'i phan bde dang / bye brag rnam par rgyal ba phan bde legs bshad gling 'dus tshogs kyi 'phral yun bde skyed thams cad 7skyabs mgon chen po gang nyid kyi thugs bskyed dang sku tshe mdzad 'phrin kho nar rag las pas/ thugs bskyed kyi dam bca' brtan po nam yang mi ltod par sku tshe 7zhabs pad brtan cing mdzad 'phrin phyogs brgyar rgyas pa dang / bdag cag rnams kyang ji srid stong gzugs phyag rgya chen po'i go 'phang ma thob bar de srid du mgon po gang nyid kyis 'bral med mnyes bzhin rjes su 'dzin pa dang / de lta bu'i go 'phang mchog thob nas kyang ji srid 'gro ba'i sdug bsngal ma zad pa de srid du mgon po gang nyid nas gzhan don mdzad pa'i zhabs 'degs su gyur pa zhes snying khong rus pa'i gting nas gsol 'debs zhu bzhin yod/133

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/don tshan lnga pa/deng skabs lo 'khor gcig gi mdzod rim mdor bsdus1974 lo nas mkhan rin po che bsam gtan chos 'phel mchog gis spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por dgongs skor bka' slob dang 'brel sgrub mchod khag dang / gtor sgrub bcas pa zla dus tshes grangs gtan 'bebs bzo gnang mdzad pa bzhin lo 'khor nang star chags zhu sgo khag dkyus gcig tu mdor bsdus su bkod pa/ lo ltar bod zla 1 tshes 1 snga dro tshu tshod 4 par gtsug lag khang du lhar bcas srid zhi'i gtsug nor gangs can lha gcig spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog 7rgyal ba'i pho brang nas chibs bsgyur bskyangs te rten gtso khag la snyan shal sgron 'bul gnang rjes tshogs dbur zhabs sor 'khod pa dang / grwa tshang mkhan rin po che nas maṇḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul zhus rjes slob dbu tshogs mang la mjal kha phyag srung stsal/ de nas rang rang ming mtshams gral la 'khod/ zhal 'don 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i bdag bskyed sgoms pa sngon du btang ste lha mo'i gshegs gtor bar gsungs gsol tshogs grol/134

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/7gong sa mchog gzim chung du chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ tshogs mang nas de'i bar snga dro'i gsol ja bzhes/ chu tshod 7 par pho brang nas tshes gtor gyi mdzad sgor spyi nor 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur gyis gtsug lag khang yang steng tshes gtor tshugs yul gyi bzhugs khrir 7zhabs sor 'khod pa dang / grwa tshang mkhan po nas maṇḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul zhus par phyag srung bcas de rjes rang gzhung bka' spyi sogs mdzod gtso rnam pa dang gzhung zhabs ser skya/ grwa tshang mkhan slob 'dus mang yongs dang gnas dga' gnyis bcas/ gzhan yang sku mgron rnam pa bcas nas sku phyag phul te gral la 'khod/ tshes gtor gyi zhal 'don gsung / grwa tshar gnyer khongs nas gra sgrig gis gsol ja bzhes 'bras phul/ tshes gtor grub pa dang / chu tshod 9 pa tsam la gtsug lag khang gi tshoms chen du rgyal po lo gsar gyi mdzad sgor/ spyi nor 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur gyi sngon du rang gzhung bka' blon bgres pa la sogs pa nas spos sne dang / grwa tshang gi spyan rgya bcas kyis sdun bsus te mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i bzhugs khri chen mor zhabs sor 'khod pa dang / bzhugs khri'i nye 'khor du sku bcar rnam pa dang / g.yon gyi sdings cha'i steng du rang gzhung bka' blon rnam pa/ tshogs gtso rnam 135

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/gnyis/ yab gzhis sku 'khor bcas dang / gzhan yang sku mgron rnams bzhugs/ sdings cha'i shod kyi g.yon phyogs su mkhan po sprul sku rnam pa dang / grwa rnam gnas dga' gnyis sogs kyi dge 'dun rnams dang / g.yas kyi phyogs su spyi 'thus rgyun las rnam pa dang drung che chung sogs sri zhu'i las byed rnams bzhugs gral la 'khod/ dbus kyi bzhugs khri rin po che sku mdun du/ grwa tshang mkhan rin po che dbus gsung bzang rnams dang / mchod g.yog ngo las sogs sku bzhengs kyis ngang nas zhal 'don sangs rgyas chos tshogs ma dang 'brel rten 'brel bzang po'i tshigs bcad dang / mkhan rin po che mchog nas mthun 'gyur gsung ba dang sbrags rtags brgyad/ rdzas brgyad/ sna bdun bcas tshig mtshams dang bstun spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po'i phyag tu phul/ de mjug bkra shis pa'i dkon mchog gsum gyi tshig rkang dang 'brel shis pa brjod de g.yon phyogs gral la 'khod mtshams/ bka' blon khri pa nas gzhung gnas kyi maṇḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul zhus rjes bla sprul che khag dang / bka' blon las zur/ spyi 'thus drung che sogs mtshan rim bzhin mjal kha stsal/ skabs der lo de'i lha rams dge bshes sam rigs lam pa gnyis nas bgro gling dang / bod gzhung 136

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/zlos gar bas sngar srol gar 'khrab/ mdzad sgor gsol ja thengs gnyis dang / bzhes 'bras btegs/ bgro gleng rgan pas tshig bkra bcad rjes gnyis gas phyag 'tshal dang 'brel mjal kha zhus par dar rang slog thog legs dar dang phyag srung stsal/ sku sger drung che mchog nas khri dar phul/ las bya gnyis nas ka dar sgrog ste mdzad sgo grol/tshes 2 nyin zhogs pa pho brang dbu g.yab 'og rda sa dang nye 'khor du yod pa'i ser skya mang tshogs la lo mjal stsal ba de skabs dbu gdugs gzung mi dang / phyag srung g.yog rogs bcas sku zhabs brgyad skor bcar dgos/ tshes zha nyin snga dro theg chen chos gling gtsug lag khang gi yang steng tshoms chen du/ spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshes gsum bstan gsol gsol tshogs su chibs bsgyur/ zhal 'don lha mo dang bstan ma gnyis kyi thog srung spyi'i 'phrin bcol gnad smin dang / dpal ldan lha mo'i sku thang mdun bstan srid sku phyu bcas skor bde don zan brtag gnang /tshes 4/5 gnyis lo gsar gung gseng dang / tshes 10 nyin der snga gtsug lag khang dang / de sang pho brang tshoms chen du gnas dga' gnyis sogs gzab gsol spyan 'dren gnang bar grwa tshang nas dbu chos gnyis dang gsung bzang ba/ mchod bzhengs bcas sku bcar zhu 137

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/dgos/ tshes 11 nas bco lnga bar cho 'phrul smon lam chen mo nyin lnga'i ring zhal 'don gyi rim pa rnams 'bras spungs tshogs chen dbu mdzad dang / sgo blo gnyis kyi dbu mdzad/ 'don bzang bcas ched bcar gyis sngar srol bzang po nyams med gnang gi yod/ den min nang byed sgo khag dang / sgrig khrims/ gasdurdzol ja bzhes lag sku 'gyed bcas pa sku sger yig tshang dang grwa tshang gi khungs so so nas 'gan 'khur gnang bzhin yod/ tshes 15 nyin snga dro chos rar spyi nor 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur bskyangs skabs/ grwa tshang dge skos nas spos sne dang /chos gamadzeg nas gzigs dpe gdan zhu/ de bzhin spyan rgya/ dbu gdugs pa gnyis nas dbu gdugs ser po dang / rma bya dbu gdugs bcas zhus/ bzhugs khrir 7zhabs sdurdzor 'aterdzod mtshams rang gzhung chos rig bka' blon nas maṇḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul zhus de mkhan po bla sprul dang dbu mdzad chos dbyangs pa bcas nas mjal kha zhus/ gsol ja dang bzhes 'bras phebs/ skyes rabs gsung chos grub mtshams gong bzhin gtsug lag khang ngam pho brang la gdan 'dren zhus/ dgong dro skam tshogs sam smon lam dngos gzhi'i mchod 'bul dang / dam bca' bcas par chibs bsgyur bskyangs/ smon lam gyi 138

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'ordzo rgyus/ mjug lo ltar spyi nor 7gong sa mchog nas dad ldan ser skya yongs la dpyid chos nyin bsdud bka' chos bka' drin che skabs lagasung zhabs zhu rgyu dang / gsol ja ba snyen bkur sogs skabs bstun zhu sgo khag gtso bo sku sger yig tshang gi bka' slob gzhir bzung sku tshab dang lhan du grwa tshang nas zhu ṭa/sa lags ces/ /bod zla gnyis pa/bod zla gnyis pa'i tshes shar gong 'khod ltar phur ba'i sgrub mchod nyin bcu/ skabs re rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas bdud rtsi sman sgrub nyin bcu bdun tshugs/bod zla gsum pa/tshes 4 nas bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor le'i sgrub mchod kyi sngon 'gro sa chog nyin dang po/ tshes 5 nyin sa gar/ tshes 6/7/8/bcas la brgyad gtor chen mo dang / nyin gsum par spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur mchibs bsgyur/ tshes 13 nyin mchod gar/ tshes 14 nas dus kyi 'khor lo'i sgrub mchod nyin bdun/ tshes 15 nyin bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo dang ngo bor dbyer ma mchis pa spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyangs/ sgrub 139

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/mchod nyin bdun las/ sku gsung thugs nyin gsum dang / thugs dkyil nyin gsum/ nyin mtha' mar sbyin sreg nyin brgyad par dul tshon klu chogade rjes nyin gsum ring dbyar gsol spro skyed/ bod zla bzhi pa/tshes shar nas spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi bka' 'brel bzhin skyabs rje ser kong mtshan zhabs rin po che thub bstan stobs 'byor mchog gis phyogs sgrig mdzad pa/ ci 'dod yid bzhin 'jo ba'i rin chen bum bzang cho ga'i sgo nas ma ṇi ril sgrub nyin bdun/ bcom ldan 'das gsang 'dus mi bskyod rdo rje'i sgrub mchod kyi sngon 'gro sa chog nyin bzhi/ tshes 15 dang bstun dang rdul tshon kyi dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgo nas sgrub mchod nyin bdun/ nyin mtha' mar sbyin sreg mjug tu rdul tshon klu chog bcas so//bod zla lnga pa/spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen pos bod kyi bstan srid bde rtsar dgongs te gsar btsugs bskyangs pa'i gras gong 'khod rig 'dzin gdung sgrub kyi sgo nas zla re'i tshes bcu chas med thog zla ba 'di'i nang bka' 'brel ltar rang gzhung chos don lhan khang nas gong gi cho ga'i steng nas byang 140

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/gter gu ru'i 'bum tshogs nyin phru/ tshogs dbur spyi nor 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur dang rang gzhung gi bka' spyi rnam pa sogs phebs kyi yod/ de bzhin tshugs tshes lo lta ra dgengs sko ra zhus te dwangs: slob khang rgi 'go dmangs spyi nas gong bzhin 'bum tshogs nyin lnga tshugs/ phyi zla 7 tshes 6 nyin rang cag bod 'bangs yongs kyi mgon 7skyabs mtshungs zla ma mchis pa spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi sku'i 'khrungs skar mdzad chen gyi snga dro pho brang du 'khrungs gsol tshogs mgon du spyi nor 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur gyis mi 'jigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i seng khrir 7zhabs sor 'khod mtshams/ grwa tshang mkhan rin po che mchog nas maṇḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul zhus rjes tshogs dmangs nas mjal kha zhus te gral la 'khod/ 'khrungs gsol gyi zhal 'don khag gsungs/ grwa tshang nas gasdurdzol ja bzhes 'bras btegs/bod zla drug pa/bcom ldan 'das 'khor lo bde mchog lu yi pa'i sgrub mchod kyi sngon 'gro sa chog nyin bzhi dang / drug pa tshes bzhi'i dus chen dang bstun rdul tshon dkyil 'khor dang 'brel ba'i sgrub mchod nyin lnga / nyin mtha' mar sbyin sreg mjug tu rdul tshon klu chog tshes 15 dbyar gyi sbyor chog 141

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/dang / tshes 16 nyin dbyar zhal bzhes gnang /bod zla bdun pa/bod zla bdun pa'i nang dmigs bkar sgrub mchod dang / gtor sgrub med pas cho ga phyag len slob sbyong gnang rgyu/bod zla brgyad pa/tshes 22 nyin lha mo'i gtor sgrub kyi byin 'bebs/ tshes 23 nas 29 bar gtor sgrub dang nyin mtha' mar gtor 'phen/de yang lo mjug dgu gtor chen mor lo ltar gtor 'phen yod pa las/de min gtor sgrub khag la gtor 'phen zhu dgos min skabs 'phral dgongs skor zhu dgos/ gtor 'phen yod tshe gtor 'phen 'gor dul tshon gyi chos 'byung 'bri dgos/bod zla dgu pa/bcom ldan 'das dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum ma'i sgrub mchod kyi sngon 'gro sa chog nyin bzhi dang / lha babs dus chen la rab gnas dngos gzhi stabs 'khel gyi tshogs dbur spyi nor 7gong sa mchog chibs bsgyur bka' drin che thog rab gnas dge legs char 'bebs ma nyin gsum dang / sgrub mchod nyin gnyis/ mjug tu rdul tshon klu chog lo ltar 142

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'otshe rgyus/sgrub mchod khag dang / de bzhin gtor sgrub/ bstan srid zhabs rim khag gi tshogs mgon du spyi nor 7gong sa mchog sku'i mdzad gseng nam byung la sku ngal 'joms med kyis tshogs mgon du chibs bsgyur bka' drin bskyangs kyi yod/ bod zla bcu pa/tshes 22 nyin mgon po'i gtor chen gyi byin 'bebs/ tshes 23 nas 29 bar gtor sgrub/ mjug tu gtor 'phen/ tshes 25 gtsug lag khang du spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur bka' drin che thog 'jim mgon blam tsong kha pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul tshugs/ tshes 30 rang cag bod 'bangs skulangs la bka' drin gyi mnga' bdag 7rgyal mchog sku 'phreng bcu sum pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs mchod 'bul dang / gzhan yang 7rgyal dbang gong ma rnams kyi dgongs rdzogs so sor/ gtsug lag khang gi rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin 'bul bshams rgya cher zhu mus su krerdzod/bod zla bcu gcig pa/tshes 23 nas lcam sring gtor sgrub nyin gsum/ bod zla 10dang 11 gang rung la gzim chung gi g.yang sgrub dang / grwa tshang g.yang 143

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/sgrub nyin gsum re/bod zla bcu gnyis pa/tshes shar nas 'irdzo mjug mchod bzhengs tshugs/ tshes 23 nas dgu gtor dang / lcags mkhar re mos kyis gtor sgrub nyin bdun/ nyin bzhi pa nas sngar srol ltar tshogs kyi gral mgor 'cham dang / tshes 29nyin gtor 'phen/ tshes 30 nyin snga dro gnam lo gsar tshes kyis mchod pa sogs sgrig gzhom zhus/ dgong dro spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur gyis tshes gtor byin 'bebs tshugs rgyu bcas lo 'khor gcig nang ltar chags zhu sgo khag gi mdzad rim mdor bsdus yin/ gzhan yang dmigs bsal 7rgyal ba'i sku phywa dang / bstan srid/ mi mang gi re bskul zhabs rim bcas rgya che sna mang zhig dus tshod nges med du smin sgrub zhu bzhin yod pa yin/don tshan drug pa/1985 lor gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen gnang skabs kyi mdzad rim/sa steng rgyal bstan yongs rdzogs kyi mnga' bdag gangs can lha gcig 144

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/'phags mchog phyag na padmo ngur sgrig gar gyi rnam rol spyi nor 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen por grwa tshang 'dus sde spyi nas bcom ldan 'das dang po'i sangs rgyas dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen zhig stsal skyong yong ba zhes phyi lo 1981 'tshe nas ji ltar gsol ba rtse gcig tu btab pa bzhin zhal bzhes legs par thob sku1da/ sa gnas gang du gnang gtan ma 'khel bar lus skabs/ dha sa bod mi'i mnyam las bzo grwa'i 'go las thun mong nas rang gzhung nang srid lhan khang brgyud dus 'khor dbang chen gnang skyong gi snyen seng zhus par grwa tshang dang mnyam du gnang rgyu'i bka' bzhes thob/ 1984 'o'i lo 'gor grwa tshang dang mnyam las thun mong nas sku sger yig tshang brgyud slar yang snyan seng zhus par/ 1985 phyi zla 12 par gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du gnang rgyu'i bka' bzhes gtsang ma thor par brten dbang chen gyi chos ra'i pho brang gsar bzhengs zhu rgyu dang / de bzhin chos zhu ba spyi dang / bye brag bod nas chos zhur bcar mi rnams kyi bzhugs gnas la serdzogs dbang chen gyi sngon 'gro'i gra sgrig byed bzhin pa'i skabs su/ rdor gdan bod dgon dga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling dang / a mdo sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ sud si gzhis khongs lha khang pha spen pa khyim tshang bcas nas dus 'khor dbang chen gyi sbyin bdag zhu rgyu'i snyan seng zhus par bka' bzhes legs par thob de ltar gong 145

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'i1 rgyus/gsal sbyin bdag rnams nas sngon 'gro'i sta gon gra sgrig zhu sgo khag legs tshags su tshud pa zhus/ 1985 phyi zla 11 tshes 27 nyin spyi nor 7be|nga sa mchog wa ra ṇa sir chibs bsgyur gyis tshes 29 nyin nas war ṇa dge slob las byed dang / phyogs 'dus mi mang ser skya 1600chig stong drug brgya skor la sgom rim le'u gsum gyi bshad lung stsal/ tshes 4 nyin de nas phebs thon gyis gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du phyi nang gi mi mang khri phrag mang pos phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus/ dbedzin pa'i dbu rtse'i gzim chung du zhabs sor 'khod/ phyi zla 12 tshes 4 nyin bzhugs sgar grwa tshang nas grwa dmangs rnams phebs thon gyis tshes 6 nyin gnas mchog rdo rje gdan du phebs 'byor byung / phyi tshes 7 bod shing glang zla 10 tshes 25 nyin 'jam mgon bla ma tsong kha pa chen po'i dgongs rdzogs lnga mchod chen mor mchod rten rin po che'i sku mdun du rgya che'i tshogs mchod 'bul ba'i tshogs mgon du chibs bsgyur gyis gnas gzigs dang thugs smon gsung chog gnad smin mdzad/ tshes 8 nyin nyi hong dgon pa'i gdan zhu ltar chibs bsgyur bskyangs te chos phyogs kyi mdzad sgo gnang /tshes 9 nyin nas dgon pa'i 'du khang du dge tshul slong gi sdom pa stsal nod dbu tshugs te nyin gsum ring 'bri gung che tshang rin po che sogs 9sprul 146

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edzi rgyus/dang bsgrub bya brgya la dge slong dang / dge tshul bsgrub bya dgu bcu bcas par bslab pa'i gzhi la 'god par mdzad/ tshes 12 nyin byang chub chen po'i mchod rten drung du gso sbyong la chibs bsgyur gyis dge 'dun khri phrag gi dbus su chos khri'i steng nas so thar gyi mdo legs par stsal/ sngar bcom ldan 'das kyis nye bar 'khor la sogs pa'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po rnams la so thar gyi mdo la sogs pa'i chos bsgrags pa'i skabs kyi gzi brjid dang sgo kun nas mtshungs par mdzad/ tshes 23 nyin dgon pa'i 'du khang du gzhung gnas nas bod gangs can gyi ris med chos lugs khag gi blachen sa skya bdag khri rin po che dang / dga' ldan khri rin po che/ 'bri gung che tshang rin po che/ byang rtse chos rje/ 'khrul zhig rin po che bcas gdan zhu gnang ba dang / rang gzhung bka' blon las zur dang spyi 'thus sogs dang / grwa tshang gi 'dus dmangs bcas nas 7gong sa lnga pa chen po'i dag snang tshe dpag med dwangs ma bcud 'dren gyi sgo nas 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog bdag sogs bstan 'gro'i mgon dpung dam par sku tshe zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i brtan bzhugs 'degs 'bul zhus/ 7rbesnang sa mchog nas kyang sku tshe zhabs pad yun du brtan par zhal gyi bzhes pa'i thugs brtse'i 'dzum zhal lhug par grol/ tshes 14 nyin ched du dus 147

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 81 rgyus/'khor dbang chen gnang yul du gsar skrun zhus pa'i gtsug lag khang du chibs bsgyur gyis mi'ajigs gdong lngas btegs pa'i gser khrir zhabs sor 'khod/tshes cha legs pas dbang chen gyi sngon 'gro thun mong lam sbyong du spyod 'jug chen mo'i gsung chos dbu 'dzugs dang 'brel slob ma rjes 'dzin stsal/ sa tshos lhan dang po / tshes 15 lhan sa sa/ra tshes 16 lhan nas rang gzhung chos rig lhan khang nas bstan 'gro'i don du bsod nams kyi tshogs chen gserdzog slad tredze sgrig bskyangs pa bzhin smon lam 'phar ma tshugs/ tshes 14 nas 28 bar spyi nor 7gong sa mchog tshogs dbur chibs bsgyur gyis gong bzhin cho ga dang / phyed yol nas star chags stod pa'i tshogs pa spyi dang / skyed grong rgya lhas bcas rdo rje nas gsol ba btab pa bzhin slob ma'i gtso bo sa skya bdag khri rin po ches dbus pa'i sa nges pa don gyi skye chen dam pa rnams dang / dad ldan slob ma ser skya 'bum phrag gsum skor la dbang chen gyi sngon 'gro thun mong lam sbyang du rgyal sras byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi thugs dam gyi snying bcud byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i bka' khrid/ dam pa be|nga ma rnams kyi bzhed pa gra ma nyams pa'i thog zhal shes man ngag zab mos brgyan cing / lhag par gang nyid nas mdo sngags kyi gzhung lugs rgya mtsho ltabur gsan sam mdzad de thugs la nyams 148

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/rtogs bzang po 'khrungs pa'i snying bcud rnams gzhan phan snying rje chen pos gdul bya mchog dman mtha' dag gis bde blag tu rtogs thub pa'i ljags bshad lhug par stsal/ tshes 21 nyin smon sems dam bca' can gyi sems bskyed bka' drin stsal/ stod pa tshogs pa nas mdo lugs ka brtan bzhugs thog 31gas 'a9tsher bcas tha /zab rgyas bstar 'bul zhus/ tshes 23 nyin dkyil 'khor rgyan 'grems dang / mchod gar/ tshes 24nas bzung nyin bzhi'i ring rgyud sde gzhan dang bshad srol mi 'dra ba rgyud kyi rgyal po bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi lubor lo'i smin byed dbang gi sta gon dang dngos gzhi'i rim pa dbu tshugs shing / 7gong sa mchog ni 'gro ba'i don la cung zad kyang sku bsnyel ba'i rnam pa mi bzhes par nyin mtshan dus drug tu/ gdul bya gang dag dge ba'i sems ma bskyed pa rnams bskyed pa dang bya/ bskyed pa rnams smin pa/ smin pa rnams grol bar bya ba las gzhan gyi dgongs pa med pas dbang chen gyi ring zhogs pa chu tshod 7 par 'char can gtsug lag khang du chibs bsgyur gnang ste brgyud 'debs nas bzung shul tshon gyi sku gsung thugs yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor la brten nas sgrub cing mchod pa dang / bdag nyid bzhugs shing dbang bzhi bzhes nas bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa mngon par sangs rgyas pa'i gnas mchog rdo 149

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/rje gdan du khro bo zhes pa shing mo glang gi lo'i mgo zla'i tshes bco dzi) nyin slob ma'i gtso bo bstan pa'i bya ba mdzad pa la mchog tu spro ba'i ris med kyi skyes chen dam pa chos kyi 'khor los sgyur pa'i rgyal po lta bu rnams dang / bka' rab 'byams dge ba'i bshes gnyen/ sgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol ba'i bya bral/ sngags 'chang grub btsun sku gas dge 'dun dang / gzhis lus spun zla gtso bor gyur pa'i rang rigs bod mi rnams dang / gzhan yang hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud du gnas pa'i mi ring 'brug pa dang / 'bras ljongs/ mon pa/ la dwags/ ga sha/ spi tai/ khu nu/ nai pā la/ rta mang / snye shang /shar pa/ de min rgyal khongs a ri dang / dbyin ji/ hpha ran si/ 'jar man/ bla( si ṭa li ya/ ho lan/ zhe'u rdo lan ḍi/ si pan/ sud si/rgya gar/ nyi hong / tha'e lan/ siṅga pur/ hong gong sogs rigs 'dra min gyi mi bcas khye1na mi grangs 'bum phrag gsum skor 'dzoms pa rnams la sta gon dang / dngos gzhi dkyil 'khor la 'jug pa'i skor dang / byis pa ltar 'jug pa'i dbang bdun/ gong ma'i dbang bzhi/ gong chen gyi dbang bzhi/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag po chen po'i dbang mtha' rten dang bcas pa legs par bka' drin stsal ba dang / gsang sngags sgrub pa'i rten la sdom ldan gnad che bar gsungs pa'i rgyud kyi dgongs pa dang / lhag par gzhis 150

shā ——— —— ga ——— 4 ri3 ༷ ri sa riri mi swe— 4 4 54 dngha 〉ca rdo bye cho ci ci dro4 dhe tsho mi byu ༷ci ri'i rig ṭwā te/ tsho 〉 / ri tsho 4 4༷snye — — ri rna ci rdo 4 7〉 〉 kyi 6 ༷ ci ciṇḍa / / /cho sa ci rdo ri77 〉 ri mo— ru kyi — shel dza ci ga ji 3 gle 4 7 bdag sogs deng nas tshe rabs thams cad du/ /gsang ba'i lha mo khyod dang mi 'bral zhing / /bar chad bgegs kyi mtshan ma ci byung yang / /de kun lha mo khyod kyis bzlog tu gsol/ /
