rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/lus mi dmangs rnams chos byed kyi rang dbang go skabs bral ba'i gnas tshul thugs kyis ma bzod par nyin dang por dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa stsal te khas len bsrung bya spang bya lnga dang mi dge bcu spong / gzhan yang sna gcig sna 'ga'/ phal cher spyod/ yongs rdzogs spyod/ tshangs spyod sogs so so'i blo nus kyis lcogs tshod yid ngo nas khas len bya 'thus zhes dmigs bsal du bka' drin stsal thog sngon 'gro'i gsung bshad zhib rgyas phebs pa'i snying por/ bcom ldan 'das dus kyi 'khor lo'i rgyud 'a di yul khams spyi dang 'brel ba mtshed par ma zad/ lhag par chos min nag phyogs bzlog pa la mchog tu bsngags pa yin pas chos tshul 'de nyid dar zhing rgyas na 'dzam gling dmag 'khrug gi nyen kha sel rgyu shin tu phan thogs chen po yod pa'i skor gyi ljags bshad dang / da nges kyis bka' dbang 'di chos dwar dngos su zhugs pa'i slob ma 'di tsam gyis ma tshad par/ dad pa dang snying stobs 'gyur du med pa'i gzhis lus bod mi rnams ngas chos 'khor gal che bskor ba'i dus gang zhig tu yin rung sngon dang por dmigs 'og tu 'jug gi yod/ da res kyang khong tsho dmigs 'og tu 'jug rgyu yin pas tshang mas thugs smon gnang rogs shes gzhis lus bod rnams la thugs brtse rjes chags chen pos mdzad par brten nges pa don du slob ma'i grangs sa ya drug las brgal 151

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bar byang sems dang / sngags sdom gyis mtshon dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen gyi rim pa mtha' dag rgyud kyi rgya la po chen po'i 'grel che na dri ma med pa'i 'od kyi dgongs pa rgya bod mkhas pa rnams kyi 'grel pa'i srol mang du gnas pa las/ bu ston thams cad mkhyen pa dang / dus kyi 'khor lo rang nyid kyis rgyal po zla ba bzang po ltar bsngags par mdzad pa rje tsong kha pa chen po'i bzhed srol thun mong ma yin pa de nyid/ rje nyid kyi thugs kyi sras gcig bu mkhas grub smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang pos rgyud kyi 'grel chen dang / dkyil 'khesar gyi cho ga cha lag dang bcas pa legs pa gtan la phab pa dang / rgyal mchog bskal bzang rgya mtsho nas 7skyabs rje sku1ngas 'dzin gling sprul khri chen rdo rje 'chang gi bar brgyud pa bar ma chad pas dpyad gsum rnam par dag pa gnang pa'i bshad pa'i rgyun 'dzin te ljags bshad phra zhib mdzad pa dang / phyag len rnams kyang sla chos su ma serdzong ba zab rgyas gnang ba bcas kyis dbang brda 'phrod tsam du ma zad phyi nang gzhan gsum gyi dus kyi 'khor le'i gnad 'gag mtha' dag la ma rtogs pa dang log par rtog pa'i the tshom gyi dri ma ma lus pa bsal te/ mkhas pa rnams la rgyud don mtha' chod pa'i go ba yongs su ster bar mdzad pa bcas legs bshad phul du byung ba'i gtam gyi lcags kyus dpyod ldan mkhas pa rnams kyi snying ni ci yang drangs/ byin 152

rnarma par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edzi rgyus/rlabs bdud rtsi'i char gyis snod ldan slob ma'i rgyud kyi zhing sa ni legs par brlan/ sku bzhi rin po che'i myu gu myur tu 'khrungs pa'i sa bon ni brtan par thebs/ gsang chen bstan pa'i snying po'i pad tshal kha 'byed pa'i dga' ston ni lhag par rgyas/ ma dang mkha' 'gro dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal datredzed cing /dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams kyi dbu 'phang mthon por gyur te sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che dus kyi mthar yang mi nub pa'i rgyal mtshan brtan par 'dzugs pa dang / 'dzam gling gi zhi bde chen po yun du gnas pa'i rnam dkar gyi ba dan phyogs kun du bsgreng bar mdzad do// skabs de dag tu bkra shis pa dang rten 'brel gyi mtshan ma ji snyed byung ba'i dpe mtshon tsam brjod na/ deng dgun dus gnam bzhis skam shas che zhing shul rlung ldang ba'i skabs yin yang sta gon dbu tshugs pa'i nub mo sbrang char zim bu sa gzhi'i shul brlan par babs pa 'di ni mgon po gang nyid rgyud 'di'i bdag po yin pas deng sang snyigs ma las ches snyigs ma'i dus skye bo re re'i rgyud la dge ba'i bsam pa phra mo re yang skye dka' ba'i skabs 'dir gsang sngags bla med kyi smin byed dbang gi rim pa stsal ba'i mthu la brten nas skye bo 'bum phrag du ma mngon mtho dang /nges legs la sbyor ba mdzad par dkar phyogs la mngon par dga' ba'i lha rnams kyis rig nas bdud rtsi'i mchod yon gyi mnyes par sgrub pa dang /153

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/de bzhin war ṇa legs sbyar mtho slob nang pa'i sde tshan gyi dbu 'dzin dang nang chos kyi tshul la rgyus mnga' che ba'i mkhas dbang ༷/ pa de bas 'isna mang gsang sngags kyi chos la nyams zhib byas pa'i mtha' don dus 'khor 'grel chen dri med 'od bal yul gyi ni ba ra'i yi ger legs sbyar gyi skad yig thog lwabod pa zhig nye char bal yul nas rnyed son byung ba des bsam pa'i dogs gnad mang po zhig sel bar brten dad pa lhag par 'phel nas dpar 'debs zhus pa'i dpar phud bka' dbang gi tshogs dbus su phul ba rten 'brel ma bsgrigs lhun grub byung bar ma zad/ khong nas 7gong sa mchog la snyan ngag gi lam las drangs pa'i gsol 'debs bstod tshig brjod don phun sum tshogs pa zhig 7snyan sgron zhus pa'i nang du/ bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo dang ngo bo gnyis su med pa 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen pos dus 'khor gyi chos tshul 'di nyid 'chad nyan dar spel rgya cher mdzad pa'i bka' drin ni nga tsho rgya gar bas ma tshad 'dzam gling yongs la'ang shin tu bka' drin che ba yin pas nga tshos lo rgyusaspyi thog nas bka' drin rjes dran zhu rgyu yin zhes dang /dus kyi 'khor lo'i skor gyi rgyud don mthar phyin pa zhig rtogs dgos na sam skri ta'i skad gcig bus ldang thabs med pas nges par du bod kyi skad yig bslab dgos pa yin zhes sogs 'khod yod pa red/ chos thun gyi thog mar sbyin 154

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bdag khag nas gsol 'debs gtang rag gi maṇḍal tredzeng bzhin 'degs 'bul zhus/ nyin tha mar bka' dbang gi sbyin bdag grwa tshang dang / dha sa bod mi'i mnyam las bzo grwa/ sud si gzhis khongs lho kha ba spen pa'i khyem tshang / sim la sangs rgyas chos gling gnas 'dzin sbyin pa rgya mtsho/ rdor gdan bod dgon 'ga' ldan 'phel rgyas gling bcas nas bka' drin gtang rag tu nang mdzod nyin mo bde legs kyis sne drangs maṇḍal tshom bu dang /bcom ldan 'das tshe dpag med kyi snang brnyan/ sher phyin gyi glegs bam/rnam par rgyal ma'i mchod rten sogs dngos 'byor gyi mchod sprin spam mtho ba rnam thos sras kyi bang mdzod la 'gran pa ltabu'i 'bul tshan rnams spyan lam du bstar yod/ dbang chen gyi mjug tu dmigs bsal bka' slob rim pa stsal ba'i nang don gtso bo ni bstan 'dzen dge 'dun gyi sde rnams nas/ ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang / zhes sogs chigs bcad kyi don bzhin ris med kyi bstan 'dzin dge 'dun rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang thog rgyal ba'i chos tshul mtha' dag la dag snang nor bu'i 'od kyis khyab pa gnang dgos/ de yang dpe cha gcig nas gsungs pa kho na la yid ches ma gnang bar rgya che'i gsung rab kyi gnas la rtog zhib gnang na mthar thug tshang ma'i dgongs pa gcig tu babs shing / der brten sa dge bka' rnying phan tshun 155

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/mkhas pa'i dgongs pa bzhes srol gyi dpe cha klog skabs mu stegs pa'i dpe cha lta bu klog skabs su 'dzin pa'i spyod tshul ltar min pa nges par dad pas kun nas bslangs te gzigs dgos/ rtsaba'i slob gnyer ni rang dbang yin pas sngar sangs rgyas kyis kyang bkag 'gog gnang ma thub par ngas bkag ga la thub/ 'on kyang deng skabs nga la bstan pa ris med kyai 'gan zhig 'khris sku1da stabs/ ngas lhag bsam gyis gzhan skul zhus pa yin/ dge lugs dang rnyi nga ma gnyis bstan pa'i sgrom bslang gzhi phran bu mi 'dra ba yod pas/ dge lugs pa tshos rnying ma'i chos tshul sbyangs na mdo phyogs la go ba gsar pa zhig rnyed rgyu med kyang / sngags phyogs la go ba gsar pa rnyed rgyur phan thog chen po yong gi yod/ deng skabs bstan pa ris med la thos pa gnang mkhan dkon po 'dug pas slad de mur ma lus pa'i thugs brtson don gnyer tshang mas gnang na bstan pa spyir phan gyi red ces thugs nan chen pos 'bod skul mdzad pa dang / mi dmangs byings la'ang da lam khyed tshos chos kyi don la sa thag ring po nas dka' ba spyad de 'gro song mang po btang nas yong ba ltar/ da res ngas nyin shas ring bshad pa'i chos kyi don rnams sems la bzhag nas chos mthun gyi mi tshe skyel thabs dang / sems bzang ya rabs kyi spyod pa rgyun bzhis su 'jags pa byas te rnam kun ma ṇi sogs 156

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/kha ton dang / tshes bzang dus bzang la smyung gnas gso sbyong sogs rnam dkar dge tshogs la 'bad 'bungs ci nus byed dgos/ de ltar byas na spyi sger 'phral phugs gang sar phan thogs chen po yong gi red/ de bzhin hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud nas yong mkhan tsho'i nang da phan sngar pha mes kyi srol ngan gzhir bzung dmar mchod 'bul mkhan sku1da tshwa da nas nges par mtshams 'jog byed dgo zhes dang / mjug tu da re bla slob tshang ma shin tu skal ba bzang po byung / tshang ma blo bde po byos nga tsho rjes su thug yong zhes bka' bzhes bzang po stsal/ tshes 28 nyin sgrol dkar gyi tshe dbang stsal zhing / de skabs ljags bshad du/ de yang 'brom chos kyi rgyal por rje btsun sgrol mas khyed kyi rjes 'brangs kho mos skyong zhes zhal gyis bzhes yod pas bod 'bangs dang dmigs bsal gyi las 'bras sku(da ces gsungs pa dang / de rjes 'jam dpal mtshan brjod kyi bshad lung sogs gzungs sngags khag gi ljags lung stsal ba dang / de mjug 'dzam gling shar nub rgyal khab bcu bzhi'i mi rigs las grub pa'i theg chen chos tshul rgyun 'dzin tshogs pas bla mchod tshogs 'khor dang 'brel ba'i brtan bzhugs gnad smin gzab rgyas bstar 'bul gyi 'don bskul dbu mdzad dang / mchod rnga 'bud dkrol/ 'bul tshan 'degs mi sogs mtha' dag phyi rgyal mi rigs 157

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/rang nyid nas zhus pa dang / zam gdong rin po che nas maṇḍal ljags bshad rgyas par gnang zhing / 'gan 'khur mi snas dbyin skad thog nas gsol 'debs snyan sgron zhus pa'i snying por/ bdag cag rnams tshe 'dir mgon po gang gi lam ston skyabs 'og tu tshud pa'i bsod nams can zhig yin/ brtseb chen po'i gzigs skyong dang / bka' slob/ sems stobs spel ba bcas kyi sgo nas nga tsho byang chub kyi lam du 'god par mdzad cing / de lta'i bka' drin gyi cha shas gsab pa dang / bdag sogs bstan 'gro'i mgon du 7zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i brtan bzhugs 'bul chog pa zhes dang / 'gro ba sems can thams cad kyi don du bdag cag rnams kyi skyabs dang re ltos 'cha' yul mgon po mchog nyid las gzhan ma mchis/ mgon po gang nyid ni bdag cag gi dus gsum bde skyid kyi rtsab lags na/ gang gi thugs bzhed bzhin nged rnams nas zhabs 'degs zhu 'os ci mchis rang sems dwang ba'i sgo nas zhu rgyu yin/ zhes dang / 'das pa'i nga tsho'i bya ba mtha' dag dang / bod rang btsan ni nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos lugs 'jig rten kun du dar spel yun gnas kyi mthun rkyen zhig chags yod/ nga tshos gsol ba yang de ltar 'debs rgyu yin/ gal te 7gong sa mchog nas gnad don 'di'i thog slob ston phebs na nga tshos de don zhabs 'degs 158

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bsgrub rgyu yin zhes sems thag chod pos khas len zhus yod pa red/ de nas khong tsho dang bla slob kyi las 'brel zab pa'i bla ma thub bstan ye shes dam de nyid kyi skye srid nges rnyed yong ba'i 'dod don gsol rjes mgon po gang nyid dus nam yang nga tsho'i mi tshe dang mi 'bral bar shog cig ces smon 'dun zhus nas dngos po'i 'bul ba rgya che spyan lam du bstar/ tshes 29 nyin bod chol kha gsum gyi sgrig 'dzugs dang / chig sgril tshogs pa/ gzhon nu/ bud med bcas kyi tshogs pa'i rgyun las pas 'gan 'khur gra sgrig zhus te gzhis byes bod mi sa ya drug po dad dam gong bu'i nus pa gcig tu bsgril nas mgrin gcig gis 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog bdag sogs mkha' khyab bstan 'gro'i mgon du sku tshe zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan pa'i tshe dpag med nang sgrub 'chi med lha lnga'i cho ga grwa tshang mkhan slob 'dus dmangs nas sgrub zhag sngags bzlas gnad smin sngon song gis ris med bla chen khag dang ser skya 'dus pa 'bum phrag gsum gyi tshogs mgon du 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po gdan drangs nas gong gsal cho ga'i thog mkha' 'gro bsun bzlog 'chi med rdo rje'i srog mkhar gyi cho ga dang / tshogs 'khor 'bum phrag kha shas bcas kyi sgo nas brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs zhus shing /mkha' 'gro'i dar thag rim par bsdus te sku glud kyi rdzong ba 'khyer nas rang 159

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/gnas su dengs/ 'jam mgon rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri rin po che 'jam dpal gzhan phan maḥtsheg nas maṇḍal ljags bshad rgyas par zhus pa'i nang du 'phags mchog 'jig rten dbang phyug ni ring mo zhig nas sangs rgyas zin kyang / bdag cag gangs can pa'i skye 'gro rnams kyi don la mchog gi sprul sku rim par byon pa'i mdzad pa rnam thar dang / lhag par 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog gi mad du byung ba'i mdzad 'phrin nam mkha'i mtha' dbus kun tu khyab pa'i bka' drin gsab pa dang / slad kyang bod kyi bstan srid bde skyed dang 'dzam gling zhi bde bcas pa'i skabs gnas re ltos zhu yul mabe|na po nyid las gzhan med pas sku tshe 7zhabs pad bskal brgyar cis kyang brtan dgos pa'i gsol 'debs thugs rgyud 'khul nges gsung gsang mthon pos shar mar gsung bzhin pa'i mur 7gong sa mchog gi thugs bskyed mdzod 'phrin dang / sku ngal rim pa nyams su bstar yang de dag khur du mi 'dzin par rgyan du bzhes pa'i rgyal sras kyi spyod pa rlabs po cher mchog tu dad pa 'khrungs te spyan chab mu stag gi rdog po ltar lhug lhug babs nas yud tsam gsung gi 'phro yang chad/ skabs der gzhis lus spun zla sogs bod mi gtso bor gyur pa'i phyi nang gi mi rigs 'dra min gyi slob ma phal mo ches mig chu gtong bzhin sku tshe brtan/ khyed mkhyen/ skal ba bzang / myur 160

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/bar gangs ljongs rang dbang gi nyi ma 'char bar mdzod cig ring min gangs ljongs su zhabs sor 'khod par shog ces sogs ngu ngag gis gsol 'debs zhus/ maṇḍal ljags bshad grub pa dang sa skya bdag khri rin po che mchog nas maṇḍal sku gsung thugs rten dang / bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ sku'i na bza' nyer chas sogs zhal 'don tshigs bcad dang sbrags 'bul gnang mdzad par dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtshos mthun 'gyur zhus/ de mjug rin chen dang gnyis las grub pa'i bod rgyal khab chen po'i rgyal rtags gzi 'od 'bar ba zhig 'dus mang dbus nas stag lung zhabs drung rin po ches bteg gnang ba dang / g.yas gamatshen gnyis nas bka' blon 'ju chen thub bstan rnam rgyal dang / spyi 'thus tshogs gzhon blo bzang chos ldan rnam gnyis kyis zur 'degs zhus/ grwa tshang gi gsung zhabs pa rnams pas dbus 'dus dmangs nas gangs ri'i rwa bas zhes pa'i tshigs bcad rta dbyangs kyis gsungs nas tshig rkang rdzogs mtshams 7be|nga sa mchog gi phyag mtshan du dgyes 'bul zhus pa dang dus mnyam mdo 'dar sur gling sogs mchod dbyangs dkrol/ rim bzhin bod kyi bla chen rnam pas rten gsum mjal dar 'bul zin rjes chol gsum 'thus mi nas mjal dar nang mdzod kyi sne drangs pa'i zhing khams rgya mtsho'i bkod pa dang / sku 161

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/gsung thugs rten/ rgyal srid sna bdun/ sku'i na bza' nyer chas sogs dngos 'byor gyi 'bul ba spam mtho ba dang / chabs cig ci gsung bka' bzhin bsgrub rgyu'i khas len dam bca' rim phul gyi 'bru don rnams 'gal med tshul bzhin lag tu bstar te bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pa 'bul rgyu'i skyar nan khas len 'khod pa'i 'bul tho bcas mkhyen brtse nyi zla'i gzigs lam du legs par bstar/ dus tshogs su bsnyen yon dang kha btags phul/ 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon chen po mchog nas da nges ched du dmigs bsal zhal bzhes kyi bka' bzang phebs don/ da lam bod gangs can ljongs kyi sa dge bka' rnying ris su ma chad pa'i mkhas grub rnam pa gdan 'dzoms pa'i thog gzhis byes bod mi sa ya drug nas brtan bzhugs gsol 'debs zhus pa ni dad dam gang thad nas ha cang yag po byung / 7rgyal ba rin po che'i tshe la sems khrul byed ma dgos shing phal cher lo brgyad cu dgu bcu bar sdod red/ gal che shos bod spyi pa'i las don gyi 'gan mi gcig gnyis la 'khris pa lta bu min par mi tshang mar 'khris yod pa yin pas chos byed mkhan zhig yin na'ang 'dra/ gzhung gi las byed pa zhig yin na'ang 'dra/ de bzhin bod pa'i spyi tshogs nang gi tshogs pa tsho yin na'ang 'dra tshang mas phan tshun phyar ba gru 'degs yag po byed dgos pa yin/ deng sang 162

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/dus tshod 'gyur ba song ste bden pa'i mtha' gsal ba dang dus tshod bzang du 'gro ba'i skabs la lhod g.yeng ma song ba nges par byed dgos/ nga tsho'i rtsaba'i 'dod don da lta 'grub thub med/ tshang mas da bar hur thag gnang yod la da dung yang hur thag gnang dgos zhes slob ston 'bod skul nan tan mdzad/ mjug tu bkra shis smerdzon tshig gis mtha' brgyan te mdzad brtan bzhugs sgo grol/ de nas mu mthud nam phyed bar dkyil 'khor mjal kha btang / tshes 30 nyin snga dro rdul tshon bum pa spos snes drangs te mchod rten nye 'khris rdzing chur klu la gtad pa'i cho ga mdzad/ dkyil 'khor sa gzhi'i thig rjes mi mngon par khrus zin pa dang / rdo rje slob dpon chen po dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bzhugs shing chog grwa rnams mthar 'khod dbu zhwa bzhes te shis brjod gdangs dbyangs dal bus bstan 'bar ma dang / bden gsol smon lam sogs kyi mtha' brgyan te me tog gi char chen dbab par mdzad pa bcas dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen thengs bcu gcig pa 'di dag sbyor dngos mjug gsum sla chos su ma song ba mkhas grub gong ma'i phyag len ltar lha mi'i dpal yon dam par legs par grub par mdzad do/ /de nas chos rwa'i sdings cha'i dbus su zhabs stegs la 'khod de hi ma la ya'i ri rgyud nas yong ba'i 'brug dang 'bras ljongs/ mon pa/ la dwags/ ga 163

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/sha/ spi ti/ khu nu/ nai pā la/ rta mang / sne shang / shar pa sogs mi 'bor shin tu khyon che zhig la sems bzang ya rabs byed dgos pa sogs kyi bka' slob byin rten srung mdud bcas gsol ras stsal/ dgong dro bod nas phebs pa'i gzhis lus spun zla bdun stong brgal bar dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal bstan te thugs brtsechen pos bka' slob chu tshod gcig lhag tsam gnang zhing / de skabs gsungs don/ bod kha ba gangs can gyi zhing ni bcom ldan 'das kyi lung gis zin pa'i zhi bde bsti gnas shig dang mi rnams kyang rang bzhin sems pa bzang po snying rje bcas dang ldan pa'i bcas kyi zhi bde'i lung pa zhig yin/ 'on kyang bar lam rkyen ngan gyis rkyen pas nga rang the ba'i mi khag gcig btsan byol ba chags pa dang / bod nang sdod mkhan tshos kyang tshad las brgal ba'i sdug bsngal myangs pa bcas nga cho'i mi thog 'di dka' ngal che shos myong mkhan zhig chags yod pa red ces dang / 1979 lo nas rgya nag gi srid byus phran bu gu yangs su song nas phyi rgyal snyaskor ba rim pas bod la song ba de tsho kha gcig grags kyis bod nang yod pa'i mi rnams sems shugs ha las pa sku1da pa dang / rtsab nas rgya mir mi dga' ba sku(da pa'i gnas tshul gsal po mthong lugs brjod de lo 'di tsam ring bod mi rnams gnya' ma chag par mkhregs por gnas pa 'dzam gling mi dmangs kyis 164

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/gsal rtogs byung yod pa red ces dang / yang rgya mis bod la da bar yag po zhig rtsab nas byas med/ de la nga tshos skad rgyag dus mes rgyal kha bral du gtong gi 'dug ces khong tshos skad ngan rgyag gi yod pa red/ kha bral sus bzos pa red/ dud 'gro khye phag dang bya bye'u zhig yin kyang sdug po gtong mkhan der dga' bo byed kyi ma red/ bod mi rigs rgya mi la sna khug 'tshig pa de bod par rang gshis sdug drags te sna khug 'tshig pa red dam/yang na rgya migadug rtsub che drags te sna khu 'chig pa red bsam thogatong dgos zhes gsung pa dang / de nas bod kyi rgyal rabs dang / rgya nag gi rgyal rabs/ bod rgya'i 'brel ba'i skor bcas la srid don thad kyi dbang shed med par gzu bor gnas pa'i thog nas mnyam zhib byed dgos pa 'dug ces ngas shod kyi yod/ rgya dang bod ces tha dad so so red/ yin na'ang ma 'ongs par gang 'dra byed dam zer na/ de'i tshe de'i dus nga rang tsho bod mi sa ya drug la khe phan che shos dang / thob thang yag shos shig dgos rgyu 'di ni mi'i bde skyed kyi rtsab chags yod/ 'dzam gling thog rgyal rabs la 'pho 'gyur ci yang yong gi yod/ gal che shos do bdag la bde skyed kyi thob thang che shos shig dgos kyi yod pa yin/ de ni ma 'ongs pa'i gnas tshul yin/ 'das pa'i 81 rgyus la cha bzhag na rgya dang bod ces tha dad serme serdzo las bod rgya nag 165

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/gi cha shas su rtsab nas gtogs med/ yin na'ang rgyal khab gcig gyur dang / mnyam sbrel rgyal khab zer ba de 'dra 'dzom gling thog gang yang yong srid pa yin/ 'dzam gling thog mi rigs gcig gyur yin pa zhig thun mong gi khe phan med par gyur dus dum bur gyur pa dang / yang mi rigs tha dad gcig la thun mong gi khe phan dmigs bsal can zhig yong ba'i skabs la gcig gyur byed kyi yod pa red/ de 'dra yin dus ma 'ongs pa'i gnas tshul tha dad yin zhes dang / ma 'ongs par gnas tshul bzang du 'gro rgyu yin zhing / gtso che shos mi dmangs kyi sems shugs yin/ sems shugs yag po yod na sgrub khag po zhig yin kyang 'grub thub pa dang / sems shugs med na sgrub sla po zhig yin yang mi 'grub pa yong srid/ da bar tshang mas lhag bsam dung las dkar ba dang / dam tshig gasku1 ba med par bsdad yod/ da dung mu mthud de ltar bya rgyu gal chen po yin/ nga rang lus po'i cha nas mi yul rgya gar du sa khad chod nas bsdad yod kyang / bod rgya che'i mi dmangs kyi tshur la re ba de tsam rgyag gi yod pa red la/ nga rang tsho tshe rabs mang por las dang smon lam gyi 'brel ba yod pa zhig yin pas ngas nam yang brjed kyi ma red/ nga'i mi tshe gang la gang 'tsham sdod thub pa'i re ba dang smon lam rgyag gi yod la/ ma shi bar ga dus yin kyang bod rgya 166

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi ches rgyus/che'i mi dmangs kyi don la bsam blo gtong gi red/ khyed tsho g.yong ba gtan nas byed ma datredzes/ bod nang la gzhis byes mnyam 'dzoms byas nas bkra shis pa dang skyed pa'i nyi ma tan tan shar gyi red/ bkra shis lugs legs ngang nga'i mi che'i tshe lhag bod nang tan tan bskyal thub kyi red ces zhal bzhes gtsang ma gnang zhing / re zhig mang tshogs dang zhal rgyas la nye ba'i skabs mi dmangs rnams shin tu 'khreng nas slad dus gang zhig du 7gong sa mchog gi zhal dkyil mjal bar 'gyur snyam te yid blong blong por gyur cing / mig mchi mas gang bzhin skad kyi nga ro drag pos mtshan nas bos de gsol ba 'debs pa dang / nyam thag smre sngags kyis myur du mjal ba'i smon lam dang / thugs rje skul ba'i nga ro 'ur 'ur du sgrogs pa'i sgo nas dkar zhing gtsang ba'i mjal dar kha ba babs pa ltar phul te 'bral mi phod pa'i rnam 'gyur du ma byed cing / 7gong sa mchog kyang dad pa'i shugs kyis lhag par gdung ba'i mi dmangs rnams la thugs brtsenges chags chen pos thugs rang dbang med par gamadzes par gyur nas mthong grol gyi 'dzum zhal yang yang ston par mdzad pa dang / yang mang tshogs kyi dkyil nas byis pa 'ga' zhig langs te 7gong sa 7skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu bzhi ba chen po'i dus rabs kyi byis pa'i snying stobs dang rang bzhin bcos min dad pa'i rnam 'gyur mtshon pa'i 167

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/sgo nas thad dar sku gam du rgyug ste mjal dar phul ba dang / ming dang skyes yul sogs bka' rtsad gnang bar gus pa chen pos lan phul ba'i tshig bkrashin tu legs/ de mjug sku sger nas tshang mar dad rten sku par dang byin rten srung mdud/ dril bsgrags las khungs nas kyang sku par dang bka' slob yig cha bcas rang rang 'dod tshim gsol ras stsal/ tshes 31nas phyi lo 1985 zla 1 tshes 3 bar chos lugs khag gi bla chen rnam pa dang 'brel yod phyi nang mi rigs gal che khag la mjal kha dang gsung gleng rim pa mdzad/ tshes 4 nyin zhogs pa rdor gdan nas chibs sgyur gnang skabs slar yang mchod rten rin po cher zhabs skor gnas gzigs kyis bstan 'gror smon pa'i thugs sman rgya che mdzad nas phebs 'khor la bzhugs te chibs bsgyur bskyangs par dad sbyin khag dang / ser skya mi dmangs 'bum phrag gis bsang dang / bdug spos/ kha btags sogs thogs te gus star phebs skyel gzab rgyas zhus/ tshes 5 nyin pan chi gha ni zhes pa'i sa char phebs 'byor skabs sa gnas nas phebs bsu gzab rgyas zhus/ tshes 14 nyin dha sa bzhugs sgar pho brang du bkra shis bde legs ngang zhabs sor lwabod pa bcas bcom ldan 'das dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbang chen thengs bcu gcig pa'i skabs kyi mdzad rim mdor bsdus so//168

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/smras pa/dge ba 'di yis tshe rabs thams cad du/ /ltar snang lam gyis nam yang mi bkri bar/ /yongs rdzogs mdo sngags zung 'brel lam bzang la/ /thos bsam sgom pa gegs med mthar phyin shog /

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 81 rgyus /7derdzong sa bdun pas stsal ba'i rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi bca' yig gser gyi gnya' shing zhes bya ba bzhugs dres//༄ṣṭha༅/ /thams cad mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal 'itshe/ /mngon mtho'i yal ga la 'khyud nges legs kyi/ /me tog byang chub chen po'i 'dzum grol ba//ci 'dod ster ba'i dpag bsam bdag cag gi /skyob pa lha yi bla ma rgyal gyur cig /blo bzang rgyal ba gang gi mdo dang sngags/ /zab rgyas mu rtag do shal mgrin par 'chang / /don ldan grags pa'i sgra dbyangs 'dzam gling 'dir/ /yongs khyab 'jam dpal snying pos dge legs stsol/ /gzi byin stong du 'bar ba'i cod pan gyis/ /gsang sngags 'khor los bsgyur pa'i rgyal tshab tu/ /mngon par dbang bskur rim gnyis grub pa'i gtso/ khres rab seṅge mi yi nyi ma rgyal/ /thabs shes zung 'jug shugs drag rlung gi mthus //bdud dpung gzhan sde bsreg pa'i zhugs chen po/ /rab 'bar dbus 'gying dpal ldan rdo rje 'dzin/ /'jigs mdzad dpa' po mchog gis rtag tu srungs//padma dkar po bzhad pa'i dri gzhon la/ /bung ba bzhin 'dus khrims ldan 170

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edze rgyus/dge 'dun sde/ /blo gsal phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i grwar/ /khrims su bca' ba'i yi ge deng 'dir spel/ /zhes yul khyad 'phags can la bstod phyag gi me tog mngon par 'thor bas mdun bsus te/ slob dpon chen po zla ba grags pas/ slar yang mi g.yo'i sku mnga' khyod kyis srid gsum byon nas sprul rnams kyis/ /gshegs pa dang ni bltams dang byang chub zhi ba'i 'khor lo'ang ston par mdzad/ /de ltar khyed kyi 'jig rten g.yo bag spyod can re ba'i zhags pa ni/ /mang pos bcings pa ma lus thugs rjes mya ngan 'das par bkri bar mdzad/ /ces gsungs pa ltar 'o skol gyi ston pa shākya seṅges 'jig rten ma rig pa'i zhags pas bcings pa'i 'gro ba mtha' dag rnam par grol ba dang yongs su grol ba'i sa la 'god pa'i slad du gzhal du med pa'i dka' ba spyad de sa bcu lam lnga rim gyis bgrod nas 'jigs bral 'og min stug po'i bkod pa'i zhing du shes bya'i sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa rnam par spangs nas 'bras bu nges pa phruldan longs spyod rdzogs skur sangs rgyas te slar yang 'dod pa khams su mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyis 'dul ba'i dus la bab pa na/ dga' ldan gyi dam pa tog dkar po dran bzhin shes bzhin du rgyal po zas gtsang ma'i rigs su sku bltams/ rgyal srid spangs te dka' ba spyad pa dang bdud 'dul ba dang mngon par byang chub pa sogs kyi 171

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'i( rgyus/tshul bstan te gdul bya rnams kyi khams dang bsam pa dang bag la nyal ji lta ba bzhin du chos phung ji snyed cig bka' stsal ba rnams kyi snying po 'dul ba ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dngos dang ston pa'i'ang go chod pa 'dul ba bstod pa las/ rgyal ba ston pa de yis bstan bcos dag /mdo dang chos mngon yin gsungs 'dul ba ni/ /ston dang bstan bcos dngos yin de yi phyir//nyis 'gyur phyag bya sangs rgyas chos gcig bzhin/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar yin la/ de lta bu'i 'dul ba'i bstan pa ni dge 'dun tshul khrims ldan pa dag yod na yod kyi med na mi 'byung ba'i phyir/ dge 'dun rnams tshul khrims yang dag pa'i bcas mtshams las mi 'da' zhing / chos spyod bcu'i bya ba la brtson pa zhig dgos pas/ da lam las dang smon lam gyis nye bar brlan pa'i rgyu las nged mdo smad kyi sa'i char lang cho'i pad ma rnam par bzhad pa la gnam bskos 'jam dbyangs mi'i nyi ma'i rtse ba'i 'od zer gyis bskyangs te sku 'bum bslab pa gsum gyi spos chu'i rdzing bur skyed bsrings pa sogs kyi tshe grags pa'i dri bsung gi nye bar pos nas/ gdan sa chen po se 'bras dga' gsum gyi grwa rigs mos pa dang ldan pa du mas mtshon pa'i blo gsal dge 'dun bung pa'i tshogs 'dus pa rnams kha phyi blta dang grod pa nang blta'i dpe dang mi mtshungs pa yin gzhis/ mig brgyangs dgos gras la rang gi 172

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/gam du bcar ba'i grwa tshang du gzengs bstod pa ji skad du/ phyi ru nyan thos spyod pa skyong / /nang du 'dus pa'i don la dga'/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar/phyi so sor thar pa'i tshul khrims kyis btsun zhing / nang sngags bla med la thos pa dang bsam bsgom gyis 'bras bu mi bskyod rdo rje skad cig nyid la thob par nus pa'i grol ba don nyer can rnam rgyal grwa tshang 'dus tshogs kyi spang blang khrims su bca' ba'i rim pa la/de yang grwa tshang 'dir rtogrwa byed mi'i rigs na tshod lo 15 ma lon na 'jug gi med cing / rab tu 'byung 'os 'gal rkyen med cing mthun rkyen tshang ba dag dge tshul slong gi bslab tshigs snga phyi sogs skabs babs kyis bsgrubs nas zhugs/ dgon sde khag nas 'ongs pa'i tshul khrims 'chal ba'i rigs 'jug gi med de/ rnam 'byed las/ lcags gong me lce 'bar pa dag /zos par gyur na mchog yin gyi/ /tshul 'chal yang dag mi sdom pas/ /yul 'khor bsod stoms za ba min/ /zhes tshul 'chal dang bslab sdom la bag med pa'i rigs kyis dge 'dun gyi dkor la spyod pa rang nyid phung tshabs shin tu che zhing / dge 'dun gzhan rnams kyang sbags nas sbal pa rma can bzhin 'gyur bar gsungs pas rab tu byung nas tshul khrims dag pa dang bag sku1da pa gal che/ ga zhan yang phyogs gzhan nas rab tu 173

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/byung rigs nyes can gnas nas bskrad pa dang / miskye ba'i bar chad dang gnas pa'i bar chad can dang srung mtshams mi zin pa sogs mi zhugs/ dge tshul rnams la yod byad bla gos/ mthang gos/ gding ba/ lhung bzed/ shog li sogs dang / dge slong la chos gos rnam gsum gyis dbus dam pa'i chos 'dul ba nas gsungs pa'i gos yo byad rnams spyir btang yul dus dang bstun ga'i rgyu sogs bzang ngan mtha' gnyis spangs pa dgos rung / gam bcar grwatshang gi grwapa gos chas bzang 'khyer gyon srol bcas bzang ngan rigs las ngan hrul gyon sa med cing gyon pa byung na dge skos kyis rtsis blangs pa'i spyi rdzas su bsdu/ de yang gnas brtan lo brgya lon pa dag dang / gsar bu ba dag tshul khrims ma nyam pa bslab dgos pas/ de ring bsnyen rdzogs pa dang / lo brgya lon pa'i bsnyen rdzogs pa dag srung sdom 'dra bar bstan pa'i shugs kyis dge tshul sogs kyang 'gre bas na/ gnas kyi bla ma bsten te dge tshul gyi bslab bya gnam rtsephong ma'am 'dul 'dzin rin po ches mdzad pa dang / dma' mtha' yang blangs 'das kyi rkang grangs nges pa byas te bsrung ba dang / dge nywadzeng rnams pham pa bzhi/ lhag ma bcu gsum/ spang ltung sum cu/ so sor bshags pa bzhi/ nyes byas brgya dang bcu gnyis te khrims nyis brgya lpabacurtsagasum la spang blang gces spras su bya dgos par tshul khrims 174

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/yang dag par ldan pa'i mdor/ srog dang bral zhing shi ba ni sla yi/ /tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pa ni de lta ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ srog dang bral nas shi ba ni tshe 'di nyid kyi skye ba zad par 'gyur gyi/ tshul khrims nyams shing zhig pas ni skye ba 'bum phrag brgya'i bar du rigs dang bral zhing bde ba spangs te rnam par ltung ba chen po nyams su myong bar 'gyur ro/ /de phyir ston pas tshul khrims rab bsngags bshad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa sangs rgyas 'byung dang 'phrad/ /tshul khrims ldan pa rgyan rnams kun gyi mchog /tshul khrims ldan pa dri ngad byug pa yin/ /zhes sogs phan yon dang bcas gsungs pa bzhin yin pas tshig tsam du ma song bar nyams su bstar ngos dge sbyong la med du mi rung ba dul ba dang zhi ba yin la/ de'i rang bzhin du byed pa bzod pa yin te/ rab tu byung ba gzhan la gnod pa dang / /gzhan la 'tshe ba dge sbyong ma yin no/ /zhes gsung pas gzhan dag la phar mi gnod par ma zad/ tshur gnod pa byung yang lan mi byed par bzod pa bsgom pa bzhis lugs su byas te dri med 'od las/ rgyal bas gsungs pa'i cho ga'i dbang mchog blangs nas rgyud 'di 'am ni bsdus pa yin/ /rgyud rgyal ma lus thos slad yang dag ye shes lam la gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /khengs dang longs spyod 'byor ba du ma btang nas sems ni bla mar gtad byas te/175

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'edzi rgyus//sangs rgyas nyid kyi slad du gtso bo'i rgyas 'grel gzhan phan spyod pa mnyan par bya/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rab gsang bde 'jigs gsum gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par thob pa/ dma' mtha' yang 'jigs mdzad rdo rje'i dbang thob pa dgos shing / de mtshungs bsnyen mtshams gal che bas blam tshul ldan gyis man ngag gis brgyan te 'don cha 'gril rim gyis bsnyen pa ma song ba'i rigs yod na dang / de min yang 'char can zla ba dang po nas zla ba drug pa'i bar dang / bdun pa nas bcu gnyis bar zla ba drug re brje bskor gyis grwa pa mang skabs bcu re dang / nyung mthar bdun re nas khyon lo gcor yong ba'i 'jigs byed kyi bsnyen pa tshad sa gtong zhing / slar bskyar ma'i rigs gang mos kyi yi dam la bsnyen pa byas chog mtshams khag snga phyir mtshams g.yog re gtong / 'phral sel gyi so so'i dge sbyor bgegs sel gyi rigs la bdun phrag gsum las mang bar byed sa med cing /de yang sgrub mchod dang gzhung gi sku rim dang 'grig na byed sa med/ 'don cha 'gril bstun rgyugs rdo rje slob dpon dang dge skos zung sbrel gyis len cing / grwa tshang la zhugs nas 'ordzo gsum ma song bar 'kherdzor zhag la 'gro sa med/ nad gzhis chu tshan du 'gro dgos nges dang / nad pa phyir spo dgos pa/ nyin shas don gcod gal cher 'gro dgos rigs rnams dge 176

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi lo rgyus/skos kyis 'di gar rgyu mtshan byung bstun babs bltas kyi gsal yong zhing /nyin re'i gnang ba dge skos la zhus par 'os min gyi ster lugs byed/ rgyun gtan nyin gcig gi sgrig lam zhogs pa lag ris mthong mtshams nas dge skos la zhal ta bas brda sprad/ dge skos kyis dge 'dun rnams 'od gsal la bzhugs par lha mo bzhis glu dbyangs nges pa dzug dang ldan pas bskul ba'i tshul gyi 'khar rnga chung rim nas bsnun te bzhengs brda btang / dge 'dun rnams mnal gyi 'od gsal las rten brten pa rab 'byams lha'i 'khor lor bzhengs la dam pa'i chos dang mthun pa'i gos tshags legs par mdzad pa dang / nang du lha la gos 'bul ba'i dmigs pas na bza' bzhes te spyod lam rgod bag med par 'du khang gi nye skor du 'byor pa dang byang 'dren gyis ltung bzhags 'go bskul byed pa dang dge skos kyis 'khar rnga'i brdung 'phro gcod/ dge 'dun rnams nas dgag bya dang / dgos pa dran bzhin pa'i sgo nas khrus dmigs bsal btab ste khrus mdzad rjes rje bla ma 'jam dpal dbyangs kyi nyams mgur las/ sgo gsum sdig ltung dri mas sbags pa 'di/ /lhag par las sgrib sbyong ba gnad che bas/ /rgyun du stobs bzhi tshang ba bsten pa gces/ /zhes gsungs pa ltar rgyud 'khul nges pa'i nges 'byung gis kun nas bslangs te phung po gsum pa'i mdo gsungs shing lang 177

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/tshe'i babs bstun gyi phyag la 'bad/ ltung bshags tshar gsum song ba dang bslab pa bgres pa dang mkhas grub che rim gyis 'byon pa las 'tshang ga dang rkang mgyogs mi byed/ byang 'dren gyis gre sangs gnyis brgyab pa'i gral la mnyam bzhugs sdud par byed/ tshogs kyi zhal 'don dang / tshogs yul sdurdzogs sngar rgyun bzhin dang / gung tshigs skabs tshogs la bzhes khu brims te tshang mas lhung bzed du sta gon byas nas byin len gtong 'jog sngon du 'gro ba'i bla ma dbu mdzad pas dkon mchog rjes dran sogs bskul/nang mchod byin rlabs dang / phung mchod bshams pa sogs chos dang mthun pa'i sgo nas nang du phung khams lha'i dkyil 'khor la sbyin sreg 'bul ba'i tshul gyi longs spyad/ mnyam sdud dang yon sbyongagi dbu rdo rje slob dpon gyi bskul/ chab ril bas lhung bzed kyi zhal chu khrim/ phud mchod bskor/tshogs grol ba'i gung seng la shag tu mi 'gro zhing 'phong ra sogs mi byed par so sor dpe cha dang bskyed rdzogs kyi nyams len la brtson pa dgos/ de mtshungs dgong ja grol nas gzim brda ma btang bar shag tu 'gro sa med bar skyor sbyang sogs la brtson pa dang / gzim brda gtong mtshams kyang mtshan mo thun drug tu phye ba'i thun phyed gnyis song mtshams la dge skos kyis gzim brda phul ba dang rim gyis ku co med par shag tu 'byon/ rgyun gtan mig 178

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/mangs sogs dang long gtam sogs tshul min gyi bya ba rnams spangs te/ chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen pos mdzad pa'i lam rim dang sngags rim/ tshul khrims le'u'i rnam bshad/ mkhas grub rin po ches mdzod pa'i rgyud snge spyi rnam/ mkhas grub nor bzang rgya mtshos mdzod pa'i dam tshig gsal sbelan sogs la thos pa mdzad nas thun mong ba'i lam rdo rje theg pa'i nyams len la 'grus pa dgos/ grwa rigs su thad nas rtsabazhi chang dang bcas par mthong thos dogs gsum gyi skyedan chags pa byung na gnas nas bskrad cing / 'khrug longs kha 'thab tsam byed mi byung yang gnyis ka 'bud/ grwa sa phan tshun dang /yul tshan/ gsar rnying / mi dpung grwa sdebs kyi 'thab rtsod/ dge 'dun gyi dbyen dang / bstan bzhig khrims 'gal byas rigs la gte po sde tshan dang bcas par rgyal khrims kyi tsa ra skabs thob byas 'gro bas 'dir gsal ma dgos/ phyi dro'i kha zas dang sgog tsong tha mi'i kha la longs spyod pa byung na dge skos kyis rtog 'jug byas pa'i tshogs kyi dbus su brgya phyag re'i chag pa 'gel/ lo ltar gyi sgrub mchod la dpal gsang ba 'dus pa'i sgrub mchod chu stod zla ba'i tshes gnyis nas grwa pa brgyad kyis nyin bzhi'i ring sa chog nas bzung shul tshon gyi dkyil lwabor gzhung dang mthun pa'i sla chos su ma song ba'i dngos gang gtsang bzhengs te tshes drug nas bcu gsum gyi bar sgrub mchod — 179

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'irdzo rgyus/dngos gzhi dang / bcu bzhi la sbyin sreg bco lnga la dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon spyan 'dren/ zla ba bcu ba'i tshes brgyad nas grwa pa brgyad kyis ldo rje 'jigs byed sgrub mchod kyi sa chog sta gon sogs gong mtshungs kyis shul rtson gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing / bcu gnyis nas nyin bdun gyi bar sgrub mchod/ bcu dgu la sbyin sreg dang nyi shu la rdul tshon spyan 'dren/ sa ga zla ba'i tshes lnga nas bde mchog gi sgrub mchod sa chog dang sta gon shul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor grwa pa brgyad kyis nyin bzhi'i ring du gang nges bzhengs nas sgrub mchod dngos gzhi tshes dgu nas bcu drug gi bar gtong / bcu bdun la sbyin sreg dang bco brgyad la rdul tshon spyan 'dren byed/ sgrub mchod gsum pa'i 'don tshig gdangs dbyangs sogs dang / zla ba ngo re bzhin gyi gso sbyong bco lnga dang /bcu bzhi pa 'dul ba'i dus tshigs bzhin dang / rdo rje slob dpon pas 'grel pa bzhi sbrags 'chad thub phyin nag pa zla ba'i tshes gcig nas brgyad pa'i gnam gang bar gung tshigs grol ba'i gung gseng chen mo'i skabs chos thun re 'chad pa'i sgrig lam rnams rgyud smad pa'i phyag len ltar byed/ chab zhugs grwa sa phan tshun nas sngar rgyun ltar btang na de mtshungs kyi zhag gang 'os dang / lo gsar nas zhag bdun gung gseng byed/ de skabs khyem pa sun 'byin gyi 'jig rten pa ma dad pa'i rigs mi byed/ gal te byed mi byung na dge skos 180

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa tshang phan bde legs bshad gling gi 'itshe rgyus/kyis mtshams tshigs byed/ grwa shag sde ra la dmigs bsal ma gtogs mi skya'i rigs mi gtong / brgyad gtor gyis mtshon dus gtor rnams lag len deb nang bzhin ma chag pa sogs gzhung sger gyi rim gror bstan pa dang sems can la sman pa'i bsam pa rnam dag gi khur len byed pa gal che'o/ /de ltar blang dor gsal ba'i nam mkha'i nor/ /dad brtson chos bzhin spyod pa'i skal bzang blo'i/ /padmo rab 'byed ma nus btsun tshugs kyi/ /kun da zum pa'i snang ba bla na med/ /'dir bkod bca' ba'i khrims kyi rim pa las/ /spang blang 'das pa'i rmongs pa lug gi grogs/ /lugs zung drag po'i spyang ki'i mche ba yis/ /klad 'gems de lta bas na bag yod kyis/ /phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'dus sde 'dir/ /so thar khrims gtsang ngur smyig 'dzin pa'i tshogs/ /'dzam gling sa yi rgyan bzhin gsang sngags kyi/ /mkhas grub skar tshogs ltar bur 'phel bar shog /de ltar gam du bcar ba'i grwa tshang rnam par rgyal ba'i 'dus sde'i bca' yig gser gyi gnya' shing zhes bya ba 'di tā bla ma ye shes bstan pa'i bshes gnyen dang /bka' blon da'i chin bā dur zung nas rgyud smad dang de min nged nas byas pa'i sku 'bum rgyud pa'i ba ca' yig ltar dgos tshul byung ba de ltar na glang khal be'u la bkal ba ltar las ma 'das bzhis/ ha lam rgyud smad grwa tshang gi 181

rnam par rgyal ba'i grwa zang hwa 5 zlode mesas bzhad gling gi lo rgyus/bca' khrims la gzhi byas/ yul dus kyi bsgyur bkod dang bcas pa bskul ma'i dus bcar gyi stabs tshig sbyor gyi spros bcas dor te shā kya'i dge sbyong blo bzang bskal bzang rgya mtshor 'bod pas zil gnon zhes pa me pho rta'i lo nag pa zla ba'i cedros bcu gcig la dreXgs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i pho brang chen po gri 'dzin gnyis par bris pa'o/ /
